1.93.s:
brahmovāca
śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ padmasaṃjñakam /
mahatpuṇyapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ mudā //
1.93.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
शृणु पुत्र प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणं पद्मसंज्ञकम् ।
महत्पुण्यप्रदं नॄणां शृण्वतां पठतां मुदा ॥
1.93.m:
Brahmā said:
Listen, my son; I shall declare the Purāṇa named Padma,
which bestows great merit on men who joyfully hear or read it.

1.93.s:
yathā cañcendriyaḥ sarvaḥ śarīrīti nigadyate /
tathedaṃ pañcabhiḥ khaṇḍairuditaṃ pāpanāśanam //
1.93.d:
यथा चञ्चेन्द्रियः सर्वः शरीरीति निगद्यते ।
तथेदं पञ्चभिः खण्डैरुदितं पापनाशनम् ॥
1.93.m:
Just as everyone possessing five senses is called an embodied being,
so this [Purāṇa], consisting of five sections, is declared to destroy sins.

1.93.s:
pulastyena tu bhīṣmāya sṛṣṭyādikramato dvija /
nānākhyānetihāsādyairyatrokto dharmavistaraḥ //
1.93.d:
पुलस्त्येन तु भीष्माय सृष्ट्यादिक्रमतो द्विज ।
नानाख्यानेतिहासाद्यैर्यत्रोक्तो धर्मविस्तरः ॥
1.93.m:
Wherein the full extent of dharma was spoken by Pulastya to Bhīṣma
in order from creation onward, O twice-born, through various tales and histories;

1.93.s:
puṣkarasya ca māhātmyaṃ vistareṇa prakīrtitam /
brahmayajñavidhānaṃ ca vedapāṭhādilakṣaṇam //
1.93.d:
पुष्करस्य च माहात्म्यं विस्तरेण प्रकीर्तितम् ।
ब्रह्मयज्ञविधानं च वेदपाठादिलक्षणम् ॥
1.93.m:
the eulogy of greatness of Puṣkara is proclaimed at length,
and the rule for the sacrifice to Brahman, characterized by Vedic recitation and the like;

1.93.s:
dānānāṃ kīrtanaṃ yatra vratānāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak /
vivāhaḥ śailajāyāścatārakākhyānakaṃ mahat //
1.93.d:
दानानां कीर्तनं यत्र व्रतानां च पृथक्पृथक् ।
विवाहः शैलजायाश्चतारकाख्यानकं महत् ॥
1.93.m:
wherein is the proclamation of gifts and each of the observances separately,
the marriage of the daughter of the Mountain, and the great story of Tāraka;

1.93.s:
māhātmyaṃ ca gavādīnāṃ kīrtitaṃ sarvapuṇyadam /
kālakeyādidaityānāṃ vadho yatra pṛthakpṛthak //
1.93.d:
माहात्म्यं च गवादीनां कीर्तितं सर्वपुण्यदम् ।
कालकेयादिदैत्यानां वधो यत्र पृथक्पृथक् ॥
1.93.m:
the eulogy of greatness of cows and other [beings] is proclaimed, bestowing all merit,
wherein the slaying of the Daityas beginning with the Kālakeyas is told separately;

1.93.s:
grahāṇāmarcanaṃ dānaṃ yatra proktaṃ dvijottama /
tatsṛṣṭikhaṇḍamuddiṣṭaṃ vyāsena sumahātmanā //
1.93.d:
ग्रहाणामर्चनं दानं यत्र प्रोक्तं द्विजोत्तम ।
तत्सृष्टिखण्डमुद्दिष्टं व्यासेन सुमहात्मना ॥
1.93.m:
wherein the worship of the planets and donation are spoken of, O best of the twice-born—
that is taught as the Sṛṣṭikhaṇḍa by the very great-souled Vyāsa.

1.93.s:
pitṛmātrādipūjyatve śivaśarmakathā purā /
suvratasya kathā paścādvṛtrasya ca vadhastathā //
1.93.d:
पितृमात्रादिपूज्यत्वे शिवशर्मकथा पुरा ।
सुव्रतस्य कथा पश्चाद्वृत्रस्य च वधस्तथा ॥
1.93.m:
In regard to the venerability of father, mother, and others, the story of Śivaśarman formerly,
then the story of Suvrata, and likewise the slaying of Vṛtra;

1.93.s:
pṛthorvainasya cākhyānaṃ sunūthāyāḥ kathā tathā /
sukalākhyānakaṃ caiva dharmākhyānaṃ tataḥ param //
1.93.d:
पृथोर्वैनस्य चाख्यानं सुनूथायाः कथा तथा ।
सुकलाख्यानकं चैव धर्माख्यानं ततः परम् ॥
1.93.m:
the tale of Pṛthu, son of Vena, and likewise the story of Sunīthā,
the tale of Sukalā, and after that the story of Dharma;

1.93.s:
pitṛśuśrūṣaṇākhyānaṃ nahuṣasya kathā tataḥ /
yayāticaritaṃ caiva gurutīrthanirūpaṇam //
1.93.d:
पितृशुश्रूषणाख्यानं नहुषस्य कथा ततः ।
ययातिचरितं चैव गुरुतीर्थनिरूपणम् ॥
1.93.m:
the tale of attending upon parents, then the story of Nahuṣa,
the deed of Yayāti, and the determination of sacred fords [such as] the guru;

1.93.s:
rājñā jaiminisaṃvādo bahvāścaryyakathāyutaḥ /
kathā hyaśokasuṃdaryāhuṇḍadaityavadhānvitā //
1.93.d:
राज्ञा जैमिनिसंवादो बह्वाश्चर्य्यकथायुतः ।
कथा ह्यशोकसुंदर्याहुण्डदैत्यवधान्विता ॥
1.93.m:
the king's dialogue with Jaimini, full of many wondrous stories;
the story of Aśokasundarī, accompanied by the slaying of the Daitya Huṇḍa;

1.93.s:
kāmodākhyānakaṃ tatra vihuṇḍavadhasaṃyutam /
kuñjalasya ca saṃvādaścyavanena mahātmanā //
1.93.d:
कामोदाख्यानकं तत्र विहुण्डवधसंयुतम् ।
कुञ्जलस्य च संवादश्च्यवनेन महात्मना ॥
1.93.m:
therein the tale of Kāmodā, joined with the slaying of Vihuṇḍa;
and Kuñjala's dialogue with the great-souled Cyavana;

1.93.s:
siddhākhyānaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ khaṇḍasyāsya phalohanam /
sūtaśaunakasaṃvādaṃ bhūmikhaṇḍamidaṃ smṛtam //
1.93.d:
सिद्धाख्यानं ततः प्रोक्तं खण्डस्यास्य फलोहनम् ।
सूतशौनकसंवादं भूमिखण्डमिदं स्मृतम् ॥
1.93.m:
then the tale of the Siddha is told, and the statement of the fruits of this section;
consisting of the dialogue between Sūta and Śaunaka, this is remembered as the Bhūmikhaṇḍa.

1.93.s:
brahmāṇḍotpattiruditā yatrarṣibhiśca sautinā /
sabhūmilokasaṃsthānaṃ tīrthākhyānaṃ tataḥ param //
1.93.d:
ब्रह्माण्डोत्पत्तिरुदिता यत्रर्षिभिश्च सौतिना ।
सभूमिलोकसंस्थानं तीर्थाख्यानं ततः परम् ॥
1.93.m:
Wherein the origin of the cosmic egg was told to the sages by the son of Sūta,
with the arrangement of the earthly world, and after that the accounts of sacred fords;

1.93.s:
narmadotpattikathanaṃ tattīrthānāṃ kathāḥ pṛthak /
kurukṣetrāditīrthānāṃ kathā puṇyā prakīrtitā //
1.93.d:
नर्मदोत्पत्तिकथनं तत्तीर्थानां कथाः पृथक् ।
कुरुक्षेत्रादितीर्थानां कथा पुण्या प्रकीर्तिता ॥
1.93.m:
the account of the origin of the Narmadā, the individual stories of its sacred fords,
and the holy tale of sacred fords such as Kurukṣetra is proclaimed;

1.93.s:
kālindīpuṇyakathanaṃ kāśīmāhātmyavarṇanam /
gayāyāścaiva māhātmyaṃ prayāgasya ca puṇyakam //
1.93.d:
कालिन्दीपुण्यकथनं काशीमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ।
गयायाश्चैव माहात्म्यं प्रयागस्य च पुण्यकम् ॥
1.93.m:
the account of the merit of the Kālindī, the description of the eulogy of greatness of Kāśī,
the eulogy of greatness of Gayā, and the merit of Prayāga;

1.93.s:
varṇāśramānurodhena karmayoganirūpaṇam /
vyāsajaminisaṃvādaḥ puṇyakarmakathānvitaḥ //
1.93.d:
वर्णाश्रमानुरोधेन कर्मयोगनिरूपणम् ।
व्यासजमिनिसंवादः पुण्यकर्मकथान्वितः ॥
1.93.m:
the determination of karmayoga in accordance with the classes and stages of life;
the dialogue of Vyāsa and Jaimini, accompanied by stories of meritorious deeds;

1.93.s:
samudramathanākhyānaṃ vratākhyānaṃ tataḥ param /
ūrjjapañcāhamāhāmyaṃ stotraṃ sarvāparādhanut //
1.93.d:
समुद्रमथनाख्यानं व्रताख्यानं ततः परम् ।
ऊर्ज्जपञ्चाहमाहाम्यं स्तोत्रं सर्वापराधनुत् ॥
1.93.m:
the tale of the churning of the ocean, and after that the tale of observances,
the eulogy of greatness of the five days of Ūrja, and the hymn removing all transgressions;

1.93.s:
etatsvargābhidhaṃ vipra sarvapātakanāśanam /
rāmāśvamedhaṃ prathamaṃ rāmarājyābhiṣecanam //
1.93.d:
एतत्स्वर्गाभिधं विप्र सर्वपातकनाशनम् ।
रामाश्वमेधं प्रथमं रामराज्याभिषेचनम् ॥
1.93.m:
this, O twice-born, named Svarga, destroys all sins.
[In the next], first Rāma's horse sacrifice, the consecration of Rāma's kingship,

1.93.s:
agastyādyāgamaścaiva paulastyānvayakīrttanam /
aśvamedhopadeśaśca hayacaryā tataḥ param //
1.93.d:
अगस्त्याद्यागमश्चैव पौलस्त्यान्वयकीर्त्तनम् ।
अश्वमेधोपदेशश्च हयचर्या ततः परम् ॥
1.93.m:
the arrival of Agastya and others, the proclamation of the lineage of Pulastya's descendant,
the instruction on the horse sacrifice, and after that the course of the horse;

1.93.s:
nānārājakathāḥ puṇyā jagannāthānuvarṇanam /
vṛndāvanasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
1.93.d:
नानाराजकथाः पुण्या जगन्नाथानुवर्णनम् ।
वृन्दावनस्य माहात्म्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
1.93.m:
various holy tales of kings, the description of Jagannātha,
and the eulogy of greatness of Vṛndāvana, which destroys all sins;

1.93.s:
nityalīlānukathanaṃ yatra kṛṣṇāvatāriṇaḥ /
mādhavasnānamāhātmyaṃ snānadānārcane phalam //
1.93.d:
नित्यलीलानुकथनं यत्र कृष्णावतारिणः ।
माधवस्नानमाहात्म्यं स्नानदानार्चने फलम् ॥
1.93.m:
wherein is the narration of the eternal play of the descended Kṛṣṇa,
the eulogy of greatness of bathing in Mādhava, and the fruit of bathing, giving, and worship.

1.93.s:
dharāvarāhasaṃvādo yamabrahmaṇayoḥ kathā /
saṃvādo rājadūtānāṃ kṛṣṇastotranirūpaṇam //
1.93.d:
धरावराहसंवादो यमब्रह्मणयोः कथा ।
संवादो राजदूतानां कृष्णस्तोत्रनिरूपणम् ॥
1.93.m: The dialogue of the Earth and the Boar; the story of Yama and the brāhmaṇa; / the conversation of the king's messengers; the expounding of the hymn to Kṛṣṇa;

1.93.s:
śivaśaṃbhusamāyogī dadhīcākhyānakaṃ tataḥ /
bhasmamāhātmyamatulaṃ śivamāhātmyamuttamam //
1.93.d:
शिवशंभुसमायोगी दधीचाख्यानकं ततः ।
भस्ममाहात्म्यमतुलं शिवमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ॥
1.93.m: the union of Śiva and Śambhu; then the story of Dadhīca; / the peerless eulogy of greatness of sacred ash; the excellent eulogy of greatness of Śiva;

1.93.s:
devarātasutākhyānaṃ purāṇajñapraśaṃsanam /
gautamākhyānakaṃ caiva śivagītā tataḥ smṛtā //
1.93.d:
देवरातसुताख्यानं पुराणज्ञप्रशंसनम् ।
गौतमाख्यानकं चैव शिवगीता ततः स्मृता ॥
1.93.m: the story of the son of Devarāta; praise of one who knows the Purāṇas; / and the story of Gautama; then is recalled the Śivagītā;

1.93.s:
kalpāntare rānakathā bhāradvājāśramasthitā /
pātālakhaṇḍametaddhi śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ sadā //
1.93.d:
कल्पान्तरे रानकथा भारद्वाजाश्रमस्थिता ।
पातालखण्डमेतद्धि शृण्वतां पठतां सदा ॥
1.93.m: the story of Rāma set in the hermitage of Bharadvāja in another kalpa; / this indeed is the Pātālakhaṇḍa, which, for those who always hear or recite it,

1.93.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradam /
parvatākhyānakaṃ pūrvaṃ gaurthai proktaṃ śivena vai //
1.93.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वाभीष्टफलप्रदम् ।
पर्वताख्यानकं पूर्वं गौर्थै प्रोक्तं शिवेन वै ॥
1.93.m: calms all sins and grants the fruit of all desires. / Formerly the story of the mountain was told to Gaurī by Śiva indeed;

1.93.s:
jālandharakathā paścācchrīśailādyanukīrtanam /
sagarasya kathā puṇyā tataḥ paramudīritam //
1.93.d:
जालन्धरकथा पश्चाच्छ्रीशैलाद्यनुकीर्तनम् ।
सगरस्य कथा पुण्या ततः परमुदीरितम् ॥
1.93.m: afterwards the story of Jālandhara; the celebration of Śrīśaila and other [places]; / the holy story of Sagara; beyond that is related

1.93.s:
gaṅgāprayāgakāśīnāṃ gayāyāścādhipuṇyakam /
annādi dānamāhātmyaṃ tanmahādvādaśīvratam //
1.93.d:
गङ्गाप्रयागकाशीनां गयायाश्चाधिपुण्यकम् ।
अन्नादि दानमाहात्म्यं तन्महाद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
1.93.m: the supreme sanctity of the Gaṅgā, Prayāga, Kāśī, and Gayā; / the eulogy of greatness of gifts of food and the like; then the observance of the Mahādvādaśī;

1.93.s:
caturviṃśaikādaśīnāṃ māhātmyaṃ pṛthagīritam /
viṣṇudharmasamākhyānaṃ viṣṇunāmasahasrakam //
1.93.d:
चतुर्विंशैकादशीनां माहात्म्यं पृथगीरितम् ।
विष्णुधर्मसमाख्यानं विष्णुनामसहस्रकम् ॥
1.93.m: the eulogy of greatness of the twenty-four Ekādaśīs, stated individually; / the discourse on the Vaiṣṇava duty; the thousand names of Viṣṇu;

1.93.s:
kārtikavratamāhātmyaṃ māghasnānaphalaṃ tataḥ /
jambṛdvīpasya tīrthānāṃ māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam //
1.93.d:
कार्तिकव्रतमाहात्म्यं माघस्नानफलं ततः ।
जम्बृद्वीपस्य तीर्थानां माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ॥
1.93.m: the eulogy of greatness of the Kārtika observance; then the fruit of bathing in Māgha; / the sin-destroying eulogy of greatness of the sacred fords of Jambūdvīpa;

1.93.s:
sābhramatyāśca māhātmyaṃ nṛsiṃhotpattivarṇanam /
devaśarmādikākhyānaṃ gītāmāhātmyavarṇanam //
1.93.d:
साभ्रमत्याश्च माहात्म्यं नृसिंहोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् ।
देवशर्मादिकाख्यानं गीतामाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ॥
1.93.m: and the eulogy of greatness of the Sābharmatī; the description of the origin of Nṛsiṃha; / the story of Devaśarman and others; the description of the eulogy of greatness of the Gītā;

1.93.s:
bhaktyākhyānaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ śrīmadbhāgavatasya ha /
indraprasthasya māhātmyaṃ bahutīrthakathānvitam //
1.93.d:
भक्त्याख्यानं च माहात्म्यं श्रीमद्भागवतस्य ह ।
इन्द्रप्रस्थस्य माहात्म्यं बहुतीर्थकथान्वितम् ॥
1.93.m: the narrative of devotion and the eulogy of greatness of the Śrīmadbhāgavata; / the eulogy of greatness of Indraprastha, accompanied by stories of many sacred fords;

1.93.s:
mantraratnābhidhānaṃ ca tripādbhūtyanuvarṇanam /
avatārakathāḥ puṇyā matsyādīnāmataḥ param //
1.93.d:
मन्त्ररत्नाभिधानं च त्रिपाद्भूत्यनुवर्णनम् ।
अवतारकथाः पुण्या मत्स्यादीनामतः परम् ॥
1.93.m: the name of the jewel among mantras and the detailed description of the three-legged manifestation; / beyond this are the holy stories of the incarnations, Matsya and the rest;

1.93.s:
rāmanāmaśataṃ divyaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ ca vāḍava /
parīkṣaṇaṃ ca bhṛguṇā śrīviṣṇorvaibhavasya ca //
1.93.d:
रामनामशतं दिव्यं तन्माहात्म्यं च वाडव ।
परीक्षणं च भृगुणा श्रीविष्णोर्वैभवस्य च ॥
1.93.m: the divine hundred names of Rāma and their eulogy of greatness, O brāhmaṇa; / and the testing of the majesty of glorious Viṣṇu by Bhṛgu:

1.93.s:
ityetaduttaraṃ khaṇḍaṃ pañcamaṃ sarvapuṇyadam /
pañcakhaṇḍayutaṃ pādmaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti narottamaḥ //
1.93.d:
इत्येतदुत्तरं खण्डं पञ्चमं सर्वपुण्यदम् ।
पञ्चखण्डयुतं पाद्मं यः शृणोति नरोत्तमः ॥
1.93.m: such is this fifth, the Uttarakhaṇḍa, conferring all religious merit. / Whichever best of men listens to the Padma [Purāṇa], consisting of five khaṇḍas,

1.93.s:
sa labhedvaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma bhuktvā bhogānihepsitān /
etadvai pañcapañcāśatsahasraṃ padmasaṃjñakam //
1.93.d:
स लभेद्वैष्णवं धाम भुक्त्वा भोगानिहेप्सितान् ।
एतद्वै पञ्चपञ्चाशत्सहस्रं पद्मसंज्ञकम् ॥
1.93.m: having enjoyed his desired pleasures here, he shall attain the realm of Viṣṇu. / This Purāṇa named Padma, consisting of fifty-five thousand [verses],

1.93.s:
purāṇaṃ lekhayitvā vai jyeṣṭhyāṃ svarṇābjasaṃyutam /
yaḥ pradadyātsusatkṛtya purāṇajñāya mānada //
1.93.d:
पुराणं लेखयित्वा वै ज्येष्ठ्यां स्वर्णाब्जसंयुतम् ।
यः प्रदद्यात्सुसत्कृत्य पुराणज्ञाय मानद ॥
1.93.m: having had it written down and accompanied by a golden lotus on the full moon day of Jyeṣṭha, / whoever, having properly honoured it, presents it to one who knows the Purāṇas, O respect-giver,

1.93.s:
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ /
padmānukramaṇīmetāṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyāttathā //
1.93.d:
स याति वैष्णवं धाम सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः ।
पद्मानुक्रमणीमेतां यः पठेच्छृणुयात्तथा ॥
1.93.m: he goes to the realm of Viṣṇu, bowed to by all the gods. / Whoever reads or likewise hears this table of contents of the Padma [Purāṇa],

1.93.s:
so 'pi padmapurāṇasya labhecchravaṇajaṃ phalam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde padmapurāṇānukramaṇikāvarṇanaṃ nāma trinavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.93.d:
सो ऽपि पद्मपुराणस्य लभेच्छ्रवणजं फलम् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे पद्मपुराणानुक्रमणिकावर्णनं नाम त्रिनवतितमो ऽध्यायः
1.93.m:
he too shall obtain the fruit born of listening to the Padmapurāṇa.

Thus ends the ninety-third chapter, named 'Description of the Table of Contents of the Padmapurāṇa', in the Fourth Quarter of the Great Narrative in the First Part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

1.94.s:
śrībrahmovāca
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahat /
trayoviṃśatisahasraṃ sarvapātakanāśanam //
1.94.d:
श्रीब्रह्मोवाच
शृणु वत्स प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणं वैष्णवं महत् ।
त्रयोविंशतिसहस्रं सर्वपातकनाशनम् ॥
1.94.m: Glorious Brahmā said: / Listen, my child, I shall tell of the great Vaiṣṇava Purāṇa, / consisting of twenty-three thousand [verses], destroying all sins,

1.94.s:
yatrādibhāge nirviṣṭāḥ ṣaḍaṃśāḥ śaktijena ha /
maitreyāyādime tatra purāṇasyāvatārikām //
1.94.d:
यत्रादिभागे निर्विष्टाः षडंशाः शक्तिजेन ह ।
मैत्रेयायादिमे तत्र पुराणस्यावतारिकाम् ॥
1.94.m: in whose first section six parts were set forth by the son of Śakti / to Maitreya; there, in the first [part], is the introduction of the Purāṇa;

1.94.s:
ādikāraṇasargaśca devādīnāṃ ca saṃbhavaḥ /
samudramathanākhyānaṃ dakṣādīnāṃ tato 'nvayaḥ //
1.94.d:
आदिकारणसर्गश्च देवादीनां च संभवः ।
समुद्रमथनाख्यानं दक्षादीनां ततो ऽन्वयः ॥
1.94.m: and the creation from the original cause, and the origin of the gods and others; / the story of the churning of the ocean, and then the lineage of Dakṣa and others;

1.94.s:
dhruvasya caritaṃ caiva pṛthoścaritameva ca /
pracetasaṃ tathākhyānaṃ prahlādasya kathānakam //
1.94.d:
ध्रुवस्य चरितं चैव पृथोश्चरितमेव च ।
प्रचेतसं तथाख्यानं प्रह्लादस्य कथानकम् ॥
1.94.m: and the deeds of Dhruva, and the deeds of Pṛthu; / likewise the story of the Pracetases; the story of Prahlāda;

1.94.s:
pṛthagrājyādhikārākhyā prathamoṃ'śaitīritaḥ /
priyavratānvayākhyākhyānaṃ dvīpavarṣanirūpaṇam //
1.94.d:
पृथग्राज्याधिकाराख्या प्रथमोंऽशैतीरितः ।
प्रियव्रतान्वयाख्याख्यानं द्वीपवर्षनिरूपणम् ॥
1.94.m: the account of the distinct jurisdictions of sovereignty—this is related as the first part. / The story of the lineage of Priyavrata; the description of the continents and regions;

1.94.s:
pātālanarakākhyānaṃ saptasvarganirūpaṇam /
sūryādivārakathanaṃ pṛthaglakṣaṇasaṃyutam //
1.94.d:
पातालनरकाख्यानं सप्तस्वर्गनिरूपणम् ।
सूर्यादिवारकथनं पृथग्लक्षणसंयुतम् ॥
1.94.m: the account of the netherworlds and hells; the description of the seven heavens; / the account of the planetary days beginning with Sunday, endowed with their distinct characteristics;

1.94.s:
caritaṃ bharatasyātha muktimārganidarśanam /
nidāghaṛbhusaṃvādo dvitīyoṃśa udāhṛtaḥ //
1.94.d:
चरितं भरतस्याथ मुक्तिमार्गनिदर्शनम् ।
निदाघऋभुसंवादो द्वितीयोंश उदाहृतः ॥
1.94.m: the deeds of Bharata, then the showing of the path to liberation; / the dialogue of Nidāgha and Ṛbhu—this is called the second part.

1.94.s:
manvantarasamākhyānaṃ vedavyāsāvatārakam /
narakoddhārakaṃ karma gaditaṃ ca tataḥ param //
1.94.d:
मन्वन्तरसमाख्यानं वेदव्यासावतारकम् ।
नरकोद्धारकं कर्म गदितं च ततः परम् ॥
1.94.m: The account of the Manvantaras; the incarnation of Vedavyāsa; / and beyond that is recounted the action that delivers from hell;

1.94.s:
sagarasyaurvasaṃvāde sarvadharmanirūpaṇam /
śrāddhakalpaṃ tathoddiṣṭaṃ varṇāśramanibandhanam //
1.94.d:
सगरस्यौर्वसंवादे सर्वधर्मनिरूपणम् ।
श्राद्धकल्पं तथोद्दिष्टं वर्णाश्रमनिबन्धनम् ॥
1.94.m: the determination of all duties in the dialogue of Sagara and Aurva; / likewise the rite of ancestral offerings is taught, and the rules of class and stage of life;

1.94.s:
sadācāraśca kathito māyāmohakathā tataḥ /
tṛtīyoṃ'śo 'yamuditaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ //
1.94.d:
सदाचारश्च कथितो मायामोहकथा ततः ।
तृतीयोंऽशो ऽयमुदितः सर्वपापप्रणाशनः ॥
1.94.m: and right conduct is related; then the story of the delusion of Māyā: / this third part is declared, which destroys all sins.

1.94.s:
sūryavaṃśakatha puṇyā somavaṃśānukīrtanam /
caturtheṃ'śemuniśreṣṭha nānārājakathānvitam //
1.94.d:
सूर्यवंशकथ पुण्या सोमवंशानुकीर्तनम् ।
चतुर्थेंऽशेमुनिश्रेष्ठ नानाराजकथान्वितम् ॥
1.94.m: The holy story of the Solar dynasty, the celebration of the Lunar dynasty / in the fourth part, O best of sages, accompanied by stories of various kings;

1.94.s:
kṛṣṇāvatārasaṃpraśno gokulīyā kathā tataḥ /
pūtanādivadho bālye kaumāre 'ghādihiṃsanam //
1.94.d:
कृष्णावतारसंप्रश्नो गोकुलीया कथा ततः ।
पूतनादिवधो बाल्ये कौमारे ऽघादिहिंसनम् ॥
1.94.m: the inquiry into the incarnation of Kṛṣṇa; then the story taking place in Gokula; / the slaying of Pūtanā and others in childhood; the destruction of Agha and others in boyhood;

1.94.s:
kaiśore kaṃsahananaṃ māthuraṃ caritaṃ tathā /
tatastu yauvane proktā līlā dvāravatībhavā //
1.94.d:
कैशोरे कंसहननं माथुरं चरितं तथा ।
ततस्तु यौवने प्रोक्ता लीला द्वारवतीभवा ॥
1.94.m: the killing of Kaṃsa in youth, and the deeds in Mathurā; / then, indeed, the sport that occurred in Dvāravatī is told in his manhood;

1.94.s:
sarvadaityavadho yatra vivāhāśca pṛthagvidhāḥ /
yatra sthitvājagannāthaḥ kṛṣṇo yogeśvareśvaraḥ //
1.94.d:
सर्वदैत्यवधो यत्र विवाहाश्च पृथग्विधाः ।
यत्र स्थित्वाजगन्नाथः कृष्णो योगेश्वरेश्वरः ॥
1.94.m: wherein took place the slaying of all demons and various marriages; / wherein abiding, the Lord of the universe, Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of the lords of yoga,

1.94.s:
bhūbhāraharaṇaṃ cakre pareṣāṃ hananādibhiḥ /
aṣṭāvakrīyamākhyānaṃ pañcamoṃ'śa itīritaḥ //
1.94.d:
भूभारहरणं चक्रे परेषां हननादिभिः ।
अष्टावक्रीयमाख्यानं पञ्चमोंऽश इतीरितः ॥
1.94.m: removed the burden of the earth by slaying enemies and the like; / the story of Aṣṭāvakra—this is related as the fifth part.

1.94.s:
kalijaṃ caritaṃ proktaṃ cāturvidhyaṃ layasya ca /
brahmajñānasamuddeśaḥ khāṇḍikyasya nirūpitaḥ //
1.94.d:
कलिजं चरितं प्रोक्तं चातुर्विध्यं लयस्य च ।
ब्रह्मज्ञानसमुद्देशः खाण्डिक्यस्य निरूपितः ॥
1.94.m: The deeds born of the Kali age are told, and the fourfold nature of dissolution; / the instruction on the knowledge of Brahman was expounded to Khāṇḍikya

1.94.s:
keśidhvajena cetyeṣa ṣaṣṭhāeṃ'śaḥ parikīrtitaḥ /
ataḥ paraṃ tu sūtena śaunakādibhirādarāt //
1.94.d:
केशिध्वजेन चेत्येष षष्ठाएंऽशः परिकीर्तितः ।
अतः परं तु सूतेन शौनकादिभिरादरात् ॥
1.94.m: by Keśidhvaja: thus this sixth part has been celebrated. / Further, however, by Sūta, respectfully questioned

1.94.s:
pṛṣṭena coditāḥ śaśvadviṣṇudharmottarāhvayāḥ /
nānādharmakathāḥ puṇyā vratāni niyamā yamāḥ //
1.94.d:
पृष्टेन चोदिताः शश्वद्विष्णुधर्मोत्तराह्वयाः ।
नानाधर्मकथाः पुण्या व्रतानि नियमा यमाः ॥
1.94.m: by Śaunaka and others, were constantly proclaimed the holy stories of various duties / named Viṣṇudharmottara, observances, restraints, and disciplines;

1.94.s:
dharmaśāstraṃ cārthaśāstraṃ vedāntaṃ jyotiṣaṃ tathā /
vaṃśākhyānaṃ prakaraṇāt stotrāṇi manavastathā //
1.94.d:
धर्मशास्त्रं चार्थशास्त्रं वेदान्तं ज्योतिषं तथा ।
वंशाख्यानं प्रकरणात् स्तोत्राणि मनवस्तथा ॥
1.94.m: the treatise on dharma and the treatise on statecraft, Vedānta and astrology; / the account of dynasties in due course, hymns, and the Manus;

1.94.s:
nānāvidyāstathā proktāḥ sarvalokopakārikāḥ /
etadviṣṇupurāṇaṃ vai sarvaśāstrārthasaṃgraham //
1.94.d:
नानाविद्यास्तथा प्रोक्ताः सर्वलोकोपकारिकाः ।
एतद्विष्णुपुराणं वै सर्वशास्त्रार्थसंग्रहम् ॥
1.94.m: likewise the various sciences were taught, which benefit all the world. / This Viṣṇupurāṇa is indeed a compendium of the meaning of all treatises;

1.94.s:
vārāhakalpavṛttāntaṃ vyāsena kathitaṃ tviha /
yo naraḥ paṭhate bhaktyā yaḥ śṛṇoti ca sādaram //
1.94.d:
वाराहकल्पवृत्तान्तं व्यासेन कथितं त्विह ।
यो नरः पठते भक्त्या यः शृणोति च सादरम् ॥
1.94.m: the account of the Vārāha Kalpa is told here by Vyāsa. / Whichsoever person recites it with devotion, and who listens with reverence,

1.94.s:
tāvubhau viṣṇulokaṃ hi vrajetāṃ bhuktabhogakau /
tallikhitvā ca yo dadyādāṣāḍhyāṃ ghṛtadhenunā //
1.94.d:
तावुभौ विष्णुलोकं हि व्रजेतां भुक्तभोगकौ ।
तल्लिखित्वा च यो दद्यादाषाढ्यां घृतधेनुना ॥
1.94.m: both of them, having enjoyed pleasures, shall indeed go to the world of Viṣṇu. / And whoever, having transcribed it, gives it on the full moon day of Āṣāḍha together with a cow made of clarified butter

1.94.s:
sahitaṃ viṇubhaktāya purāṇārthavidedvija /
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma vimānenārkavarcasā //
1.94.d:
सहितं विणुभक्ताय पुराणार्थविदेद्विज ।
स याति वैष्णवं धाम विमानेनार्कवर्चसा ॥
1.94.m: to a devotee of Viṣṇu, a twice-born who knows the meaning of the Purāṇa, / he goes to the realm of Viṣṇu in a chariot possessing the brilliance of the sun.

1.94.s:
yaśca viṣṇupurāṇasya samanukramaṇīṃ dvija /
kathayecchṛṇuyādvāpi sa purāṇaphalaṃ labhet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde viṣṇupurāṇānukramaṇīnirūpaṇaṃ nāma caturnavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.94.d:
यश्च विष्णुपुराणस्य समनुक्रमणीं द्विज ।
कथयेच्छृणुयाद्वापि स पुराणफलं लभेत् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे विष्णुपुराणानुक्रमणीनिरूपणं नाम चतुर्नवतितमो ऽध्यायः
1.94.m:
And the twice-born who recites or even listens to / this table of contents of the Viṣṇupurāṇa shall obtain the fruit of the Purāṇa.

Thus ends the ninety-fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Table of Contents of the Viṣṇupurāṇa', in the Fourth Quarter of the Great Narrative in the First Part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

1.95.s:
brahmovāca
śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ vāyavīyakam /
yasmiñcchrute labhaddhāma rudrasya paramātmanaḥ //
1.95.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
शृणु विप्र प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणं वायवीयकम् ।
यस्मिञ्च्छ्रुते लभद्धाम रुद्रस्य परमात्मनः ॥
1.95.m: Brahmā said: / Listen, O brāhmaṇa, I shall tell of the Purāṇa belonging to Vāyu, / on hearing which one obtains the realm of Rudra, the Supreme Self.

1.95.s:
caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ tatpurāṇaṃ prakīrtitam /
śvetakalpaprasaṃgena dharmānatrāha mārutaḥ //
1.95.d:
चतुर्विंशतिसाहस्रं तत्पुराणं प्रकीर्तितम् ।
श्वेतकल्पप्रसंगेन धर्मानत्राह मारुतः ॥
1.95.m: That Purāṇa is celebrated as consisting of twenty-four thousand [verses]. / In the context of the Śvetakalpa, the Wind here spoke of duties.

1.95.s:
tadbāyavīyanuditaṃ bhāgadvayasamanvitam /
sargādilakṣaṇaṃ yatra proktaṃ vipra savistaram //
1.95.d:
तद्बायवीयनुदितं भागद्वयसमन्वितम् ।
सर्गादिलक्षणं यत्र प्रोक्तं विप्र सविस्तरम् ॥
1.95.m: That Vāyavīya is declared as endowed with two parts, / in which the characteristics beginning with creation are expounded at length, O brāhmaṇa;

1.95.s:
manvantareṣu vaṃśāśca rājñāṃ ye yatra kīrtitāḥ /
gayāsurasya hananaṃ vistarādyatra kīrtitam //
1.95.d:
मन्वन्तरेषु वंशाश्च राज्ञां ये यत्र कीर्तिताः ।
गयासुरस्य हननं विस्तराद्यत्र कीर्तितम् ॥
1.95.m: and the lineages of kings in the Manvantaras which are celebrated therein; / wherein the slaying of the demon Gayāsura is celebrated in detail;

1.95.s:
māsānāṃ caiva māhātmyaṃ māghasyoktaṃ phalādhikam /
dānadharmā rājadharmā vistareṇoditā stathā //
1.95.d:
मासानां चैव माहात्म्यं माघस्योक्तं फलाधिकम् ।
दानधर्मा राजधर्मा विस्तरेणोदिता स्तथा ॥
1.95.m: The eulogy of the greatness of the months, and that of Māgha bringing greater fruit, / the duties of giving, and the duties of kings are also related in detail;

1.95.s:
bhūpātālakakubvyomacāriṇāṃ yatra nirṇayaḥ /
vratādīnāṃ ca pūrvo 'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ //
1.95.d:
भूपातालककुब्व्योमचारिणां यत्र निर्णयः ।
व्रतादीनां च पूर्वो ऽयं विभागः समुदाहृतः ॥
1.95.m: wherein is the determination concerning those moving on earth, in the netherworld, the quarters, and the sky, / and regarding vows and other rites: this first division is declared.

1.95.s:
uttare tasya bhāgetu narmadātīrthavarṇanam /
śivasya saṃhitoktā vai vistareṇa munīśvara //
1.95.d:
उत्तरे तस्य भागेतु नर्मदातीर्थवर्णनम् ।
शिवस्य संहितोक्ता वै विस्तरेण मुनीश्वर ॥
1.95.m: In its second part, however, is the description of the sacred fords of the Narmadā; / indeed, the Saṃhitā of Śiva is related in detail, O lord of sages.

1.95.s:
yo devaḥ sarvadevānāṃ durvijñeyaḥ sanātanaḥ /
sa tu sarvātmanā yasyāstīre tiṣṭhati saṃtatam //
1.95.d:
यो देवः सर्वदेवानां दुर्विज्ञेयः सनातनः ।
स तु सर्वात्मना यस्यास्तीरे तिष्ठति संततम् ॥
1.95.m: The eternal God who is difficult to be comprehended by all gods, / he, indeed, constantly dwells with all his soul on its riverbank.

1.95.s:
idaṃ brahmā hārīridaṃ sākṣāccedaṃ paro haraḥ /
idaṃ brahma nirākāraṃ kaivalyaṃ narmadājalam //
1.95.d:
इदं ब्रह्मा हारीरिदं साक्षाच्चेदं परो हरः ।
इदं ब्रह्म निराकारं कैवल्यं नर्मदाजलम् ॥
1.95.m: This is Brahmā, this is Hari, and this directly is supreme Hara; / this water of the Narmadā is formless Brahman, absolute liberation.

1.95.s:
dhruvaṃ lokahitārthāya śivena svaśarīrataḥ /
śaktiḥ kāpi saridṛpā reveyamavatāritā //
1.95.d:
ध्रुवं लोकहितार्थाय शिवेन स्वशरीरतः ।
शक्तिः कापि सरिदृपा रेवेयमवतारिता ॥
1.95.m: Truly, for the welfare of the world, Śiva brought down / from his own body this Revā, some supreme power in the form of a river.

1.95.s:
ye vasaṃtyuttare kūle rudrasyānucarā hi te /
vasaṃti yāmyatīre ye lokaṃ te yānti vaiṣṇavam //
1.95.d:
ये वसंत्युत्तरे कूले रुद्रस्यानुचरा हि ते ।
वसंति याम्यतीरे ये लोकं ते यान्ति वैष्णवम् ॥
1.95.m: Those who dwell on its northern bank are indeed followers of Rudra; / those who dwell on the southern riverbank go to the world of Viṣṇu.

1.95.s:
oṅkāreśvaramārabhyayāvatpaścimasāgaraḥ /
saṃgamāḥ pañca ca triṃśannadīnāṃ pāpanāśanī //
1.95.d:
ओङ्कारेश्वरमारभ्ययावत्पश्चिमसागरः ।
संगमाः पञ्च च त्रिंशन्नदीनां पापनाशनी ॥
1.95.m: Beginning from Oṅkāreśvara up to the western ocean, / there are thirty-five confluences of rivers, destroying sin;

1.95.s:
daśaikamuttare tīre trayoviṃśatirdakṣiṇe /
pañcatriṃśattamaḥ prokto revāsāgarasagamaḥ //
1.95.d:
दशैकमुत्तरे तीरे त्रयोविंशतिर्दक्षिणे ।
पञ्चत्रिंशत्तमः प्रोक्तो रेवासागरसगमः ॥
1.95.m: eleven on the northern riverbank, twenty-three on the southern, / and the confluence of the Revā with the ocean is declared the thirty-fifth.

1.95.s:
saṃgamaiḥ sahitānyeva revātīradvaye 'pi ca /
catuḥśatāni tīrthāni prasiddhāni ca saṃti hi //
1.95.d:
संगमैः सहितान्येव रेवातीरद्वये ऽपि च ।
चतुःशतानि तीर्थानि प्रसिद्धानि च संति हि ॥
1.95.m: Together with the confluences, on both riverbanks of the Revā / there are indeed four hundred well-known sacred fords;

1.95.s:
ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyo munīśvara /
saṃti cānyāni revāyāstīrayugme pade pade //
1.95.d:
षष्टितीर्थसहस्राणि षष्टिकोट्यो मुनीश्वर ।
संति चान्यानि रेवायास्तीरयुग्मे पदे पदे ॥
1.95.m: and sixty thousand and sixty crores of other sacred fords, O lord of sages, / exist at every step on the pair of riverbanks of the Revā.

1.95.s:
saṃhiteyaṃ mahāpuṇyā śivasya paramātmanaḥ /
narmadācaritaṃ yatra vāyunā parikīrtitam //
1.95.d:
संहितेयं महापुण्या शिवस्य परमात्मनः ।
नर्मदाचरितं यत्र वायुना परिकीर्तितम् ॥
1.95.m: This Saṃhitā of Śiva, the Supreme Self, is exceedingly meritorious, / wherein the account of the Narmadā is proclaimed by Vāyu.

1.95.s:
likhitvedaṃ purāṇaṃ tu guḍadhenusamanvitam /
śrāvaṇyāṃ yo dadedbhaktyā brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine //
1.95.d:
लिखित्वेदं पुराणं तु गुडधेनुसमन्वितम् ।
श्रावण्यां यो ददेद्भक्त्या ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने ॥
1.95.m: Having copied this Purāṇa together with a molasses cow, / whoever presents it with devotion to a householder brāhmaṇa on the Śrāvaṇī full-moon,

1.95.s:
rudraloke vasetso 'pi yāvadindrāścaturddaśa /
yaḥ śrāvayedvā śṛṇuyādvāyavīyamidaṃ naraḥ //
1.95.d:
रुद्रलोके वसेत्सो ऽपि यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्द्दश ।
यः श्रावयेद्वा शृणुयाद्वायवीयमिदं नरः ॥
1.95.m: he too shall dwell in the world of Rudra as long as fourteen Indras rule. / A man who recites or hears this Vāyavīya [Purāṇa],

1.95.s:
niyamena haviṣyāśī sa rudro nātra saṃśayaḥ /
yaścānukramaṇīmetāṃ śṛṇoti śrāvayettathā //
1.95.d:
नियमेन हविष्याशी स रुद्रो नात्र संशयः ।
यश्चानुक्रमणीमेतां शृणोति श्रावयेत्तथा ॥
1.95.m: observing a vow and eating sacrificial food, becomes Rudra; of this there is no doubt. / And whoever hears or recites this table of contents,

1.95.s:
so 'pi sarvapurāṇasya phalaṃ śravaṇajaṃ labhet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde vāyupurāṇānukramaṇīnirūpaṇaṃ nāma pañcanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.95.d:
सो ऽपि सर्वपुराणस्य फलं श्रवणजं लभेत् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे वायुपुराणानुक्रमणीनिरूपणं नाम पञ्चनवतितमो ऽध्यायः
1.95.m:
he too obtains the fruit arising from hearing all the Purāṇas.

Thus ends the ninety-fifth chapter, entitled 'Determination of the Table of Contents of the Vāyupurāṇa', in the fourth quarter in the Great Narrative of the First Part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

1.96.s:
brahmovāca
marīce śṛṇu vakṣyāmi vedavyāsena yatkṛtam /
śrīmadbhāgavataṃ nāma purāṇaṃ brahmasaṃmitam //
1.96.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
मरीचे शृणु वक्ष्यामि वेदव्यासेन यत्कृतम् ।
श्रीमद्भागवतं नाम पुराणं ब्रह्मसंमितम् ॥
1.96.m: Brahmā said: / O Marīci, listen, I shall speak of that which was composed by Vedavyāsa: / the Purāṇa named Śrīmad-Bhāgavata, equal to Brahman.

1.96.s:
tadaṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ kīrtitaṃ pāpanāśanam /
surapādaparūpo 'yaṃ skandhairdvādaśabhiryutaḥ //
1.96.d:
तदष्टादशसाहस्रं कीर्तितं पापनाशनम् ।
सुरपादपरूपो ऽयं स्कन्धैर्द्वादशभिर्युतः ॥
1.96.m: It is proclaimed to consist of eighteen thousand [verses], destroying sin; / it is in the form of the celestial tree, endowed with twelve cantos.

1.96.s:
bhagavāneva viprendra viśvarūpīsamīritaḥ /
tatra tu prathamaskandhe sūtarṣīṇāṃ samāgame //
1.96.d:
भगवानेव विप्रेन्द्र विश्वरूपीसमीरितः ।
तत्र तु प्रथमस्कन्धे सूतर्षीणां समागमे ॥
1.96.m: The Lord Himself, having the universal form, is declared [in it], O best of vipras. / There, in the first canto, at the gathering of Sūta and the sages,

1.96.s:
vyāsasya caritaṃ puṇyaṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ tathaiva ca /
parīkṣitamupākhyānamitīdaṃ samudāhṛtam //
1.96.d:
व्यासस्य चरितं पुण्यं पाण्डवानां तथैव च ।
परीक्षितमुपाख्यानमितीदं समुदाहृतम् ॥
1.96.m: the meritorious deeds of Vyāsa and likewise of the Pāṇḍavas, / and the narrative of Parīkṣit: thus is this recounted.

1.96.s:
parīkṣicchukasaṃvāde sṛṣṭidvayanirūpaṇam /
brahmanāradasaṃvāde devatācaritāmṛtam //
1.96.d:
परीक्षिच्छुकसंवादे सृष्टिद्वयनिरूपणम् ।
ब्रह्मनारदसंवादे देवताचरितामृतम् ॥
1.96.m: In the conversation between Parīkṣit and Śuka, the determination of the twofold creation [is told]; / in the conversation between Brahmā and Nārada, the nectar of the deeds of the deities,

1.96.s:
purāṇalakṣaṇaṃ caiva sṛṣṭikāraṇasaṃbhavaḥ /
dvitīyo 'yaṃ samuditaḥ skandho vyāsena dhīmatā //
1.96.d:
पुराणलक्षणं चैव सृष्टिकारणसंभवः ।
द्वितीयो ऽयं समुदितः स्कन्धो व्यासेन धीमता ॥
1.96.m: and the characteristics of a Purāṇa, and the origin of the cause of creation: / this second canto was declared by the wise Vyāsa.

1.96.s:
caritaṃ vidurasyātha maitreyeṇāsya saṃgamaḥ /
sṛṣṭiprakaraṇaṃ paścādbahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ //
1.96.d:
चरितं विदुरस्याथ मैत्रेयेणास्य संगमः ।
सृष्टिप्रकरणं पश्चाद्बह्मणः परमात्मनः ॥
1.96.m: Then the deeds of Vidura, his meeting with Maitreya, / thereafter the section on creation by Brahmā, the Supreme Self,

1.96.s:
kāpilaṃ sāṃkhyamapyatra tṛtīyo 'yamudāhṛtaḥ /
satyāścaritamādau tu dhruvasya caritaṃ tataḥ //
1.96.d:
कापिलं सांख्यमप्यत्र तृतीयो ऽयमुदाहृतः ।
सत्याश्चरितमादौ तु ध्रुवस्य चरितं ततः ॥
1.96.m: and here also the Sāṃkhya of Kapila: this third [canto] is recounted. / First the deeds of Satī, then the deeds of Dhruva,

1.96.s:
pṛthoḥ puṇyasamākhyānaṃ tataḥ prācīnabarhiṣam /
ityeṣa turyo gadito visarge skandha uttamaḥ //
1.96.d:
पृथोः पुण्यसमाख्यानं ततः प्राचीनबर्हिषम् ।
इत्येष तुर्यो गदितो विसर्गे स्कन्ध उत्तमः ॥
1.96.m: the meritorious narration of Pṛthu, and then of Prācīnabarhis: / thus this excellent fourth canto is proclaimed regarding secondary creation.

1.96.s:
priyavratasya caritaṃ tadvaṃśyānāṃ ca puṇyadam /
brahmāṇḍāntargatānāṃ ca lokānāṃ varṇanaṃ tataḥ //
1.96.d:
प्रियव्रतस्य चरितं तद्वंश्यानां च पुण्यदम् ।
ब्रह्माण्डान्तर्गतानां च लोकानां वर्णनं ततः ॥
1.96.m: The deeds of Priyavrata and of his descendants, granting merit, / then the description of the worlds contained within the cosmic egg,

1.96.s:
narakasthitirityeṣa saṃsthāne pañcamo mataḥ /
ajāmilasya caritaṃ dakṣasṛṣṭinirūpaṇam //
1.96.d:
नरकस्थितिरित्येष संस्थाने पञ्चमो मतः ।
अजामिलस्य चरितं दक्षसृष्टिनिरूपणम् ॥
1.96.m: and the state of hells: thus this fifth [canto] is held to concern the cosmic structure. / The account of Ajāmila, the determination of the creation by Dakṣa,

1.96.s:
vṛtrākhyānaṃ tataḥ paścānmarutāṃ janma puṇyadam /
ṣaṣṭho 'yamuditaḥ skandhovyāsena paripoṣaṇe //
1.96.d:
वृत्राख्यानं ततः पश्चान्मरुतां जन्म पुण्यदम् ।
षष्ठो ऽयमुदितः स्कन्धोव्यासेन परिपोषणे ॥
1.96.m: then after that the narrative of Vṛtra, and the merit-granting birth of the Maruts: / this sixth canto was spoken by Vyāsa concerning preservation.

1.96.s:
prahlādacaritaṃ puṇyaṃ varṇāśramanirūpaṇam /
saptamo gadito vatsa vāsanākarmakīrtane //
1.96.d:
प्रह्लादचरितं पुण्यं वर्णाश्रमनिरूपणम् ।
सप्तमो गदितो वत्स वासनाकर्मकीर्तने ॥
1.96.m: The meritorious deed of Prahlāda, the determination of the social classes and stages of life: / the seventh [canto] is proclaimed, my child, in the description of latent impressions and actions.

1.96.s:
gajendramokṣaṇākhyānaṃ manvantaranirūpaṇe /
samudramathanaṃ caiva balivaibhavabandhanam //
1.96.d:
गजेन्द्रमोक्षणाख्यानं मन्वन्तरनिरूपणे ।
समुद्रमथनं चैव बलिवैभवबन्धनम् ॥
1.96.m: The story of the liberation of Gajendra in the determination of the world-periods, / the churning of the ocean, the grandeur and binding of Bali,

1.96.s:
matsyāktāracaritamaṣṭamo 'yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ /
sūryavaṃśasamākhyānaṃ somavaṃśanirūpaṇam //
1.96.d:
मत्स्याक्तारचरितमष्टमो ऽयं प्रकीर्तितः ।
सूर्यवंशसमाख्यानं सोमवंशनिरूपणम् ॥
1.96.m: and the deeds of the Fish incarnation: this eighth [canto] is proclaimed. / The narration of the Solar Dynasty, the determination of the Lunar Dynasty,

1.96.s:
vaṃśyānucarite prokto navamo 'yaṃ mahāmate /
kṛṣṇasya bālacaritaṃ kaumāraṃ ca vrajasthitiḥ //
1.96.d:
वंश्यानुचरिते प्रोक्तो नवमो ऽयं महामते ।
कृष्णस्य बालचरितं कौमारं च व्रजस्थितिः ॥
1.96.m: in the description of royal lineages: this ninth [canto] is declared, O highly intelligent one. / The childhood deeds of Kṛṣṇa, and boyhood and dwelling in Vraja,

1.96.s:
kaiśoraṃ mathurāsthānaṃ yauvanaṃ dvārakāsthitiḥ /
bhūbhāraharaṇaṃ cātra nirodhe daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ //
1.96.d:
कैशोरं मथुरास्थानं यौवनं द्वारकास्थितिः ।
भूभारहरणं चात्र निरोधे दशमः स्मृतः ॥
1.96.m: adolescence and dwelling in Mathurā, youth and dwelling in Dvārakā, / and the removal of the earth's burden: here the tenth [canto] is taught concerning withdrawal.

1.96.s:
nāradena tu saṃvādo vasudevasya kīrtitaḥ /
yadośca dattātreyeṇa śrīkṛṣṇonoddhavasya ca //
1.96.d:
नारदेन तु संवादो वसुदेवस्य कीर्तितः ।
यदोश्च दत्तात्रेयेण श्रीकृष्णोनोद्धवस्य च ॥
1.96.m: The dialogue of Vasudeva with Nārada is related, / and of Yadu with Dattātreya, and of glorious Kṛṣṇa with Uddhava,

1.96.s:
yādavānāṃ mithontaśca muktāvekādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ /
bhaviṣyakalinirddeśo mokṣo rājñaḥ parīkṣitaḥ //
1.96.d:
यादवानां मिथोन्तश्च मुक्तावेकादशः स्मृतः ।
भविष्यकलिनिर्द्देशो मोक्षो राज्ञः परीक्षितः ॥
1.96.m: and the mutual end of the Yādavas: the eleventh [canto] is taught concerning liberation. / The mention of the future Kali age, the liberation of King Parīkṣit,

1.96.s:
vedaśākhāpraṇayanaṃ mārkaṇḍeyatapaḥkriyā /
saurī vibhūtiruditā sātvatī ca tataḥ param //
1.96.d:
वेदशाखाप्रणयनं मार्कण्डेयतपःक्रिया ।
सौरी विभूतिरुदिता सात्वती च ततः परम् ॥
1.96.m: the compilation of the Vedic branches, the ascetic practice of Mārkaṇḍeya, / the solar majesty is declared, and beyond that the majesty of the Sātvatas,

1.96.s:
purāṇasaṃkhyākathanamāśraye dvādaśo hyayam /
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa śrīmadbhāgavataṃ tava //
1.96.d:
पुराणसंख्याकथनमाश्रये द्वादशो ह्ययम् ।
इत्येवं कथितं वत्स श्रीमद्भागवतं तव ॥
1.96.m: and the narration of the number of verses of the Purāṇas: this twelfth [canto] is in the category of ultimate refuge. / Thus, my child, has the Śrīmad-Bhāgavata been related to you;

1.96.s:
vaktuḥ śrotuścopadeṣṭuranumoditureva ca /
sāhāyyakarturgaditaṃ bhaktibhuktivimuktidam //
1.96.d:
वक्तुः श्रोतुश्चोपदेष्टुरनुमोदितुरेव च ।
साहाय्यकर्तुर्गदितं भक्तिभुक्तिविमुक्तिदम् ॥
1.96.m: for the speaker, the hearer, the instructor, the approver, / and the assistant, it is declared to bestow devotion, enjoyment, and liberation.

1.96.s:
prauṣṭhapadyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ hemasiṃhasamanvitam /
deyaṃ bhāgavatāyedaṃ dvijāyaprītipūrvakam //
1.96.d:
प्रौष्ठपद्यां पूर्णिमायां हेमसिंहसमन्वितम् ।
देयं भागवतायेदं द्विजायप्रीतिपूर्वकम् ॥
1.96.m: On the full-moon day of Prauṣṭhapada, together with a golden lion-throne, / this should be given with love to a brāhmaṇa who is a devotee of the Lord,

1.96.s:
saṃpūjya vastrahemādyairbhagavadbhaktimicchatā /
yo 'pyanukramaṇīmetāṃ śrāvayecchṛṇuyāttathā /
sa purāṇaśravaṇajaṃ prāpnoti phalamuttamam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde śrīmadbhāgavatānukramaṇīnirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.96.d:
संपूज्य वस्त्रहेमाद्यैर्भगवद्भक्तिमिच्छता ।
यो ऽप्यनुक्रमणीमेतां श्रावयेच्छृणुयात्तथा ।
स पुराणश्रवणजं प्राप्नोति फलमुत्तमम् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे श्रीमद्भागवतानुक्रमणीनिरूपणं नाम षण्णवतितमो ऽध्यायः
1.96.m:
having worshipped it with garments, gold, and other gifts, by one desiring devotion to the Lord. / Whoever also recites or hears this table of contents / obtains the supreme fruit arising from hearing the Purāṇa.

Thus ends the ninety-sixth chapter, entitled 'Determination of the Table of Contents of the Śrīmad-Bhāgavata', in the fourth quarter in the Great Narrative of the First Part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

1.97.s:
śrībrahmovāca
śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ nāradīyakam /
pañcaviṃśatisāhasraṃ bṛhatkalpakathāśrayam //
1.97.d:
श्रीब्रह्मोवाच
शृणु विप्र प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणं नारदीयकम् ।
पञ्चविंशतिसाहस्रं बृहत्कल्पकथाश्रयम् ॥
1.97.m: The glorious Brahmā said: / Listen, O vipra, I shall speak of the Nāradīya Purāṇa, / consisting of twenty-five thousand [verses], based on the stories of the Bṛhat-kalpa.

1.97.s:
sūtaśaunakasaṃvādaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃkṣepavarṇanam /
nānādharmakathāḥ puṇyāḥ pravṛtte samudāhṛtāḥ //
1.97.d:
सूतशौनकसंवादः सृष्टिसंक्षेपवर्णनम् ।
नानाधर्मकथाः पुण्याः प्रवृत्ते समुदाहृताः ॥
1.97.m: The dialogue between Sūta and Śaunaka, a brief description of creation, / and stories of various meritorious duties are related in the course [of it]

1.97.s:
prāgbhāge prathame pāde sanakena mahātmanā /
dvitīye mokṣadharmākhye mokṣopāyanirūpaṇam //
1.97.d:
प्राग्भागे प्रथमे पादे सनकेन महात्मना ।
द्वितीये मोक्षधर्माख्ये मोक्षोपायनिरूपणम् ॥
1.97.m: in the first quarter of the first part, by the great-souled Sanaka; / in the second [quarter] named Mokṣadharma, the determination of the means to liberation,

1.97.s:
vedāṅgānāṃ ca kathanaṃ śukotpattiśca vistarāt /
sanandanena gaditā nāradāya mahātmane //
1.97.d:
वेदाङ्गानां च कथनं शुकोत्पत्तिश्च विस्तरात् ।
सनन्दनेन गदिता नारदाय महात्मने ॥
1.97.m: the teaching of the auxiliary limbs of the Veda, and the birth of Śuka in detail / were related by Sanandana to the great-souled Nārada.

1.97.s:
mahātantre samuddiṣṭaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam /
mantrāṇāṃ śodhanaṃ dīkṣāmantroddhāraśca pūjanam //
1.97.d:
महातन्त्रे समुद्दिष्टं पशुपाशविमोक्षणम् ।
मन्त्राणां शोधनं दीक्षामन्त्रोद्धारश्च पूजनम् ॥
1.97.m: In the Great Tantra, the liberation of the bound soul from bondage is set forth: / the purification of mantras, initiation, the extraction of mantras, and worship,

1.97.s:
prayogāḥ kavacaṃ nāmasahasraṃ stotrameva ca /
gaṇeśasūryaviṣṇūnāṃ śivaśaktyoranukramāt //
1.97.d:
प्रयोगाः कवचं नामसहस्रं स्तोत्रमेव च ।
गणेशसूर्यविष्णूनां शिवशक्त्योरनुक्रमात् ॥
1.97.m: ritual applications, the armor, the thousand names, and the hymn of praise, / of Gaṇeśa, the Sun, and Viṣṇu, and of Śiva and the Śakti in due order.

1.97.s:
sanatkumāramuninā nāradāya tṛtīyake /
purāṇalakṣaṇaṃ caiva pramāṇaṃ dānameva ca //
1.97.d:
सनत्कुमारमुनिना नारदाय तृतीयके ।
पुराणलक्षणं चैव प्रमाणं दानमेव च ॥
1.97.m: By the sage Sanatkumāra to Nārada, in the third [quarter], / the characteristics of the Purāṇas, their extent, and gift-giving,

1.97.s:
pṛthakpṛthak samuddiṣṭaṃ dānakālapuraḥsaram /
caitrādisarvamāseṣu tithīnāñcapṛthakpṛthak //
1.97.d:
पृथक्पृथक् समुद्दिष्टं दानकालपुरःसरम् ।
चैत्रादिसर्वमासेषु तिथीनाञ्चपृथक्पृथक् ॥
1.97.m: were individually set forth, along with the proper times for gift-giving, / and individually for the lunar days across all months starting with Caitra.

1.97.s:
proktaṃ pratipadādīnāṃ vrataṃ sarvāghanāśanam /
sanātanena muninā nāradāya caturthake //
1.97.d:
प्रोक्तं प्रतिपदादीनां व्रतं सर्वाघनाशनम् ।
सनातनेन मुनिना नारदाय चतुर्थके ॥
1.97.m: The vow for Pratipad and the other [lunar days], destroying all sins, was proclaimed. / By the sage Sanātana to Nārada, in the fourth [quarter],

1.97.s:
pūrvabhāgo 'yamudito bṛhadākhyānasaṃjñitaḥ /
asyottare vibhāge tu praśna ekādaśīvrate //
1.97.d:
पूर्वभागो ऽयमुदितो बृहदाख्यानसंज्ञितः ।
अस्योत्तरे विभागे तु प्रश्न एकादशीव्रते ॥
1.97.m: this earlier section (Pūrvabhāga), designated the 'Great Narrative' (Bṛhadākhyāna), was declared. / But in its later section (Uttarabhāga), there is the inquiry into the Ekādaśī vow,

1.97.s:
vasiṣṭhenātha saṃvādo māndhātuḥ parikīrtitaḥ /
rukmāṅgadakathā puṇyāmohinyutpattikarma ca //
1.97.d:
वसिष्ठेनाथ संवादो मान्धातुः परिकीर्तितः ।
रुक्माङ्गदकथा पुण्यामोहिन्युत्पत्तिकर्म च ॥
1.97.m: and then the dialogue between Vasiṣṭha and Māndhātṛ is recounted; / the holy story of Rukmāṅgada and the act of Mohinī's creation;

1.97.s:
vasuśāpaśca mohinyai paścāduddharaṇakriyā /
gaṅgākathā puṇyatamā gayāyātrānukīrtanam //
1.97.d:
वसुशापश्च मोहिन्यै पश्चादुद्धरणक्रिया ।
गङ्गाकथा पुण्यतमा गयायात्रानुकीर्तनम् ॥
1.97.m: and the Vasus' curse upon Mohinī, and afterwards the act of her deliverance; / the most holy story of the Gaṅgā, and the recitation of the pilgrimage to Gayā;

1.97.s:
kāśyā māhātmyamatulaṃ puruṣottamavarṇanam /
yātrāvidhānaṃ kṣetrasya bahvākhyānasamanvitam //
1.97.d:
काश्या माहात्म्यमतुलं पुरुषोत्तमवर्णनम् ।
यात्राविधानं क्षेत्रस्य बह्वाख्यानसमन्वितम् ॥
1.97.m: the matchless eulogy of the greatness of Kāśī; the description of Puruṣottama; / the procedure for pilgrimage to the sacred field, accompanied by many narratives;

1.97.s:
prayāgasyātha māhātmyaṃ kurukṣetrasya tatparam /
haridvārasya cākhyānaṃ kāmodākhyānakaṃ tathā //
1.97.d:
प्रयागस्याथ माहात्म्यं कुरुक्षेत्रस्य तत्परम् ।
हरिद्वारस्य चाख्यानं कामोदाख्यानकं तथा ॥
1.97.m: and then the eulogy of the greatness of Prayāga; next to that, of Kurukṣetra; / the narrative of Haridvāra, and likewise the narrative of Kāmodā;

1.97.s:
badarītīrthamāhātmyaṃ kāmākṣāyāstathaiva ca /
prabhāsasya ca māhātmyaṃ puṣkarākhyānakaṃ tataḥ //
1.97.d:
बदरीतीर्थमाहात्म्यं कामाक्षायास्तथैव च ।
प्रभासस्य च माहात्म्यं पुष्कराख्यानकं ततः ॥
1.97.m: the eulogy of the greatness of the sacred ford of Badarī, and likewise of Kāmākṣā; / and the eulogy of the greatness of Prabhāsa; next, the narrative of Puṣkara;

1.97.s:
gautamākhyānakaṃ paścādvedapādastavastataḥ /
gokarṇakṣetramāhātmyaṃ lakṣmaṇākhyānakaṃ tathā //
1.97.d:
गौतमाख्यानकं पश्चाद्वेदपादस्तवस्ततः ।
गोकर्णक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यं लक्ष्मणाख्यानकं तथा ॥
1.97.m: afterwards the narrative of Gautama; then the hymn of praise on the feet of the Veda; / the eulogy of the greatness of the sacred field of Gokarṇa, and likewise the narrative of Lakṣmaṇa;

1.97.s:
setumāhātmyakathanaṃ narmadātīrthavarṇanam /
avantyāścaiva māhātmyaṃ madhurāyāstataḥ param //
1.97.d:
सेतुमाहात्म्यकथनं नर्मदातीर्थवर्णनम् ।
अवन्त्याश्चैव माहात्म्यं मधुरायास्ततः परम् ॥
1.97.m: the recitation of the eulogy of the greatness of Setu; the description of the sacred ford of the Narmadā; / the eulogy of the greatness of Avantī, and next to that, of Madhurā;

1.97.s:
bṛndāvanasya mahimā paśorbrahmāntike gatiḥ /
mohinīcaritaṃ paścādevaṃ paścādevaṃ vai nāradīyakam //
1.97.d:
बृन्दावनस्य महिमा पशोर्ब्रह्मान्तिके गतिः ।
मोहिनीचरितं पश्चादेवं पश्चादेवं वै नारदीयकम् ॥
1.97.m: the majesty of Bṛndāvana; the animal's going to Brahmā's presence; / afterwards the story of Mohinī—such is the Nāradīya Purāṇa.

1.97.s:
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyāśrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ /
sa yāti brahmaṇo dhāma nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
1.97.d:
यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्याश्रावयेद्वा समाहितः ।
स याति ब्रह्मणो धाम नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
1.97.m: The man who hears it with devotion, or recites it with concentrated mind, / goes to the abode of Brahmā; no doubt need be entertained here.

1.97.s:
yastvetadiṣupūrṇāyāṃ dhenūnāṃ saptakānvitam /
pradadyāddijarṃyāya saṃlabhenmokṣameva ca //
1.97.d:
यस्त्वेतदिषुपूर्णायां धेनूनां सप्तकान्वितम् ।
प्रदद्याद्दिजर्ंयाय संलभेन्मोक्षमेव च ॥
1.97.m: Whoever should give this [book] along with seven cows on the full moon of Āśvina / to an eminent twice-born man shall attain liberation.

1.97.s:
yaścānukramaṇīmetāṃ nāradīyasya varṇayet /
śṛṇuyadvaikacittena so 'pi svargagatiṃ labhet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde nāradīyapurāṇānukramaṇīkathanaṃ nāma saptanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.97.d:
यश्चानुक्रमणीमेतां नारदीयस्य वर्णयेत् ।
शृणुयद्वैकचित्तेन सो ऽपि स्वर्गगतिं लभेत् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे नारदीयपुराणानुक्रमणीकथनं नाम सप्तनवतितमो ऽध्यायः
1.97.m:
And whoever should recount this table of contents of the Nāradīya / or hear it with single-minded focus, he too shall attain the celestial realm.

Thus ends the ninety-seventh chapter, entitled 'Recitation of the Table of Contents of the Nāradīya Purāṇa', in the fourth quarter in the Great Narrative of the earlier section (Pūrvabhāga) of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

1.98.s:
śrībrahmovāca
atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi mārkaṇḍeyābhidhaṃ mune /
purāṇaṃ sumahatpuṇyaṃ paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sadā //
1.98.d:
श्रीब्रह्मोवाच
अथ ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि मार्कण्डेयाभिधं मुने ।
पुराणं सुमहत्पुण्यं पठतां शृण्वतां सदा ॥
1.98.m: The glorious Brahmā said: / Now I shall thoroughly proclaim to you, O sage, that named Mārkaṇḍeya, / a Purāṇa of very great merit for those who always read and hear [it].
Where, taking birds as the authority, the determination of all duty is set forth: / that Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa is declared to have nine thousand [verses].

1.98.s:
mārkaṇḍeyamuneḥ praśno jaimineḥ prāksamīritaḥ /
pakṣiṇāṃ dharmasaṃjñānaṃ tato janmanirūpaṇam //
1.98.d:
मार्कण्डेयमुनेः प्रश्नो जैमिनेः प्राक्समीरितः ।
पक्षिणां धर्मसंज्ञानं ततो जन्मनिरूपणम् ॥
1.98.m: First is stated the question of the sage Jaimini to the sage Mārkaṇḍeya; / the birds' knowledge of duty, and then the description of their birth;

1.98.s:
pūrvajanmakathā caiṣāṃ vikriyā cā divaspateḥ /
tīrthayātrā balasyātha draupadeyakathānakam //
1.98.d:
पूर्वजन्मकथा चैषां विक्रिया चा दिवस्पतेः ।
तीर्थयात्रा बलस्याथ द्रौपदेयकथानकम् ॥
1.98.m: and the story of their previous births; and the perturbation of Indra; / then Bala's pilgrimage to sacred fords; the narrative of the sons of Draupadī;

1.98.s:
hariścandrakathā puṇyā yuddhamāḍībakābhidham /
pitāputrasamākhyānaṃ dattātreyakatha tataḥ //
1.98.d:
हरिश्चन्द्रकथा पुण्या युद्धमाडीबकाभिधम् ।
पितापुत्रसमाख्यानं दत्तात्रेयकथ ततः ॥
1.98.m: the holy story of Hariścandra; the battle named after the Āḍi and Baka [birds]; / the dialogue between father and son; then the story of Dattātreya;

1.98.s:
haihasasyātha caritaṃ mahākhyānasamanvitam /
madālakasākathā proktā hyalarkacaritānvitā //
1.98.d:
हैहसस्याथ चरितं महाख्यानसमन्वितम् ।
मदालकसाकथा प्रोक्ता ह्यलर्कचरितान्विता ॥
1.98.m: then the life of Haihaya, accompanied by a great narrative; / the story of Madālasā is related, along with the deeds of Alarka;
the holy recitation of creation, proclaimed to be ninefold; / the specification of the time of the end of the kalpa; the description of the creation of Yakṣas;

1.98.s:
rudrādisṛṣṭirapyuktā dvīpacaryānukīrtanam /
manūnāṃ ca kathā nānākīrtitāḥ pāpahārikāḥ //
1.98.d:
रुद्रादिसृष्टिरप्युक्ता द्वीपचर्यानुकीर्तनम् ।
मनूनां च कथा नानाकीर्तिताः पापहारिकाः ॥
1.98.m: the creation of Rudra and the others is also told; the recitation of the courses of the continents; / and the diverse stories of the Manus are related, which take away sins;

1.98.s:
tāsu durgākathātyantaṃ puṇyadā cāṣṭameṃ'tare /
tatpaścātpraṇavotpattistrayītejaḥ samudbhavā //
1.98.d:
तासु दुर्गाकथात्यन्तं पुण्यदा चाष्टमेंऽतरे ।
तत्पश्चात्प्रणवोत्पत्तिस्त्रयीतेजः समुद्भवा ॥
1.98.m: among them, the exceedingly merit-granting story of Durgā in the eighth Manvantara; / after that, the origin of the Praṇava, arising from the splendour of the three Vedas;

1.98.s:
mārtaṇḍasya ca janmākhyātanmāhātmyasamanvitā /
vaivasvatānvayaścāpi vatsaprīścaritaṃ tataḥ //
1.98.d:
मार्तण्डस्य च जन्माख्यातन्माहात्म्यसमन्विता ।
वैवस्वतान्वयश्चापि वत्सप्रीश्चरितं ततः ॥
1.98.m: the birth of Mārtaṇḍa is told, accompanied by his eulogy of greatness; / and also the lineage of Vaivasvata; then the deed of Vatsaprī;

1.98.s:
khanitrasya tataḥ proktā kathā puṇyā mahātmanaḥ /
avikṣiccaritaṃ caiva kimicchavratakīrttanam //
1.98.d:
खनित्रस्य ततः प्रोक्ता कथा पुण्या महात्मनः ।
अविक्षिच्चरितं चैव किमिच्छव्रतकीर्त्तनम् ॥
1.98.m: then the holy story of the great-souled Khanitra is related; / and the deeds of Avikṣit; the recitation of the Kimiccha vow;

1.98.s:
nariṣyantasya caritaṃ ikṣvākucaritaṃ tataḥ /
nalasya caritaṃ paścādrāmacandrasya satkathā //
1.98.d:
नरिष्यन्तस्य चरितं इक्ष्वाकुचरितं ततः ।
नलस्य चरितं पश्चाद्रामचन्द्रस्य सत्कथा ॥
1.98.m: the deeds of Nariṣyanta; then the deeds of Ikṣvāku; / afterwards the deeds of Nala; the true story of Rāmacandra;

1.98.s:
kuśavaṃśasamākhyānaṃ somavaṃśānukīrttanam /
pururavaḥ kathā puṇyā nahuṣasya kathādbhutā //
1.98.d:
कुशवंशसमाख्यानं सोमवंशानुकीर्त्तनम् ।
पुरुरवः कथा पुण्या नहुषस्य कथाद्भुता ॥
1.98.m: the account of Kuśa's lineage; the recitation of the Lunar lineage; / the holy story of Purūravas; the wondrous story of Nahuṣa;

1.98.s:
yayāticaritaṃ puṇyaṃ yaduvaṃśānukīrttanam /
śrīkṛṣṇabālacaritaṃ māthuraṃ caritaṃ tataḥ //
1.98.d:
ययातिचरितं पुण्यं यदुवंशानुकीर्त्तनम् ।
श्रीकृष्णबालचरितं माथुरं चरितं ततः ॥
1.98.m: the holy deeds of Yayāti; the recitation of the Yadu lineage; / the childhood deeds of glorious Kṛṣṇa; then the deeds in Mathurā;

1.98.s:
dvārakācaritaṃ cātha kathā sarvāvatārajā /
tataḥ sāṃkhyasamuddeśaḥ prapañcāsattvakīrtanam //
1.98.d:
द्वारकाचरितं चाथ कथा सर्वावतारजा ।
ततः सांख्यसमुद्देशः प्रपञ्चासत्त्वकीर्तनम् ॥
1.98.m: and then the deeds in Dvārakā; the stories arising from all the incarnations; / then the exposition of Sāṃkhya; the recitation of the unreality of phenomenal existence;

1.98.s:
mārkaṇḍeyasya caritaṃ purāṇaśravaṇe phalam /
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā purāṇamidamādarāt //
1.98.d:
मार्कण्डेयस्य चरितं पुराणश्रवणे फलम् ।
यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या पुराणमिदमादरात् ॥
1.98.m: the life of Mārkaṇḍeya; the fruit of hearing the Purāṇa. / The person who hears this Purāṇa with devotion and reverence,

1.98.s:
mārkaṇḍeyābhidhaṃ vatsa sa labhetparamāṃ gatim /
yastu vyākurute caitacchaivaṃ sa labhate padam //
1.98.d:
मार्कण्डेयाभिधं वत्स स लभेत्परमां गतिम् ।
यस्तु व्याकुरुते चैतच्छैवं स लभते पदम् ॥
1.98.m: named Mārkaṇḍeya, O dear one, shall attain the supreme goal. / And he who expounds this attains the abode of Śiva.

1.98.s:
tatprayacchellikhitvā yaḥ sauvarṇakarisaṃyutam /
kārtikyāṃ dvijavaryāya sa labhendbrahmaṇaḥ padam //
1.98.d:
तत्प्रयच्छेल्लिखित्वा यः सौवर्णकरिसंयुतम् ।
कार्तिक्यां द्विजवर्याय स लभेन्द्ब्रह्मणः पदम् ॥
1.98.m: Whoever, having written it out, should give it with a golden elephant / to an eminent twice-born on the full moon of Kārttika shall attain the abode of Brahmā.

1.98.s:
śṛṇoti śrāvayedvāpi yaścānukramaṇīmimām /
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇasya sa labhedvāñchitaṃ phalam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇānukramaṇīnirūpaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.98.d:
शृणोति श्रावयेद्वापि यश्चानुक्रमणीमिमाम् ।
मार्कण्डेयपुराणस्य स लभेद्वाञ्छितं फलम् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे मार्कण्डेयपुराणानुक्रमणीनिरूपणं नामाष्टनवतितमो ऽध्यायः
1.98.m:
And whoever hears or recites this table of contents / of the Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa shall obtain his desired fruit.

Thus ends the ninety-eighth chapter, entitled 'Determination of the Table of Contents of the Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa', in the fourth quarter in the Great Narrative of the earlier section (Pūrvabhāga) of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

1.99.s:
śrībrahmovāca
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tavāgneyapurāṇakam /
īśānakalpavṛttāntaṃ vasiṣṭhāyānalo 'bravīt //
1.99.d:
श्रीब्रह्मोवाच
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि तवाग्नेयपुराणकम् ।
ईशानकल्पवृत्तान्तं वसिष्ठायानलो ऽब्रवीत् ॥
1.99.m: The glorious Brahmā said: / Now, from this point, I shall proclaim to you the Āgneya Purāṇa; / Agni related the events of the Īśāna Kalpa to Vasiṣṭha.

1.99.s:
tatpañcadaśasāhasraṃ nānā caritamadbhutam /
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇām //
1.99.d:
तत्पञ्चदशसाहस्रं नाना चरितमद्भुतम् ।
पठतां शृण्वतां चैव सर्वपापहरं नृणाम् ॥
1.99.m: It consists of fifteen thousand [verses], containing diverse wondrous deeds, / and removes all sins of men who read and hear it.

1.99.s:
praśnaḥ pūrvaṃ purāṇasya kathā sarvāvatārajā /
sṛṣṭiprakaraṇaṃ cātha viṣṇupūjādikaṃ tataḥ //
1.99.d:
प्रश्नः पूर्वं पुराणस्य कथा सर्वावतारजा ।
सृष्टिप्रकरणं चाथ विष्णुपूजादिकं ततः ॥
1.99.m: First is the inquiry of the Purāṇa; the stories arising from all the incarnations; / then the section on creation; after that, the worship of Viṣṇu and other rites;

1.99.s:
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ paścānmantramudrādilakṣaṇam /
sarvadīkṣāvidhānaṃ ca abhiṣekanirūpaṇam //
1.99.d:
अग्निकार्यं ततः पश्चान्मन्त्रमुद्रादिलक्षणम् ।
सर्वदीक्षाविधानं च अभिषेकनिरूपणम् ॥
1.99.m: afterwards the fire-ritual; the characteristics of mantras, mudrās, and so forth; / the rules for all initiations; the description of consecration (abhiṣeka);

1.99.s:
lakṣaṇaṃ maṇḍalādīnāṃ kuśāpāmārjanaṃ tataḥ /
pavitrāropaṇavidhirdevālayavidhistataḥ //
1.99.d:
लक्षणं मण्डलादीनां कुशापामार्जनं ततः ।
पवित्रारोपणविधिर्देवालयविधिस्ततः ॥
1.99.m: the characteristics of sacred diagrams and the like; then cleansing with kuśa grass and water; / the rule for presenting the sacred thread (pavitrāropaṇa); then the rule for temples;

1.99.s:
śālagrāmādipūjā ca mūrtilakṣma pṛthakpṛthak /
nyāsādīnāṃ vidhānaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpūrtakaṃ tataḥ //
1.99.d:
शालग्रामादिपूजा च मूर्तिलक्ष्म पृथक्पृथक् ।
न्यासादीनां विधानं च प्रतिष्ठापूर्तकं ततः ॥
1.99.m: worship of the Śālagrāma and so forth; the specific marks of idols individually; / the rules for ritual placement and others; then the consecration and public works;

1.99.s:
vināyakādipūjā ca nānādīkṣāvidhiḥ param /
pratiṣṭhā sarvadevānāṃ brahmaṇḍasya nirūpaṇam //
1.99.d:
विनायकादिपूजा च नानादीक्षाविधिः परम् ।
प्रतिष्ठा सर्वदेवानां ब्रह्मण्डस्य निरूपणम् ॥
1.99.m: and worship of Vināyaka and others; beyond that, rules for diverse initiations; / consecration of all deities; description of the cosmic egg;

1.99.s:
gaṅgāditīrthamāhātmyaṃ dvīpavarṣānuvarṇanam /
ūrddhvādholokaracanā jyotiścakranirūpaṇam //
1.99.d:
गङ्गादितीर्थमाहात्म्यं द्वीपवर्षानुवर्णनम् ।
ऊर्द्ध्वाधोलोकरचना ज्योतिश्चक्रनिरूपणम् ॥
1.99.m: eulogy of the greatness of the Gaṅgā and other sacred fords; detailed description of continents and realms; / arrangement of the upper and lower worlds; description of the zodiacal sphere;

1.99.s:
jyotiṣaṃ ca tataḥ proktaṃ śāstraṃ yuddhajayārṇavam /
ṣaṭkarma ca tataḥ proktaṃ mantramantrauṣadhīgaṇaḥ //
1.99.d:
ज्योतिषं च ततः प्रोक्तं शास्त्रं युद्धजयार्णवम् ।
षट्कर्म च ततः प्रोक्तं मन्त्रमन्त्रौषधीगणः ॥
1.99.m: and then astronomy/astrology is declared; the treatise named Yuddhājayārṇava; / then the six magical acts are declared; the groups of mantras and medicinal herbs;

1.99.s:
kubjikādisamarcatvaṃ ṣoḍhā nyāsavidhistathā /
koṭihomavidhānaṃ ca manvantaranirūpaṇam //
1.99.d:
कुब्जिकादिसमर्चत्वं षोढा न्यासविधिस्तथा ।
कोटिहोमविधानं च मन्वन्तरनिरूपणम् ॥
1.99.m: the worship of Kubjikā and others; likewise the rule for the sixfold ritual placement; / the procedure for the offering of ten million oblations; description of the Manvantaras;

1.99.s:
brahmacaryādidharmāṃśca śrāddhakalpavidhistataḥ /
grahayajñastataḥ proktovaidikasmārtakarma ca //
1.99.d:
ब्रह्मचर्यादिधर्मांश्च श्राद्धकल्पविधिस्ततः ।
ग्रहयज्ञस्ततः प्रोक्तोवैदिकस्मार्तकर्म च ॥
1.99.m: the duties of studenthood and the rest; then the rule for the rite of ancestral offerings; / then the planetary sacrifice is declared, along with Vedic and Smārta rituals.

1.99.s:
prāyaścittānukathanaṃ tithīnāṃ ca vratādikam /
vāravratānukathanaṃ nakṣatravratakīrtanam //
1.99.d:
प्रायश्चित्तानुकथनं तिथीनां च व्रतादिकम् ।
वारव्रतानुकथनं नक्षत्रव्रतकीर्तनम् ॥
1.99.m: The description of expiations, the observances and other rites of lunar days, / the description of observances on weekdays, and the proclamation of observances for asterisms;

1.99.s:
māsikavratanirddeśo dīpadānavidhistathā /
navavyūhārcanaṃ proktaṃ narakāṇāṃ nirūpaṇam //
1.99.d:
मासिकव्रतनिर्द्देशो दीपदानविधिस्तथा ।
नवव्यूहार्चनं प्रोक्तं नरकाणां निरूपणम् ॥
1.99.m: the specification of monthly observances, and likewise the rule for the gift of a lamp; / the worship of the nine vyūhas is declared, and the description of hells;

1.99.s:
vratānāṃ cāpi dānānāṃ nirūpaṇamihoditam /
nāḍīcakrasamuddeśaḥ saṃdhyāvidhiranuttamaḥ //
1.99.d:
व्रतानां चापि दानानां निरूपणमिहोदितम् ।
नाडीचक्रसमुद्देशः संध्याविधिरनुत्तमः ॥
1.99.m: the description of observances and also of gifts is stated here; / the exposition of the network of channels, and the unsurpassed rule for the twilight devotion;

1.99.s:
gāyatryarthasya nirddeśo liṅgastotraṃ tataḥ param /
rājyābhiṣekamantroktirddharmakṛtyaṃ ca bhūbhujām //
1.99.d:
गायत्र्यर्थस्य निर्द्देशो लिङ्गस्तोत्रं ततः परम् ।
राज्याभिषेकमन्त्रोक्तिर्द्धर्मकृत्यं च भूभुजाम् ॥
1.99.m: the specification of the meaning of the gāyatrī, followed then by the hymn to the Liṅga; / the proclamation of mantras for the royal consecration, and the duties of kings;

1.99.s:
svapnādhyāyastataḥ proktaḥ śakunādinirūpaṇam /
maṇḍalādikanirddeṃśo ratnadīkṣāvidhistataḥ //
1.99.d:
स्वप्नाध्यायस्ततः प्रोक्तः शकुनादिनिरूपणम् ।
मण्डलादिकनिर्द्देंशो रत्नदीक्षाविधिस्ततः ॥
1.99.m: then the chapter on dreams is taught, the examination of omens and portents; / the description of sacred diagrams and the like, followed by the rite of gemstone-initiation;

1.99.s:
rāmoktanītinirddeśo ratnānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ /
dhanurvidyā tataḥ proktā vyavahārapradarśanam //
1.99.d:
रामोक्तनीतिनिर्द्देशो रत्नानां लक्षणं ततः ।
धनुर्विद्या ततः प्रोक्ता व्यवहारप्रदर्शनम् ॥
1.99.m: the teaching of polity spoken by Rāma, followed by the characteristics of gemstones; / archery is then taught, and the presentation of legal proceedings;

1.99.s:
devāsuravimardākhyā hyāyurvedanirūpaṇam /
gajādīnāṃ cikitsā ca teṣāṃ śāntistataḥ param //
1.99.d:
देवासुरविमर्दाख्या ह्यायुर्वेदनिरूपणम् ।
गजादीनां चिकित्सा च तेषां शान्तिस्ततः परम् ॥
1.99.m: the account of the clash between gods and asuras, and the examination of Āyurveda; / the medical treatment of elephants and others, followed then by their pacification rites;

1.99.s:
gonarādicikitsā ca nānāpūjāstataḥ param /
śāntayaścāpi vividhāśchandaḥ śāstramataḥ param //
1.99.d:
गोनरादिचिकित्सा च नानापूजास्ततः परम् ।
शान्तयश्चापि विविधाश्छन्दः शास्त्रमतः परम् ॥
1.99.m: the medical treatment of cattle, humans, and others, and various worships after that; / various pacification rites, and following that, the treatise on metrics;

1.99.s:
sāhityaṃ ca tataḥ paścādekārṇādisamāhvayāḥ /
siddhaśabdānuśiṣṭiścakośaḥ sargādivargakaḥ //
1.99.d:
साहित्यं च ततः पश्चादेकार्णादिसमाह्वयाः ।
सिद्धशब्दानुशिष्टिश्चकोशः सर्गादिवर्गकः ॥
1.99.m: and next, poetics, names beginning with single-syllabled words, / the instruction on established vocabulary, and a lexicon arranged in sections such as creation;

1.99.s:
pralayānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca śārīrakanirūpaṇam /
varṇanaṃ narakāṇāṃ ca yogāśtramataḥ param //
1.99.d:
प्रलयानां लक्षणं च शारीरकनिरूपणम् ।
वर्णनं नरकाणां च योगाश्त्रमतः परम् ॥
1.99.m: the characteristics of cosmic dissolutions, and the examination of the embodied self; / the description of the hells, and after that the treatise on yoga;

1.99.s:
brahmajñānaṃ tataḥ paścātpurāṇaśravaṇe phalam /
etadāgneyakaṃ vipra purāṇaṃ parikīrtitam //
1.99.d:
ब्रह्मज्ञानं ततः पश्चात्पुराणश्रवणे फलम् ।
एतदाग्नेयकं विप्र पुराणं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
1.99.m: knowledge of Brahman after that, and the fruit of listening to the Purāṇa— / this, O brāhmaṇa, is proclaimed as the Āgneya Purāṇa.

1.99.s:
tallikhitvā tu yo dadyātsuvarṇakalamānvitam /
tiladhenu yutaṃ cāpi mārgaśīrṣyāṃ vidhānataḥ //
1.99.d:
तल्लिखित्वा तु यो दद्यात्सुवर्णकलमान्वितम् ।
तिलधेनु युतं चापि मार्गशीर्ष्यां विधानतः ॥
1.99.m: Whoever transcribes it and presents it, endowed with a golden pen, / together with a cow made of sesame seeds, on the full-moon day of Mārgaśīrṣa according to the rule,

1.99.s:
purāṇārthavide so 'tha svargaloke mahīyate /
eṣānukramaṇī proktā tavāgneyasya muktidā //
1.99.d:
पुराणार्थविदे सो ऽथ स्वर्गलोके महीयते ।
एषानुक्रमणी प्रोक्ता तवाग्नेयस्य मुक्तिदा ॥
1.99.m: to one who knows the meaning of the Purāṇa, is then glorified in the heavenly world. / This table of contents of the Āgneya [Purāṇa], granting liberation, has been told to you,

1.99.s:
śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ caiva nṛṇāṃ ceha paratra ca //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde 'gnipurāṇānukramaṇīnirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikonaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.99.d:
शृण्वतां पठतां चैव नृणां चेह परत्र च ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे ऽग्निपुराणानुक्रमणीनिरूपणं नामैकोनशततमो ऽध्यायः
1.99.m:
both here and in the hereafter, for men who listen to it and read it.

Thus ends the ninety-ninth chapter, named ‘Description of the Table of Contents of the Agni Purāṇa,’ in the Fourth Part in the Great Narrative in the First Half of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

1.100.s:
śrībrahmovāca
atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ sarvasiddhidam /
bhaviṣyaṃ bhavataḥ sarvalokābhīṣṭapradāyakam //
1.100.d:
श्रीब्रह्मोवाच
अथ ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणं सर्वसिद्धिदम् ।
भविष्यं भवतः सर्वलोकाभीष्टप्रदायकम् ॥
1.100.m: The glorious Brahmā said: / Now I shall tell you the Purāṇa that yields all attainments, / the Bhaviṣya, which bestows all desired things for the world upon you,

1.100.s:
yatrāhaṃ sarvadevānāmādikartā samudgataḥ /
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ tatra saṃjāto manuḥ svāryabhuvaḥ purā //
1.100.d:
यत्राहं सर्वदेवानामादिकर्ता समुद्गतः ।
सृष्ट्यर्थं तत्र संजातो मनुः स्वार्यभुवः पुरा ॥
1.100.m: wherein I, the primal creator of all the gods, arose; / there, for the purpose of creation, Manu Svāyambhuva was formerly born.

1.100.s:
sa māṃ praṇamya papraccha dharmaṃ sarvāthasādhakam /
ahaṃ tasmai tadā prītaḥ prāvocaṃ dharmasaṃhitām //
1.100.d:
स मां प्रणम्य पप्रच्छ धर्मं सर्वाथसाधकम् ।
अहं तस्मै तदा प्रीतः प्रावोचं धर्मसंहिताम् ॥
1.100.m: Bowing down to me, he inquired about righteousness, which achieves all goals; / pleased with him, I then spoke the compendium of righteousness.

1.100.s:
purāṇānāṃ yadā vyāso vyāsaṃ caktre mahāmatiḥ /
tadā tāṃ saṃhitāṃ sarvāṃ pañcadhā vyabhajanmuniḥ //
1.100.d:
पुराणानां यदा व्यासो व्यासं चक्त्रे महामतिः ।
तदा तां संहितां सर्वां पञ्चधा व्यभजन्मुनिः ॥
1.100.m: When the great-minded Vyāsa arranged the arrangement of the Purāṇas, / the sage then divided that entire compendium into five parts:

1.100.s:
adhorakalpavṛttāntaṃ nānāścaryakathanvitam /
tatrādimaṃ smṛtaṃ parvaṃ brāhmaṃ yatrāstyupakramaḥ //
1.100.d:
अधोरकल्पवृत्तान्तं नानाश्चर्यकथन्वितम् ।
तत्रादिमं स्मृतं पर्वं ब्राह्मं यत्रास्त्युपक्रमः ॥
1.100.m: replete with the account of the Aghora Kalpa and filled with various wondrous narratives. / There, the first section is remembered as the Brāhma [Parvan], wherein lies the beginning,
the sequence of questions on the Purāṇa in the dialogue between Sūta and Śaunaka; / it largely concerns the deeds of the Sun, accompanied by all kinds of narratives;

1.100.s:
sṛṣṭyādilakṣaṇopetaḥ śāstrasarvasvarūpakaḥ /
pustalekhakalekhānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca tataḥ param //
1.100.d:
सृष्ट्यादिलक्षणोपेतः शास्त्रसर्वस्वरूपकः ।
पुस्तलेखकलेखानां लक्षणं च ततः परम् ॥
1.100.m: it possesses the characteristics of creation and the rest, having the form of the entirety of scripture; / and after that, the characteristics of the book, the scribe, and the script;

1.100.s:
saṃskārāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cātra kīrtitam /
pakṣasyāditithīnāṃ ca kalpāḥ sapta ca kīrtitāḥ //
1.100.d:
संस्काराणां च सर्वेषां लक्षणं चात्र कीर्तितम् ।
पक्षस्यादितिथीनां च कल्पाः सप्त च कीर्तिताः ॥
1.100.m: and the characteristics of all the purificatory rites are proclaimed here; / and seven rituals of the initial lunar days of the fortnight are proclaimed;

1.100.s:
aṣṭamyādyāḥ śeṣakalpā vaiṣṇave parvaṇi smṛtāḥ /
śaive ca kāyato bhinnāḥ saure cāntyakathānvayaḥ //
1.100.d:
अष्टम्याद्याः शेषकल्पा वैष्णवे पर्वणि स्मृताः ।
शैवे च कायतो भिन्नाः सौरे चान्त्यकथान्वयः ॥
1.100.m: the remaining rituals, beginning with the eighth lunar day, are recorded in the Vaiṣṇava section; / and they are physically distinct in the Śaiva [section], and in the Saura [section] is the sequence of the final narratives;
the fifth section, named Pratisarga, follows, endowed with various narratives, / accompanied by the conclusion of the Purāṇa.

1.100.s:
eṣu pañcasu pūrvasmin brahmaṇo mahimādhikāḥ /
dharme kāme ca mokṣe tu viṣṇoścāpi śivasya ca //
1.100.d:
एषु पञ्चसु पूर्वस्मिन् ब्रह्मणो महिमाधिकाः ।
धर्मे कामे च मोक्षे तु विष्णोश्चापि शिवस्य च ॥
1.100.m: Among these five, the glories of Brahmā are predominant in the first; / and [those] of Viṣṇu and Śiva in righteousness, desire, and liberation;

1.100.s:
dvitīyaṃ ca tṛtīye ca saure vargacatuṣṭaye /
pratisargāhvayaṃ tvantyaṃ proktaṃ sarvakathānvitam //
1.100.d:
द्वितीयं च तृतीये च सौरे वर्गचतुष्टये ।
प्रतिसर्गाह्वयं त्वन्त्यं प्रोक्तं सर्वकथान्वितम् ॥
1.100.m: the second and third [deal with them], and the four aims of life [are treated] in the Saura; / but the last, called Pratisarga, is said to be endowed with all narratives.

1.100.s:
sabhaviṣyaṃ vinirddiṣṭaṃ parva vyāsena dhīmatā /
caturddaśasahasraṃ tu purāṇaṃ parikīrtitam //
1.100.d:
सभविष्यं विनिर्द्दिष्टं पर्व व्यासेन धीमता ।
चतुर्द्दशसहस्रं तु पुराणं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
1.100.m: The section named Bhaviṣya was pointed out by the wise Vyāsa; / this Purāṇa is proclaimed to consist of fourteen thousand [verses],

1.100.s:
bhaviṣyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ sāmyaṃ yatra prakīrtitam /
guṇānāṃ tāratamyena samaṃ brahmeti hi śrutiḥ //
1.100.d:
भविष्यं सर्वदेवानां साम्यं यत्र प्रकीर्तितम् ।
गुणानां तारतम्येन समं ब्रह्मेति हि श्रुतिः ॥
1.100.m: the Bhaviṣya, wherein the equality of all the gods is proclaimed; / indeed, the Veda states that Brahman is equal through the gradation of qualities.

1.100.s:
taṃ likhitvā tu yo dadyātpauṣyāṃ vidvānvimatsaraḥ /
guḍadhenuyutaṃ hemavastramālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ //
1.100.d:
तं लिखित्वा तु यो दद्यात्पौष्यां विद्वान्विमत्सरः ।
गुडधेनुयुतं हेमवस्त्रमाल्यविभूषणैः ॥
1.100.m: Whoever, being learned and free from envy, transcribes it and presents it on the full-moon day of Pauṣa, / accompanied by a cow made of jaggery, with gold, garments, garlands, and ornaments,

1.100.s:
vācakaṃ pustakaṃ cāpi pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ /
gandhādyairbhojyabhakṣyaiśca kṛtvā nīrājanādikam //
1.100.d:
वाचकं पुस्तकं चापि पूजयित्वा विधानतः ।
गन्धाद्यैर्भोज्यभक्ष्यैश्च कृत्वा नीराजनादिकम् ॥
1.100.m: having worshiped both the reciter and the book according to the rule / with perfumes and other offerings, foods to be eaten and enjoyed, having performed the waving of lights and other rites;

1.100.s:
yo vai jitendriyo bhūtvā sopavāsaḥ samāhitaḥ /
atha vaikahaviṣyāśī kīrtayecchṛṇuyādapi //
1.100.d:
यो वै जितेन्द्रियो भूत्वा सोपवासः समाहितः ।
अथ वैकहविष्याशी कीर्तयेच्छृणुयादपि ॥
1.100.m: whoever, having conquered his senses, fasting and composed, / or eating only sacred food once a day, proclaims or listens to it,

1.100.s:
sa muktaḥ pātakairghoraiḥ prayāti brahmaṇaḥ padam /
yo 'pyanukramaṇīmetāṃ bhaviṣyasya nirūpitām //
1.100.d:
स मुक्तः पातकैर्घोरैः प्रयाति ब्रह्मणः पदम् ।
यो ऽप्यनुक्रमणीमेतां भविष्यस्य निरूपिताम् ॥
1.100.m: freed from terrible sins, goes to the abode of Brahmā. / Whoever also reads or hears this stated table of contents of the Bhaviṣya,

1.100.s:
paṭhedvā śṛṇuyāccaitāṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca vindati //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde bhaviṣyapurāṇānukramaṇī nirūpaṇaṃ nāma śatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.100.d:
पठेद्वा शृणुयाच्चैतां भुक्तिं मुक्तिं च विन्दति ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे भविष्यपुराणानुक्रमणी निरूपणं नाम शततमो ऽध्यायः
1.100.m:
attains enjoyment and liberation.

Thus ends the one hundredth chapter, named ‘Description of the Table of Contents of the Bhaviṣya Purāṇa,’ in the Fourth Part in the Great Narrative in the First Half of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

1.101.s:
śrībrahmovāca
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ daśamaṃ tava /
brahmavaivartakaṃ nāma vedamārgānudarśakam //
1.101.d:
श्रीब्रह्मोवाच
शृणु वत्स प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणं दशमं तव ।
ब्रह्मवैवर्तकं नाम वेदमार्गानुदर्शकम् ॥
1.101.m: The glorious Brahmā said: / Listen, my child, I shall tell you of the tenth Purāṇa, / named Brahmavaivarta, which reveals the path of the Vedas,

1.101.s:
sāvarṇiryatra bhagavānsākṣāddevarṣaye sthitaḥ /
nāradāya purāṇārthaṃ prāha sarvamalaukikam //
1.101.d:
सावर्णिर्यत्र भगवान्साक्षाद्देवर्षये स्थितः ।
नारदाय पुराणार्थं प्राह सर्वमलौकिकम् ॥
1.101.m: wherein the divine Sāvarṇi, directly appearing to the divine sage / Nārada, explained the entire otherworldly meaning of the Purāṇa.

1.101.s:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sāraḥ prītirharau hare /
tayorabhedasiddhyarthaṃ brahmavaivartamuttamam //
1.101.d:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां सारः प्रीतिर्हरौ हरे ।
तयोरभेदसिद्ध्यर्थं ब्रह्मवैवर्तमुत्तमम् ॥
1.101.m: The essence of righteousness, wealth, desire, and liberation is devotion to Hari and Hara; / for the sake of establishing their non-difference, the Brahmavaivarta is supreme.

1.101.s:
rathantarasya kalpasya vṛttāntaṃ yanmayoditam /
śatakoṭipurāṇe tatsaṃkṣipya prāha vedavit //
1.101.d:
रथन्तरस्य कल्पस्य वृत्तान्तं यन्मयोदितम् ।
शतकोटिपुराणे तत्संक्षिप्य प्राह वेदवित् ॥
1.101.m: The account of the Rathantara Kalpa which was spoken by me / in the Purāṇa of a hundred crore verses, the knower of the Veda, having condensed it,

1.101.s:
vyāsaścaturddhā saṃvyasya brahmavaivartasaṃjñite /
aṣṭādaśasahasraṃ tatpurāṇaṃ parikīrtitam //
1.101.d:
व्यासश्चतुर्द्धा संव्यस्य ब्रह्मवैवर्तसंज्ञिते ।
अष्टादशसहस्रं तत्पुराणं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
1.101.m: Vyāsa, dividing it into four in that known as Brahmavaivarta, spoke. / That Purāṇa is proclaimed to consist of eighteen thousand [verses],

1.101.s:
brahmaprakṛtivighneśakṛṣṇakhaṇḍasamanvitam /
tatra sūtarṣisaṃvāde purāṇopakramastataḥ //
1.101.d:
ब्रह्मप्रकृतिविघ्नेशकृष्णखण्डसमन्वितम् ।
तत्र सूतर्षिसंवादे पुराणोपक्रमस्ततः ॥
1.101.m: possessing the Brahma, Prakṛti, Vighneśa, and Kṛṣṇa sections; / there, in the dialogue between Sūta and the sages, the Purāṇa begins;

1.101.s:
sṛṣṭiprakaraṇaṃ tvādyaṃ tato nāradavedhasoḥ /
vivādaḥ sumahānyatra dvayorāsītparābhavaḥ //
1.101.d:
सृष्टिप्रकरणं त्वाद्यं ततो नारदवेधसोः ।
विवादः सुमहान्यत्र द्वयोरासीत्पराभवः ॥
1.101.m: first is the section on creation, then the very great dispute / between Nārada and Brahmā, wherein occurred the defeat of both;

1.101.s:
śivalokagatiḥ paścājjñānalābhaḥ śivātmane /
śivavākyena tatpaścānmarīcernāradasya tu //
1.101.d:
शिवलोकगतिः पश्चाज्ज्ञानलाभः शिवात्मने ।
शिववाक्येन तत्पश्चान्मरीचेर्नारदस्य तु ॥
1.101.m: then the departure to the world of Śiva, the attainment of knowledge from Śiva; / after that, by the word of Śiva, of Marīci and Nārada,

1.101.s:
gamanaṃ caiva sāvarṇerjñānārthaṃ siddhasevite /
āśrame sumahāpuṇye trailokyāścaryakāriṇī //
1.101.d:
गमनं चैव सावर्णेर्ज्ञानार्थं सिद्धसेविते ।
आश्रमे सुमहापुण्ये त्रैलोक्याश्चर्यकारिणी ॥
1.101.m: and the departure of Sāvarṇi for the sake of knowledge to the hermitage / visited by perfected beings, extremely meritorious, causing wonder to the three worlds.

1.101.s:
etaddhi brahmakhaṇḍaṃ hi śrutaṃ pāpavināśanam /
tataḥ sāvarṇisaṃvādo nāradasya samīritaḥ //
1.101.d:
एतद्धि ब्रह्मखण्डं हि श्रुतं पापविनाशनम् ।
ततः सावर्णिसंवादो नारदस्य समीरितः ॥
1.101.m: This indeed is the Brahma-khaṇḍa, which, when heard, destroys sin. / Then the dialogue of Sāvarṇi and Nārada is related,

1.101.s:
kṛṣṇamāhātmyasaṃyukto nānākhyānakathottaram /
prakṛteraṃśabhūtānāṃ kalānāṃ cāpi varṇitam //
1.101.d:
कृष्णमाहात्म्यसंयुक्तो नानाख्यानकथोत्तरम् ।
प्रकृतेरंशभूतानां कलानां चापि वर्णितम् ॥
1.101.m: joined with the eulogy of greatness of Kṛṣṇa, followed by various tales and narratives; / the eulogy of greatness, worship, and other rites of the partial manifestations

1.101.s:
māhātmyaṃ pūjanādyaṃ ca vistareṇa yathāsthitam /
etatprakṛtikhaṇḍaṃ hi śrutaṃ bhūtividhāyakam //
1.101.d:
माहात्म्यं पूजनाद्यं च विस्तरेण यथास्थितम् ।
एतत्प्रकृतिखण्डं हि श्रुतं भूतिविधायकम् ॥
1.101.m: and fractional parts of Prakṛti are described in full, exactly as they are. / This indeed is the Prakṛti-khaṇḍa, which, when heard, bestows prosperity.

1.101.s:
gaṇeśajanmasaṃpraśnaḥ sapuṇyakamahāvratam /
pārvatyāḥ kārtikeyena saha vighneśasaṃbhavam //
1.101.d:
गणेशजन्मसंप्रश्नः सपुण्यकमहाव्रतम् ।
पार्वत्याः कार्तिकेयेन सह विघ्नेशसंभवम् ॥
1.101.m: The inquiry concerning the birth of Gaṇeśa, the great observance with the Puṇyaka rite, / and the birth of Vighneśa along with Kārtikeya from Pārvatī.

1.101.s:
caritaṃ kārtavīryasya jāmadagryasya cādbhutam /
vivādaḥ sumahānāsījjāmadagryagaṇeśayoḥ //
1.101.d:
चरितं कार्तवीर्यस्य जामदग्र्यस्य चाद्भुतम् ।
विवादः सुमहानासीज्जामदग्र्यगणेशयोः ॥
1.101.m: The wondrous deeds of Kārtavīrya and Jāmadagnya, / and the very great dispute that arose between Jāmadagnya and Gaṇeśa;

1.101.s:
etadvighneśakhaṇḍaṃ hi sarvavighnavināśanam /
śrīkṛṣṇajanmasaṃpraśno janmākhyānaṃ tato 'dbhutam //
1.101.d:
एतद्विघ्नेशखण्डं हि सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम् ।
श्रीकृष्णजन्मसंप्रश्नो जन्माख्यानं ततो ऽद्भुतम् ॥
1.101.m: this is the Vighneśakhaṇḍa, which destroys all obstacles. / Then the inquiry into Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s birth and the wondrous account of his birth;

1.101.s:
gokule gamanaṃ gaścātpūtanādivadādbhūtāḥ /
bālyakaumārajā līlā vividhāstatra varṇitāḥ //
1.101.d:
गोकुले गमनं गश्चात्पूतनादिवदाद्भूताः ।
बाल्यकौमारजा लीला विविधास्तत्र वर्णिताः ॥
1.101.m: his journey to Gokula, the subsequent wondrous slaying of Pūtanā and others, / and the various childhood and boyhood pastimes described there;

1.101.s:
rāsakrīḍā ca gopībhiḥ śāradī samudāhṛtā /
rahasye rādhayā krīḍā varṇitā bahuvistarā //
1.101.d:
रासक्रीडा च गोपीभिः शारदी समुदाहृता ।
रहस्ये राधया क्रीडा वर्णिता बहुविस्तरा ॥
1.101.m: and the autumn circular dance with the cowherdesses is recounted; / and in secret his playful pastimes with Rādhā are described at great length;

1.101.s:
sahākrūreṇa tatpaścānmathurāgamanaṃ hareḥ /
kaṃsādīnāṃ vadhe vṛtte kṛṣṇasya dvijasaṃskṛtiḥ //
1.101.d:
सहाक्रूरेण तत्पश्चान्मथुरागमनं हरेः ।
कंसादीनां वधे वृत्ते कृष्णस्य द्विजसंस्कृतिः ॥
1.101.m: after that, Hari's going to Mathurā with Akrūra; / the slaying of Kaṃsa and the rest having taken place, the twice-born initiation of Kṛṣṇa;

1.101.s:
kāśyasāṃdīpaneḥ paścādvidyopādānamadbhutam /
yavanasya vadhaḥ paścāddvārakāgamanaṃ hareḥ //
1.101.d:
काश्यसांदीपनेः पश्चाद्विद्योपादानमद्भुतम् ।
यवनस्य वधः पश्चाद्द्वारकागमनं हरेः ॥
1.101.m: after that, the wondrous acquisition of knowledge from Sāṃdīpani of Kāśī; / the slaying of the Yavana, and after that Hari's departure for Dvārakā;

1.101.s:
narakādivadhastatra kṛṣṇena vihito 'dbhutaḥ /
kṛṣṇakhaṇḍamidaṃ vipra nṛṇāṃ saṃsārakhaṇḍanam //
1.101.d:
नरकादिवधस्तत्र कृष्णेन विहितो ऽद्भुतः ।
कृष्णखण्डमिदं विप्र नृणां संसारखण्डनम् ॥
1.101.m: the wondrous slaying of Naraka and others performed there by Kṛṣṇa; / this Kṛṣṇakhaṇḍa, O brahmin, cuts away the worldly cycle of human beings.

1.101.s:
paṭhitaṃ ca śrutaṃ dhyātaṃ pūjitaṃ cābhivanditam /
ityetadbrahmavaivartapurāṇaṃ cātyalaukikam //
1.101.d:
पठितं च श्रुतं ध्यातं पूजितं चाभिवन्दितम् ।
इत्येतद्ब्रह्मवैवर्तपुराणं चात्यलौकिकम् ॥
1.101.m: Read, heard, meditated upon, worshipped, and bowed down to— / thus is this extremely extraordinary Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa,

1.101.s:
vyāsoktaṃ cādi saṃbhūtaṃ paṭhañchṛṇvanvimucyate /
vijñānājñānaśamanāddhorātsaṃsārasāgarāt //
1.101.d:
व्यासोक्तं चादि संभूतं पठञ्छृण्वन्विमुच्यते ।
विज्ञानाज्ञानशमनाद्धोरात्संसारसागरात् ॥
1.101.m: spoken by Vyāsa and originated in primeval times. Reading or hearing it, one is freed / from the dreadful ocean of the worldly cycle through the pacification of ignorance by spiritual knowledge.

1.101.s:
likhitvedaṃ ca yo dadyānmādhyāṃ dhenusamanvitam /
brahmalokamavāpnoti sa mukto 'jñānabandhanāt //
1.101.d:
लिखित्वेदं च यो दद्यान्माध्यां धेनुसमन्वितम् ।
ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नोति स मुक्तो ऽज्ञानबन्धनात् ॥
1.101.m: And whoever, having copied it down, should give it on the full moon of Māgha along with a cow, / attains the world of Brahmā, freed from the bond of ignorance.

1.101.s:
yaścānukramaṇīṃ cāpi paṭhedvā śṛṇuyādapi /
so 'pi kṛṣṇaprasādena labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne brahmavaivartapurāṇānukramaṇīnirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyāḥ // 101 //
1.101.d:
यश्चानुक्रमणीं चापि पठेद्वा शृणुयादपि ।
सो ऽपि कृष्णप्रसादेन लभते वाञ्छितं फलम् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने ब्रह्मवैवर्तपुराणानुक्रमणीनिरूपणं नामैकोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायाः ॥ 101 ॥
1.101.m:
And whoever reads or even hears this table of contents / also obtains his desired fruit by the grace of Kṛṣṇa.

Thus ends the one hundred and first chapter, entitled 'Determination of the Table of Contents of the Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa', in the Great Narrative of the First Part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

1.102.s:
brahmovāca
śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ liṅgasaṃjñitam /
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva bhuktimuktipradāyakam //
1.102.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
शृणु पुत्र प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणं लिङ्गसंज्ञितम् ।
पठतां शृण्वतां चैव भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् ॥
1.102.m: Brahmā said: / Listen, my son: I shall declare the Purāṇa designated as the Liṅga [Purāṇa], / which bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation upon those who read and hear it;

1.102.s:
yacca liṅgābhidhaṃ tiṣṭhanvahniliṅge haro 'bhyadhāt /
mahyaṃ dharmādisiddhyarthaṃ magnikalpakathāśrayam //
1.102.d:
यच्च लिङ्गाभिधं तिष्ठन्वह्निलिङ्गे हरो ऽभ्यधात् ।
मह्यं धर्मादिसिद्ध्यर्थं मग्निकल्पकथाश्रयम् ॥
1.102.m: which Hara, standing in the fiery Liṅga, spoke under the name Liṅga / to me for the attainment of righteousness and the rest, centered on stories of the Agni Kalpa.

1.102.s:
tadeva vyāsadevena bhāgadvayasamanvitam /
purāṇaṃ liṅgamuditaṃ bahvākhyānavicitritam //
1.102.d:
