तदेव व्यासदेवेन भागद्वयसमन्वितम् ।
पुराणं लिङ्गमुदितं बह्वाख्यानविचित्रितम् ॥
1.102.m: That very Liṅga Purāṇa has been proclaimed by the divine Vyāsa / as consisting of two parts, variegated with many narratives.

1.102.s:
tadekādaśasāhasraṃ haramāhātmyasūcakam /
paraṃ sarvapurāṇānāṃ sārabhūtaṃ jagattraye //
1.102.d:
तदेकादशसाहस्रं हरमाहात्म्यसूचकम् ।
परं सर्वपुराणानां सारभूतं जगत्त्रये ॥
1.102.m: It contains eleven thousand [verses], indicating the eulogy of the greatness of Hara, / supreme, the essential core of all the Purāṇas in the three worlds.

1.102.s:
purāṇopakrame praśnaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ saṃkṣepataḥ purā /
yogākhyānaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ kalpākhyānaṃ tataḥ param //
1.102.d:
पुराणोपक्रमे प्रश्नः सृष्टिः संक्षेपतः पुरा ।
योगाख्यानं ततः प्रोक्तं कल्पाख्यानं ततः परम् ॥
1.102.m: In the beginning of the Purāṇa is the inquiry; the creation in brief in the beginning; / then the account of yoga is declared, and after that the account of the kalpas;

1.102.s:
liṅgodbhavastadaṃbā ca kīrtitā hi tataḥ param /
sanatkumāraśailādisaṃvādaścātha pāvanaḥ //
1.102.d:
लिङ्गोद्भवस्तदंबा च कीर्तिता हि ततः परम् ।
सनत्कुमारशैलादिसंवादश्चाथ पावनः ॥
1.102.m: the origin of the Liṅga, and after that the Mother is indeed praised; / and then the purifying dialogue between Sanatkumāra and Śailādi;

1.102.s:
tato dādhīcacaritaṃ yugadharmanirūpaṇam /
tato bhuvana kośākhyā sūryasomānvayastataḥ //
1.102.d:
ततो दाधीचचरितं युगधर्मनिरूपणम् ।
ततो भुवन कोशाख्या सूर्यसोमान्वयस्ततः ॥
1.102.m: then the deeds of Dadhīca, the determination of the duty of the ages; / then the account of the cosmic sphere, and then the genealogies of the Sun and Moon;

1.102.s:
tataśca vistarātsargastripurākhyānakaṃ tathā /
liṅgapratiṣṭhā ca tataḥ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam //
1.102.d:
ततश्च विस्तरात्सर्गस्त्रिपुराख्यानकं तथा ।
लिङ्गप्रतिष्ठा च ततः पशुपाशविमोक्षणम् ॥
1.102.m: and then the detailed creation, as well as the narrative of Tripura; / and then the installation of the Liṅga, and the release of the bound souls from their fetters;

1.102.s:
śivavratāni ca tathā sadācāranirūpaṇam /
prāyaścitānyariṣṭāni kāśīśrīśailavarṇanam //
1.102.d:
शिवव्रतानि च तथा सदाचारनिरूपणम् ।
प्रायश्चितान्यरिष्टानि काशीश्रीशैलवर्णनम् ॥
1.102.m: and likewise the vows of Śiva, the determination of right conduct, / expiations, omens of death, and the description of Kāśī and Śrīśaila;

1.102.s:
andhakākhyānakaṃ paścādvārāhacaritaṃ punaḥ /
nṛsiṃhacaritaṃ paścājjalandharavadhastataḥ //
1.102.d:
अन्धकाख्यानकं पश्चाद्वाराहचरितं पुनः ।
नृसिंहचरितं पश्चाज्जलन्धरवधस्ततः ॥
1.102.m: the narrative of Andhaka, and then further the deeds of Varāha; / after that the deeds of Nṛsiṃha, then the slaying of Jalandhara;

1.102.s:
śaivaṃ sahasranāmātha dakṣayajñavināśanam /
kāmasya dahanaṃ paścādgirijāyāḥ karagrahaḥ //
1.102.d:
शैवं सहस्रनामाथ दक्षयज्ञविनाशनम् ।
कामस्य दहनं पश्चाद्गिरिजायाः करग्रहः ॥
1.102.m: then the Thousand Names of Śiva, the destruction of Dakṣa’s sacrifice, / the burning of Kāma, and afterwards the marriage of Girijā;

1.102.s:
tato vināyakākhyānaṃ nṛpākhyānaṃ śivasya ca /
upamanyukathā cāpi pūrvabhāga itīritaḥ //
1.102.d:
ततो विनायकाख्यानं नृपाख्यानं शिवस्य च ।
उपमन्युकथा चापि पूर्वभाग इतीरितः ॥
1.102.m: then the narrative of Vināyaka, and the royal narrative of Śiva, / and the story of Upamanyu: thus is the first part declared.

1.102.s:
viṣṇumāhātmyakathanamaṃbarīṣakathā tataḥ /
sanatkumāranandīśasaṃvādaśca punarmune //
1.102.d:
विष्णुमाहात्म्यकथनमंबरीषकथा ततः ।
सनत्कुमारनन्दीशसंवादश्च पुनर्मुने ॥
1.102.m: The proclamation of the eulogy of the greatness of Viṣṇu, then the story of Ambarīṣa, / and again, O sage, the dialogue between Sanatkumāra and Nandīśa;

1.102.s:
śivamāhā tmyaseyuktaḥ strānayāgādikaṃ tataḥ /
sūryapūjāvidhiścaiva śivapūjā ca muktidā //
1.102.d:
शिवमाहा त्म्यसेयुक्तः स्त्रानयागादिकं ततः ।
सूर्यपूजाविधिश्चैव शिवपूजा च मुक्तिदा ॥
1.102.m: which is joined with the eulogy of the greatness of Śiva; then ablutions, sacrifices, and the like; / and the rite of Sun-worship, and the worship of Śiva that bestows liberation;

1.102.s:
dānāni bahudhāktāni śrāddhaprakaraṇaṃ tataḥ /
pratiṣṭhātaṃ tramuditaṃ tato 'ghorasya kīrtanam //
1.102.d:
दानानि बहुधाक्तानि श्राद्धप्रकरणं ततः ।
प्रतिष्ठातं त्रमुदितं ततो ऽघोरस्य कीर्तनम् ॥
1.102.m: Gifts of many kinds are declared, then the section on ancestral rites, / the ritual manual of consecration is spoken, and then the praise of Aghora,

1.102.s:
vajreśvarī mahāvidyā gāyatrīmahimā tataḥ /
tryaṃbakasya ca māhātmyaṃ purāṇaśravaṇasya ca //
1.102.d:
वज्रेश्वरी महाविद्या गायत्रीमहिमा ततः ।
त्र्यंबकस्य च माहात्म्यं पुराणश्रवणस्य च ॥
1.102.m: the Great Knowledge of Vajreśvarī, and then the greatness of the Gāyatrī, / the eulogy of greatness of Tryambaka, and that of listening to the Purāṇa.

1.102.s:
evaṃ coparibhāgaste laiṅgasya kathito mayā /
vyāsena hi nibaddhasya rudrāmāhātmyasūcitaḥ //
1.102.d:
एवं चोपरिभागस्ते लैङ्गस्य कथितो मया ।
व्यासेन हि निबद्धस्य रुद्रामाहात्म्यसूचितः ॥
1.102.m: Thus the upper part of the Liṅgapurāṇa has been told to you by me; / indeed, composed by Vyāsa, it indicates the greatness of Rudra.

1.102.s:
likhitvaitatpurāṇaṃ tu tiladhenusamanvitam /
phaālgunyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ yo dadyādbhaktyā dvijātaye //
1.102.d:
लिखित्वैतत्पुराणं तु तिलधेनुसमन्वितम् ।
फआल्गुन्यां पूर्णिमायां यो दद्याद्भक्त्या द्विजातये ॥
1.102.m: Having written down this Purāṇa, accompanied by a sesame-cow, / whoever gives it with devotion to a twice-born on the full moon day of Phālguna,

1.102.s:
sa labhecchivasāyujyaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam /
yaḥ paṭecchṛṇuyādvāpi laiṅgaṃ pāpāpahaṃ naraḥ //
1.102.d:
स लभेच्छिवसायुज्यं जरामरणवर्जितम् ।
यः पटेच्छृणुयाद्वापि लैङ्गं पापापहं नरः ॥
1.102.m: attains union with Śiva, free from old age and death. / Whatever person recites or hears the Liṅgapurāṇa that removes sin,

1.102.s:
sa bhuktabhogo loke 'sminnante śivapuraṃ vrajet /
liṅgānukramaṇīmetāṃ paṭhedyaḥ śṛṇuyāttathā //
1.102.d:
स भुक्तभोगो लोके ऽस्मिन्नन्ते शिवपुरं व्रजेत् ।
लिङ्गानुक्रमणीमेतां पठेद्यः शृणुयात्तथा ॥
1.102.m: having enjoyed pleasures in this world, at the end goes to Śiva's city. / Whoever recites or hears this table of contents of the Liṅgapurāṇa,

1.102.s:
tāvubhau śivabhaktau tu lokadvitayabhoginau /
jāyatāṃ girijābhartuḥ prasādānnātra saṃśayaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde liṅgapurāṇānukramaṇīnirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.102.d:
तावुभौ शिवभक्तौ तु लोकद्वितयभोगिनौ ।
जायतां गिरिजाभर्तुः प्रसादान्नात्र संशयः ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे लिङ्गपुराणानुक्रमणीनिरूपणं नाम द्व्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः
1.102.m:
both of them, devoted to Śiva, enjoy both worlds / by the grace of the husband of the Mountain's Daughter; of this there is no doubt.

Thus, in the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa, in the First Part, in the Great Narrative, in the Fourth Quarter, the hundred and second chapter, named 'Description of the Table of Contents of the Liṅgapurāṇa.'

1.103.s:
brahmovāca
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi vārāhaṃ vai purāṇakam /
bhāgadvayayutaṃ śaśvadviṣṇumāhātmyasūcakam //
1.103.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
शृणु वत्स प्रवक्ष्यामि वाराहं वै पुराणकम् ।
भागद्वययुतं शश्वद्विष्णुमाहात्म्यसूचकम् ॥
1.103.m: Brahmā said: / Listen, child! I shall proclaim the Vārāha Purāṇa, / endowed with two parts, perpetually indicating the eulogy of greatness of Viṣṇu.

1.103.s:
mānavasya tu kalpasya prasaṃgaṃ matkṛtaṃ purā /
nibabandha purāṇe 'smiṃścaturviṃśasahasrake //
1.103.d:
मानवस्य तु कल्पस्य प्रसंगं मत्कृतं पुरा ।
निबबन्ध पुराणे ऽस्मिंश्चतुर्विंशसहस्रके ॥
1.103.m: In this Purāṇa of twenty-four thousand [verses], [Vyāsa] compiled / the narrative of the Mānava Kalpa formerly produced by me.

1.103.s:
vyāso hi viduṣāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhuvi /
tatrādau śubhasaṃvādaḥ smṛtobhūmivarāhayoḥ //
1.103.d:
व्यासो हि विदुषां श्रेष्ठः साक्षान्नारायणो भुवि ।
तत्रादौ शुभसंवादः स्मृतोभूमिवराहयोः ॥
1.103.m: Indeed, Vyāsa is the best of the wise, visibly Nārāyaṇa on earth. / In it, first is remembered the auspicious dialogue between Earth and the Boar.

1.103.s:
athādikṛtavṛttānte raṃbhasya caritaṃ tataḥ /
durjayasya ca tatpaścācchrāddhakalpa udīritaḥ //
1.103.d:
अथादिकृतवृत्तान्ते रंभस्य चरितं ततः ।
दुर्जयस्य च तत्पश्चाच्छ्राद्धकल्प उदीरितः ॥
1.103.m: Then, in the narration of the first Golden Age, the deeds of Rambha, / and then of Durjaya, after which the ritual of ancestral rites is declared;

1.103.s:
mahātapasa ākhyānaṃ gauryutpattistataḥ parā /
vināyakasya nāgānāṃ senānyādityayorapi //
1.103.d:
महातपस आख्यानं गौर्युत्पत्तिस्ततः परा ।
विनायकस्य नागानां सेनान्यादित्ययोरपि ॥
1.103.m: the narrative of Mahātapas, and after that the origin of Gaurī, / of Vināyaka, of the snakes, and also of the General and the Sun,

1.103.s:
gaṇānāṃ ca tathā devyā dhanadasya vṛṣasya ca /
ākhyānaṃ satyatapaso vratākhyānasamanvitam //
1.103.d:
गणानां च तथा देव्या धनदस्य वृषस्य च ।
आख्यानं सत्यतपसो व्रताख्यानसमन्वितम् ॥
1.103.m: and of the Gaṇas, and likewise of the Goddess, of Kubera, and of the Bull; / the narrative of Satyatapas, along with the narrative of religious vows;

1.103.s:
agastyagītā tatpaścādrudragītā prakīrtitā /
mahiṣāsuravidhvaṃsamāhātmyaṃ ca triśaktijam //
1.103.d:
अगस्त्यगीता तत्पश्चाद्रुद्रगीता प्रकीर्तिता ।
महिषासुरविध्वंसमाहात्म्यं च त्रिशक्तिजम् ॥
1.103.m: the song of Agastya, and after that the song of Rudra is proclaimed; / and the eulogy of greatness of the destruction of the buffalo-demon, born of the Three Powers;

1.103.s:
parvādhyāyastataḥ śvetopākhyānaṃ gopradānikam /
ityādi kṛtavṛttāntaṃ prathame darśitaṃ mayā //
1.103.d:
पर्वाध्यायस्ततः श्वेतोपाख्यानं गोप्रदानिकम् ।
इत्यादि कृतवृत्तान्तं प्रथमे दर्शितं मया ॥
1.103.m: the chapter on festivals, then the story of Śveta concerning the gift of cattle; / such narratives of the Golden Age have been shown by me in the first [section].
Afterwards, in the section on the Lord's duties, the narration of vows and sacred fords, / [and] the bodily expiation for the thirty-two offenses;

1.103.s:
tīrthānāṃ cāpi sarveṣāṃ māhātmyaṃ pṛthagīritam /
mathurāyā viśeṣeṇa śrāddhādīnāṃ vidhistataḥ //
1.103.d:
तीर्थानां चापि सर्वेषां माहात्म्यं पृथगीरितम् ।
मथुराया विशेषेण श्राद्धादीनां विधिस्ततः ॥
1.103.m: and the eulogy of greatness of all sacred fords is proclaimed separately, / especially of Mathurā, and then the rite of ancestral offerings and other ceremonies;

1.103.s:
varṇanaṃ yamalokasya ṛṣiputraprasaṃgataḥ /
vipākaḥ karmaṇāṃ caiva viṣṇuvratanirūpaṇam //
1.103.d:
वर्णनं यमलोकस्य ऋषिपुत्रप्रसंगतः ।
विपाकः कर्मणां चैव विष्णुव्रतनिरूपणम् ॥
1.103.m: the description of Yama's realm in connection with the sage's son, / and the ripening of actions, and the determination of vows to Viṣṇu;

1.103.s:
gokarṇasya ca māhātmyaṃ kīrtitaṃ pāpanāśanam /
ityevaṃ pūrvabhāgo 'yaṃ purāṇasya nirūpitaḥ //
1.103.d:
गोकर्णस्य च माहात्म्यं कीर्तितं पापनाशनम् ।
इत्येवं पूर्वभागो ऽयं पुराणस्य निरूपितः ॥
1.103.m: and the eulogy of greatness of Gokarṇa is proclaimed, destroying sin. / In this way, this first part of the Purāṇa has been set forth.

1.103.s:
uttare pravibhāge tu pulastyakururājayoḥ /
saṃvāde sarvatīrthānāṃ māhātmyaṃ vistarātpṛthak //
1.103.d:
उत्तरे प्रविभागे तु पुलस्त्यकुरुराजयोः ।
संवादे सर्वतीर्थानां माहात्म्यं विस्तरात्पृथक् ॥
1.103.m: In the second section, in the dialogue between Pulastya and the king of the Kurus, / the eulogy of greatness of all sacred fords [is given] individually in detail;

1.103.s:
aśeṣadharmāścākhyātāḥ pauṣkaraṃ puṇyaparva ca /
ityevaṃ tava vārāhaṃ proktaṃ pāpavināśanam //
1.103.d:
अशेषधर्माश्चाख्याताः पौष्करं पुण्यपर्व च ।
इत्येवं तव वाराहं प्रोक्तं पापविनाशनम् ॥
1.103.m: all duties are proclaimed, and the holy festival of Pauṣkara. / Thus the Vārāha has been told to you, destroying sins,

1.103.s:
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva bhagavadbhaktivardhanam /
kāñcanaṃ garuḍa kṛtvā tiladhenusamanvitam //
1.103.d:
पठतां शृण्वतां चैव भगवद्भक्तिवर्धनम् ।
काञ्चनं गरुड कृत्वा तिलधेनुसमन्वितम् ॥
1.103.m: increasing devotion to the Lord for those who recite and hear it. / Having made a golden Garuḍa along with a sesame-cow,

1.103.s:
likhitvaitacca yo dadyāccaitryāṃ viprāya bhaktitaḥ /
sa labhedvaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma devarṣigaṇavanditaḥ //
1.103.d:
लिखित्वैतच्च यो दद्याच्चैत्र्यां विप्राय भक्तितः ।
स लभेद्वैष्णवं धाम देवर्षिगणवन्दितः ॥
1.103.m: having copied this out, whoever gives it with devotion to a brāhmaṇa on the full moon day of Caitra, / reaches the realm of Viṣṇu, praised by the hosts of gods and sages.

1.103.s:
yo vānukramaṇīmentāṃ śṛṇotyapi paṭhatyapi /
so 'pi bhaktiṃ labhedviṣṇau saṃsārocchedakāriṇīm //
iti śrībṛhannāradīya purāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde vārāhapurāṇānukramaṇīvarṇanaṃ nāma tryuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.103.d:
यो वानुक्रमणीमेन्तां शृणोत्यपि पठत्यपि ।
सो ऽपि भक्तिं लभेद्विष्णौ संसारोच्छेदकारिणीम् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीय पुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे वाराहपुराणानुक्रमणीवर्णनं नाम त्र्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः
1.103.m:
Or whoever hears or recites this table of contents / also attains devotion to Viṣṇu, which cuts off mundane existence.

Thus, in the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa, in the First Part, in the Great Narrative, in the Fourth Quarter, the hundred and third chapter, named 'Description of the Table of Contents of the Vārāhapurāṇa.'

1.104.s:
brahmovāca
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ skandasaṃjñakam /
yasminpratipadaṃ sākṣānmahādevo vyavasthitaḥ //
1.104.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
शृणु वत्स प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणं स्कन्दसंज्ञकम् ।
यस्मिन्प्रतिपदं साक्षान्महादेवो व्यवस्थितः ॥
1.104.m: Brahmā said: / Listen, child! I shall proclaim the Purāṇa named Skanda, / wherein at every step Mahādeva himself is directly situated.

1.104.s:
purāṇe śatakoṭo tu yacchaivaṃ varṇitaṃ mayā /
lakṣaṃ tasyārthaṃ jātasya sāro vyāsena kīrtitaḥ //
1.104.d:
पुराणे शतकोटो तु यच्छैवं वर्णितं मया ।
लक्षं तस्यार्थं जातस्य सारो व्यासेन कीर्तितः ॥
1.104.m: In the Purāṇa of one hundred crores [of verses], the Śaiva portion described by me / has its essence, amounting to one hundred thousand [verses], proclaimed by Vyāsa.

1.104.s:
skandāhvayastatra khaṇḍāḥ saptaiva parikalpitāḥ /
ekāśītisahasraṃ tu skāndaṃ sarvoghakṛtaṃnam //
1.104.d:
स्कन्दाह्वयस्तत्र खण्डाः सप्तैव परिकल्पिताः ।
एकाशीतिसहस्रं तु स्कान्दं सर्वोघकृतंनम् ॥
1.104.m: In that [work] named after Skanda, seven sections are established; / the Skānda consists of eighty-one thousand [verses], destroying all floods of sin.

1.104.s:
yaḥ śṛṇoti paṭhedvāpi sa tu sākṣācchivaḥ sthitaḥ /
yatra māheśvarā dharmāḥ ṣaṇmukhena prakāśitāḥ //
1.104.d:
यः शृणोति पठेद्वापि स तु साक्षाच्छिवः स्थितः ।
यत्र माहेश्वरा धर्माः षण्मुखेन प्रकाशिताः ॥
1.104.m: Whoever hears or recites it remains as Śiva directly. / In it, the duties belonging to Maheśvara are revealed by the Six-Faced One,

1.104.s:
kalpe tatpuruṣe vṛttāḥ sarvasiddhividhāyakāḥ /
tasya māheśvaraścātha khaṇḍaḥ pāpapraṇāśanaḥ //
1.104.d:
कल्पे तत्पुरुषे वृत्ताः सर्वसिद्धिविधायकाः ।
तस्य माहेश्वरश्चाथ खण्डः पापप्रणाशनः ॥
1.104.m: which occurred in the Tatpuruṣa Kalpa and bestow all perfections. / Its Māheśvara section, destroying sin,

1.104.s:
kiñcinnyūnārkasāhasro bahupuṇyo bṛhatkathaḥ /
sucaritraśatairyuktaḥ skandamāhātmyasūcakaḥ //
1.104.d:
किञ्चिन्न्यूनार्कसाहस्रो बहुपुण्यो बृहत्कथः ।
सुचरित्रशतैर्युक्तः स्कन्दमाहात्म्यसूचकः ॥
1.104.m: consists of slightly less than twelve thousand [verses], has great merit and extensive tales, / is accompanied by hundreds of virtuous deeds, and indicates the eulogy of greatness of Skanda.

1.104.s:
yatra kedāramāhātmye purāṇopakramaḥ purā /
dakṣayajñakathā paścācchivaliṅgārcane phalam //
1.104.d:
यत्र केदारमाहात्म्ये पुराणोपक्रमः पुरा ।
दक्षयज्ञकथा पश्चाच्छिवलिङ्गार्चने फलम् ॥
1.104.m: Wherein, in the eulogy of greatness of Kedāra, the Purāṇa initially begins; / after that the story of Dakṣa's sacrifice, and the fruit in worshipping the liṅga of Śiva;

1.104.s:
samudramathanākhyānaṃ devendracaritaṃ tataḥ /
pārvatyāḥ samupākhyānaṃ vivāhastadanantaram //
1.104.d:
समुद्रमथनाख्यानं देवेन्द्रचरितं ततः ।
पार्वत्याः समुपाख्यानं विवाहस्तदनन्तरम् ॥
1.104.m: the narrative of the churning of the ocean, and then the deeds of the lord of the gods; / the narrative of Pārvatī, and immediately after that the marriage;

1.104.s:
kumārotpattikathanaṃ tatastārakasaṃgaraḥ /
tataḥ pāśupatākhyānaṃ caṇḍākhyānasamanvitam //
1.104.d:
कुमारोत्पत्तिकथनं ततस्तारकसंगरः ।
ततः पाशुपताख्यानं चण्डाख्यानसमन्वितम् ॥
1.104.m: the telling of Kumāra's birth, and then the battle with Tāraka; / then the narrative of the Pāśupata, accompanied by the story of Caṇḍa;

1.104.s:
dyūtapravartanākhyānaṃ nāradena samāgamaḥ /
tataḥ kumāramāhātmye pañcatīrthakathānakam //
1.104.d:
द्यूतप्रवर्तनाख्यानं नारदेन समागमः ।
ततः कुमारमाहात्म्ये पञ्चतीर्थकथानकम् ॥
1.104.m: the narrative of the gambling match, the encounter with Nārada; / then, in the eulogy of greatness of Kumāra, the story of the Five Fords;

1.104.s:
dharmavarmanṛpākhyānaṃ nadīsāgarakīrtanam /
indradyumnakathā paścānnāḍījaṅghakathānvitam //
1.104.d:
धर्मवर्मनृपाख्यानं नदीसागरकीर्तनम् ।
इन्द्रद्युम्नकथा पश्चान्नाडीजङ्घकथान्वितम् ॥
1.104.m: the narrative of King Dharmavarman, the mention of the river and the ocean; / after that the story of Indradyumna, accompanied by the story of Nāḍījaṅgha;

1.104.s:
prādurbhāvastato mahyāḥ kathā damanakasya ca /
mahīsāgarasaṃyogaḥ kumāreśakathā tataḥ //
1.104.d:
प्रादुर्भावस्ततो मह्याः कथा दमनकस्य च ।
महीसागरसंयोगः कुमारेशकथा ततः ॥
1.104.m: then the manifestation of the Earth, and the story of Damanaka; / the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean, and then the story of Kumāreśa;

1.104.s:
tatastārakayuddhaṃ ca nānākhyānasamanvitam /
vadhaśca tārakasyātha pañcaliṅganiveśanam //
1.104.d:
ततस्तारकयुद्धं च नानाख्यानसमन्वितम् ।
वधश्च तारकस्याथ पञ्चलिङ्गनिवेशनम् ॥
1.104.m: then the battle with Tāraka, accompanied by various narratives, / and the slaying of Tāraka, and then the installation of the five liṅgas;

1.104.s:
dvīpākhyānaṃ tataḥ puṇyamūrddhalokavyavasthitiḥ /
brahmāṇḍasthitimānaṃ ca varkareśakathānakam //
1.104.d:
द्वीपाख्यानं ततः पुण्यमूर्द्धलोकव्यवस्थितिः ।
ब्रह्माण्डस्थितिमानं च वर्करेशकथानकम् ॥
1.104.m: then the holy narrative of the continents, the arrangement of the upper worlds, / the measure and state of the cosmic egg, and the story of Varkareśa;

1.104.s:
mahākālasamudbhūtiḥ kathā cāsya mahādbhutā /
vāsudevasya māhātmyaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ tataḥ param //
1.104.d:
महाकालसमुद्भूतिः कथा चास्य महाद्भुता ।
वासुदेवस्य माहात्म्यं कोटितीर्थं ततः परम् ॥
1.104.m: the origin of Mahākāla, and his most wonderful story; / the eulogy of greatness of Vāsudeva, and after that Koṭitīrtha;

1.104.s:
nānātīrthasamākhyānaṃ guptakṣetre prakīrtitam /
pāṇḍavānāṃ kathā puṇyā mahāvidyāprasādhanam //
1.104.d:
नानातीर्थसमाख्यानं गुप्तक्षेत्रे प्रकीर्तितम् ।
पाण्डवानां कथा पुण्या महाविद्याप्रसाधनम् ॥
1.104.m: the narration of various sacred fords, proclaimed in the hidden sacred field; / the holy story of the Pāṇḍavas, and the accomplishment of the great knowledge;

1.104.s:
tīrthayātrāsamāptiśca kaumāramidamadbhutam /
aruṇācalamāhātmyaṃ sanakabrahmasaṃkathā //
1.104.d:
तीर्थयात्रासमाप्तिश्च कौमारमिदमद्भुतम् ।
अरुणाचलमाहात्म्यं सनकब्रह्मसंकथा ॥
1.104.m: and the conclusion of the pilgrimage to sacred fords—this is the wonderful section on Kumāra; / the eulogy of greatness of Aruṇācala, and the conversation between Sanaka and Brahmā;

1.104.s:
gaurītapaḥ samākhyānaṃ tattattīrthanirūpaṇam /
māhiṣāsuramākhyānaṃ vadhaścāsya mahādbhutaḥ //
1.104.d:
गौरीतपः समाख्यानं तत्तत्तीर्थनिरूपणम् ।
माहिषासुरमाख्यानं वधश्चास्य महाद्भुतः ॥
1.104.m: the narrative of Gaurī's penance, the determination of respective sacred fords; / the narrative of the buffalo-demon, and his most wonderful slaying;

1.104.s:
droṇācale śivāsthānaṃ nityadāparikīrtitam /
ityeṣa kathitaḥ skānde khaṇḍo māheśvaro 'dbhutaḥ //
1.104.d:
द्रोणाचले शिवास्थानं नित्यदापरिकीर्तितम् ।
इत्येष कथितः स्कान्दे खण्डो माहेश्वरो ऽद्भुतः ॥
1.104.m: the seat of Śivā on Mount Droṇa, proclaimed as eternal. / Thus this wonderful Māheśvara section in the Skānda has been told.

1.104.s:
dvitīyo vaiṣṇavaḥ khaṇḍastasyākhyānāni me śuṇu /
prathamaṃ bhūmivārāhasamākhyānaṃ prakīrtitam //
1.104.d:
द्वितीयो वैष्णवः खण्डस्तस्याख्यानानि मे शुणु ।
प्रथमं भूमिवाराहसमाख्यानं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
1.104.m: Hear from me the second section, the Vaiṣṇava, and its narratives! / First, the narrative of the Earth and the Boar is proclaimed,

1.104.s:
yatra veṅkaṭakudhrasya māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam /
kamalāyāḥ kathā puṇyā śrīnivāsasthitistataḥ //
1.104.d:
यत्र वेङ्कटकुध्रस्य माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ।
कमलायाः कथा पुण्या श्रीनिवासस्थितिस्ततः ॥
1.104.m: wherein is the sin-destroying eulogy of greatness of Mount Veṅkaṭa, / the holy story of Kamalā, and then the residence of Śrīnivāsa.

1.104.s:
kulā lākhyānakaṃ cātra suvarṇamukharī kathā /
nānākhyānasamāyuktā bhāradvājakathādbhutā //
1.104.d:
कुला लाख्यानकं चात्र सुवर्णमुखरी कथा ।
नानाख्यानसमायुक्ता भारद्वाजकथाद्भुता ॥
1.104.m: and here the narrative of the potter, the story of the Suvarṇamukharī, / and the wondrous story of Bhāradvāja, accompanied by diverse narratives;

1.104.s:
mataṅgāñjanasaṃvādaḥ kīrtitaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ /
puruṣottamamāhātmyaṃ kīrtitaṃ cotkale tataḥ //
1.104.d:
मतङ्गाञ्जनसंवादः कीर्तितः पापनाशनः ।
पुरुषोत्तममाहात्म्यं कीर्तितं चोत्कले ततः ॥
1.104.m: the dialogue between Mataṅga and Añjana, destroying sins, is related; / then the eulogy of the greatness of Puruṣottama in Utkala is recounted;

1.104.s:
mārkaṇḍeyasamākhyānamaṃbarīṣasya bhūpateḥ /
indradyumnasya cākhyānaṃ vidyāpatikathā śubhā //
1.104.d:
मार्कण्डेयसमाख्यानमंबरीषस्य भूपतेः ।
इन्द्रद्युम्नस्य चाख्यानं विद्यापतिकथा शुभा ॥
1.104.m: the narrative of Mārkaṇḍeya, and of King Ambarīṣa, / and the narrative of Indradyumna, and the auspicious story of Vidyāpati;

1.104.s:
jaimineḥ samupākhyānaṃ nāradasyāpi vāḍava /
nīlakaṇṭhasamākhyānaṃ narasiṃhopavarṇanam //
1.104.d:
जैमिनेः समुपाख्यानं नारदस्यापि वाडव ।
नीलकण्ठसमाख्यानं नरसिंहोपवर्णनम् ॥
1.104.m: the full account of Jaimini, and also of Nārada, O brahmin; / the narrative of Nīlakaṇṭha, and the description of Narasiṃha;

1.104.s:
aśvamedhakathā rājño brahmalokagatistathā /
rathayāvrāvidhiḥ paścājjanmasthānavidhistathā //
1.104.d:
अश्वमेधकथा राज्ञो ब्रह्मलोकगतिस्तथा ।
रथयाव्राविधिः पश्चाज्जन्मस्थानविधिस्तथा ॥
1.104.m: the story of the king's horse-sacrifice, and his going to the world of Brahmā; / then the rite of the chariot-procession, and likewise the rite of the birthplace;

1.104.s:
dakṣiṇāmūrtyupākhyānaṃ guṇḍivākhyānakaṃ tataḥ /
ratharakṣāvidhānaṃ ca śayanotsavakīrtanam //
1.104.d:
दक्षिणामूर्त्युपाख्यानं गुण्डिवाख्यानकं ततः ।
रथरक्षाविधानं च शयनोत्सवकीर्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: the account of Dakṣiṇāmūrti, then the narrative of Guṇḍivā, / and the performance of chariot protection, and the proclamation of the sleeping festival;

1.104.s:
śvetopākhyānamatroktaṃ pṛthutsavanirūpaṇam /
dolotsavo bhagavato vrataṃ sāṃvatsarābhidham //
1.104.d:
श्वेतोपाख्यानमत्रोक्तं पृथुत्सवनिरूपणम् ।
दोलोत्सवो भगवतो व्रतं सांवत्सराभिधम् ॥
1.104.m: the account of Śveta is declared here, the determination of the major festival, / the swing festival of the Lord, and the vow called the annual [vow];

1.104.s:
pūjā cākāmikā viṣṇoruddālakaniyogataḥ /
yogasādhanamatroktaṃ nānāyoganirūpaṇam //
1.104.d:
पूजा चाकामिका विष्णोरुद्दालकनियोगतः ।
योगसाधनमत्रोक्तं नानायोगनिरूपणम् ॥
1.104.m: and desireless worship of Viṣṇu by the appointment of Uddālaka; / the practice of yoga is declared here, and the determination of various yogas;

1.104.s:
daśāvatārakathanaṃ srānādiparikīrtanam /
tato badarikāyāśca māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam //
1.104.d:
दशावतारकथनं स्रानादिपरिकीर्तनम् ।
ततो बदरिकायाश्च माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ॥
1.104.m: the declaration of the ten avatars, the proclamation of ablutions and the like, / and then the sin-destroying eulogy of the greatness of Badarikā;

1.104.s:
agnyāditīrthamāhātmyaṃ vainateyaśilābhavam /
kāraṇaṃ bhagavadvāse tīrthaṃ kāpālamocanam //
1.104.d:
अग्न्यादितीर्थमाहात्म्यं वैनतेयशिलाभवम् ।
कारणं भगवद्वासे तीर्थं कापालमोचनम् ॥
1.104.m: the eulogy of the greatness of the sacred fords beginning with Agni, originating from the Vainateya rock; / the reason for the Lord's residence, and the sacred ford Kapālamocana;

1.104.s:
pañcadhārābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ merusaṃsthāpanaṃ tathā /
tataḥ kārtikamāhātmye māhātmyaṃ madanālasam //
1.104.d:
पञ्चधाराभिधं तीर्थं मेरुसंस्थापनं तथा ।
ततः कार्तिकमाहात्म्ये माहात्म्यं मदनालसम् ॥
1.104.m: the sacred ford called Pañcadhārā, and likewise the establishment of Meru; / then, in the eulogy of the greatness of Kārtika, the eulogy of greatness concerning Madanālasa;

1.104.s:
dhūmrakeśasamākhyānaṃ dinakṛtyāni kartike /
pañcabhīṣmavratākhyānaṃ kīrtitaṃ bhuktimuktidam //
1.104.d:
धूम्रकेशसमाख्यानं दिनकृत्यानि कर्तिके ।
पञ्चभीष्मव्रताख्यानं कीर्तितं भुक्तिमुक्तिदम् ॥
1.104.m: the narrative of Dhūmrakeśa, daily duties in Kārtika, / and the narrative of the five-day Bhīṣma vow, granting worldly enjoyment and liberation, is recounted;

1.104.s:
tato mārgasya māhātmye vidhānaṃ snānajaṃ tathā /
puṇḍrādikīrtanaṃ cātra mālādhāraṇapuṇyakam //
1.104.d:
ततो मार्गस्य माहात्म्ये विधानं स्नानजं तथा ।
पुण्ड्रादिकीर्तनं चात्र मालाधारणपुण्यकम् ॥
1.104.m: then, in the eulogy of the greatness of Mārgaśīrṣa, the rule of bath-born [merit] and the like; / and here the praise of sectarian marks and the like, and the merit of wearing garlands;

1.104.s:
pañcāmṛtasnānapuṇyaṃ ghaṇṭānādādijaṃ phalam /
nānāpuṣpārcanaphalaṃ tulasīdalajaṃ phalam //
1.104.d:
पञ्चामृतस्नानपुण्यं घण्टानादादिजं फलम् ।
नानापुष्पार्चनफलं तुलसीदलजं फलम् ॥
1.104.m: the merit of bathing in the five nectars, the fruit arising from the ringing of bells and the like, / the fruit of worshipping with various flowers, and the fruit arising from basil leaves;

1.104.s:
naivedyasya ca māhātmyaṃ harivāsarakīrtanam /
akhaṇḍaikādaśīpuṇyaṃ tathā jāgaraṇasya ca //
1.104.d:
नैवेद्यस्य च माहात्म्यं हरिवासरकीर्तनम् ।
अखण्डैकादशीपुण्यं तथा जागरणस्य च ॥
1.104.m: the eulogy of the greatness of food-offerings, the praise of Hari's day, / the merit of unbroken Ekādaśī, and likewise of keeping vigil;

1.104.s:
yasyotsavavidhānaṃ ca nāmamāhātmyakīrtanam /
dhyānādipuṇyakathanaṃ māhātmyaṃ mathurābhavam //
1.104.d:
यस्योत्सवविधानं च नाममाहात्म्यकीर्तनम् ।
ध्यानादिपुण्यकथनं माहात्म्यं मथुराभवम् ॥
1.104.m: and the rule for his festival, the celebration of the eulogy of the greatness of the Name, / the declaration of the merit of meditation and the like, and the eulogy of the greatness belonging to Mathurā;

1.104.s:
mathurātīrthamāhātmyaṃ pṛthaguktaṃ tataḥ param /
vanānāṃ dvādaśānāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ kīrtitaṃ tataḥ //
1.104.d:
मथुरातीर्थमाहात्म्यं पृथगुक्तं ततः परम् ।
वनानां द्वादशानां च माहात्म्यं कीर्तितं ततः ॥
1.104.m: after that, the eulogy of the greatness of the sacred fords of Mathurā is declared separately; / then the eulogy of the greatness of the twelve forests is proclaimed;

1.104.s:
śrīmadbhāgavatasyātra māhātmyaṃ kīrtitaṃ param /
vajraśāṇḍilyasaṃvāda antarlīlāprakāśakam //
1.104.d:
श्रीमद्भागवतस्यात्र माहात्म्यं कीर्तितं परम् ।
वज्रशाण्डिल्यसंवाद अन्तर्लीलाप्रकाशकम् ॥
1.104.m: here the supreme eulogy of the greatness of the Śrīmad Bhāgavata is recounted; / the dialogue between Vajra and Śāṇḍilya revealing the inner pastimes;

1.104.s:
tato māghasya māhātmyaṃ snānadānajapodbhavam /
nānākhyānasamāyuktaṃ daśādhyāyairnirūpitam //
1.104.d:
ततो माघस्य माहात्म्यं स्नानदानजपोद्भवम् ।
नानाख्यानसमायुक्तं दशाध्यायैर्निरूपितम् ॥
1.104.m: then the eulogy of the greatness of Māgha, arising from bath, gift, and recitation, / accompanied by various narratives, is set forth in ten chapters;

1.104.s:
tato vaiṣṇavamāhātmye śayyādānādijaṃ phalam /
jaladā nādividhayaḥ kāmākhyānamataḥ param //
1.104.d:
ततो वैष्णवमाहात्म्ये शय्यादानादिजं फलम् ।
जलदा नादिविधयः कामाख्यानमतः परम् ॥
1.104.m: then, in the eulogy of the greatness of the Vaiṣṇava [month], the fruit arising from the gift of a bed and the like, / the rites of giving water and the like, and after this the narrative of Kāma;

1.104.s:
śrutadevasya caritaṃ vyādhopākhyānamadbhutam /
tathākṣayatṛtīyāderviśeṣātpuṇyakīrtanam //
1.104.d:
श्रुतदेवस्य चरितं व्याधोपाख्यानमद्भुतम् ।
तथाक्षयतृतीयादेर्विशेषात्पुण्यकीर्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: the life of Śrutadeva, the wondrous narrative of the hunter, / and likewise the celebration of merit especially from Akṣayatṛtīyā onwards;

1.104.s:
tatastvayodhyāmāhātmye cakrabrahmāhvatīrthake /
surāpāpavimokṣākhye tathādhārasahasrakam //
1.104.d:
ततस्त्वयोध्यामाहात्म्ये चक्रब्रह्माह्वतीर्थके ।
सुरापापविमोक्षाख्ये तथाधारसहस्रकम् ॥
1.104.m: then, in the eulogy of the greatness of Ayodhyā, the sacred fords named Cakra and Brahmā, / that called the Release from the Sin of Drinking Liquor, and likewise the Sahasradhāra.

1.104.s:
svargadvāraṃ candraharidharmaharyupavarṇanam /
svarṇavṛṣṭerupākhyānaṃ tilodāsarayūyutiḥ //
1.104.d:
स्वर्गद्वारं चन्द्रहरिधर्महर्युपवर्णनम् ।
स्वर्णवृष्टेरुपाख्यानं तिलोदासरयूयुतिः ॥
1.104.m: The description of Svargadvāra, Candrahari, and Dharmahari; / the story of the rain of gold, [and] the confluence of the Tilodā and the Sarayū;

1.104.s:
sītākuṇḍaṃ guptaharisaraṃyughargharānvayaḥ /
gopratāraṃ ca dugdhodaṃ gurukuṇḍādipañcakam //
1.104.d:
सीताकुण्डं गुप्तहरिसरंयुघर्घरान्वयः ।
गोप्रतारं च दुग्धोदं गुरुकुण्डादिपञ्चकम् ॥
1.104.m: Sītākuṇḍa, Guptahari, the junction of the Sarayū and the Ghargharā, / Gopratāra, Dugdhoda, and the group of five beginning with Gurukuṇḍa;

1.104.s:
somārkā dīni tīrthāni trayodaśa tataḥ param /
gayākūpasya māhātmyaṃ sarvāghavinivartakam //
1.104.d:
सोमार्का दीनि तीर्थानि त्रयोदश ततः परम् ।
गयाकूपस्य माहात्म्यं सर्वाघविनिवर्तकम् ॥
1.104.m: next, the thirteen sacred fords beginning with Soma and Arka; / [and] the eulogy of greatness of Gayākūpa, which removes all sins;

1.104.s:
māṇḍavyāśramapūrvāṇi tīrthāni tadanantaram /
ajitādi mānasāditīrthāni gaditāni ca //
1.104.d:
माण्डव्याश्रमपूर्वाणि तीर्थानि तदनन्तरम् ।
अजितादि मानसादितीर्थानि गदितानि च ॥
1.104.m: thereafter, the sacred fords beginning with Māṇḍavya's hermitage; / and the sacred fords beginning with Ajita and Mānasa are spoken of.

1.104.s:
ityeṣa vaiṣṇavaḥ khaṇḍo dvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ /
ataḥ paraṃ brahmakhaṇḍaṃ marīce śṛṇu puṇyadam //
1.104.d:
इत्येष वैष्णवः खण्डो द्वितीयः परिकीर्तितः ।
अतः परं ब्रह्मखण्डं मरीचे शृणु पुण्यदम् ॥
1.104.m: Thus this second Vaiṣṇava section has been proclaimed. / Hereafter, O son of Marīci, listen to the merit-yielding Brahma section,

1.104.s:
yatra vai setumāhātmye phalaṃ snāne kṣaṇodbhavam /
gālavasya tapaścaryā rākṣasākhyānakaṃ tataḥ //
1.104.d:
यत्र वै सेतुमाहात्म्ये फलं स्नाने क्षणोद्भवम् ।
गालवस्य तपश्चर्या राक्षसाख्यानकं ततः ॥
1.104.m: wherein indeed, in the eulogy of greatness of the Setu, the fruit arising instantly from bathing [is told]; / [then] the ascetic practice of Gālava, and next the tale of the Rākṣasa;

1.104.s:
cakratīrthādimāhātmyaṃ devīpattanasaṃyute /
vetālatīrthamahimā pāpanāśādikīrtanam //
1.104.d:
चक्रतीर्थादिमाहात्म्यं देवीपत्तनसंयुते ।
वेतालतीर्थमहिमा पापनाशादिकीर्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: the eulogy of greatness of Cakratīrtha and others in connection with Devīpattana, / the grandeur of Vetālatīrtha, [and] the proclamation of the destruction of sins and so forth;

1.104.s:
maṅgalādikamāhātmyaṃ brahmakuṇḍādivarṇanam /
hanumatkuṇḍamahimāgastyatīrthabhavaṃ phalam //
1.104.d:
मङ्गलादिकमाहात्म्यं ब्रह्मकुण्डादिवर्णनम् ।
हनुमत्कुण्डमहिमागस्त्यतीर्थभवं फलम् ॥
1.104.m: the eulogy of greatness of Maṅgala and others, the description of Brahmakuṇḍa and others, / the grandeur of Hanumatkuṇḍa, and the fruit arising from Agastyatīrtha;

1.104.s:
rāmatīrthādikathanaṃ lakṣmītīrthanirūpaṇam /
śaṅkhāditīrthamahimā tathā sādhyāmṛtādijaḥ //
1.104.d:
रामतीर्थादिकथनं लक्ष्मीतीर्थनिरूपणम् ।
शङ्खादितीर्थमहिमा तथा साध्यामृतादिजः ॥
1.104.m: the narration of Rāmatīrtha and others, the explanation of Lakṣmītīrtha, / the grandeur of Śaṅkha and other sacred fords, as well as that arising from Sādhyāmṛta and others;

1.104.s:
dhanuṣkoṭyādimāhātmyaṃ kṣīrakuṇḍādijaṃ tathā /
gāyatryādikatīrthānāṃ māhātmyaṃ cātra kīrtitam //
1.104.d:
धनुष्कोट्यादिमाहात्म्यं क्षीरकुण्डादिजं तथा ।
गायत्र्यादिकतीर्थानां माहात्म्यं चात्र कीर्तितम् ॥
1.104.m: the eulogy of greatness of Dhanuṣkoṭi and others, likewise that arising from Kṣīrakuṇḍa and others; / and the eulogy of greatness of the sacred fords beginning with Gāyatrī is proclaimed here;

1.104.s:
rāmanāthasya mahimā tattvajñānopadeśanam /
yātrāvidhānakathanaṃ setai muktipradaṃ nṛṇām //
1.104.d:
रामनाथस्य महिमा तत्त्वज्ञानोपदेशनम् ।
यात्राविधानकथनं सेतै मुक्तिप्रदं नृणाम् ॥
1.104.m: the grandeur of Rāmanātha, the instruction in knowledge of reality, / the account of the rules of pilgrimage to the Setu, which grants liberation to men;

1.104.s:
dharmāraṇyasya māhātmyaṃ tataḥ paramudīritam /
sthāṇuḥ skandāya bhagavānyatra tattvamupādiśat //
1.104.d:
धर्मारण्यस्य माहात्म्यं ततः परमुदीरितम् ।
स्थाणुः स्कन्दाय भगवान्यत्र तत्त्वमुपादिशत् ॥
1.104.m: next, the eulogy of greatness of Dharmāraṇya is declared, / where the Lord Sthāṇu instructed Skanda in the truth;

1.104.s:
dharmāraṇyasusaṃbhūtistatpuṇyaparikīrttanam /
karṃmasiddheḥ samākhyānaṃ ṛṣivaṃśanirūpaṇam //
1.104.d:
धर्मारण्यसुसंभूतिस्तत्पुण्यपरिकीर्त्तनम् ।
कर्ंमसिद्धेः समाख्यानं ऋषिवंशनिरूपणम् ॥
1.104.m: the origin of Dharmāraṇya, the proclamation of its merit, / the narrative of the perfection of rites, and the account of the lineages of the ṛṣis;

1.104.s:
apsarastīrthamukhyānāṃ māhātmyaṃ yatra kīrtitam /
varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca dharmatattvanirūpaṇam //
1.104.d:
अप्सरस्तीर्थमुख्यानां माहात्म्यं यत्र कीर्तितम् ।
वर्णानामाश्रमाणां च धर्मतत्त्वनिरूपणम् ॥
1.104.m: wherein the eulogy of greatness of the foremost sacred fords beginning with Apsarastīrtha is proclaimed, / and the explanation of the essential duties of the castes and life-stages;

1.104.s:
divaḥ sthānavibhāgaśca bakulārkakathā śubhā /
chatrānandā tathā śāntā śrīmātā ca mataṅginī //
1.104.d:
दिवः स्थानविभागश्च बकुलार्ककथा शुभा ।
छत्रानन्दा तथा शान्ता श्रीमाता च मतङ्गिनी ॥
1.104.m: the division of the realms of heaven, and the auspicious story of Bakulārka; / Chatrānandā, Śāntā, Śrīmātā, Mataṅginī,

1.104.s:
puṇyadā ca samākhyātā yatra devyaḥ samāsthitāḥ /
indreśvarādimāhātmyaṃ dvārakādinirūpaṇam //
1.104.d:
पुण्यदा च समाख्याता यत्र देव्यः समास्थिताः ।
इन्द्रेश्वरादिमाहात्म्यं द्वारकादिनिरूपणम् ॥
1.104.m: and Puṇyadā are recounted, where the goddesses dwell; / the eulogy of greatness of Indreśvara and others, and the description of Dvārakā and others;

1.104.s:
lohāsurasamākhyānaṃ gaṅgākūpanirūpaṇam /
śrīrāmacaritaṃ caiva satyamandiravarṇanam //
1.104.d:
लोहासुरसमाख्यानं गङ्गाकूपनिरूपणम् ।
श्रीरामचरितं चैव सत्यमन्दिरवर्णनम् ॥
1.104.m: the story of the Asura Loha, the explanation of Gaṅgākūpa, / the deeds of Śrī Rāma, and the description of Satyamandira;

1.104.s:
jīrṇoddhā rasya kathanamāsanapratipādanam /
jātibhedaprakathanaṃ smṛtidharmanirūpaṇam //
1.104.d:
जीर्णोद्धा रस्य कथनमासनप्रतिपादनम् ।
जातिभेदप्रकथनं स्मृतिधर्मनिरूपणम् ॥
1.104.m: the discourse on renovating what is dilapidated, the presentation of seats, / the exposition of the distinctions among castes, and the determination of the dharma of the Smṛtis;

1.104.s:
tatastu vaiṣṇavā dharmā nānākhyānairudīritāḥ /
cāturmāsye tataḥ puṇye sarvadhamanirūpaṇam //
1.104.d:
ततस्तु वैष्णवा धर्मा नानाख्यानैरुदीरिताः ।
चातुर्मास्ये ततः पुण्ये सर्वधमनिरूपणम् ॥
1.104.m: then the Vaiṣṇava practices are declared through various narratives; / then, in the auspicious Cāturmāsya, the determination of all duties;

1.104.s:
dānapraśaṃsā tatpaścādvratasya mahimā tataḥ /
tapaścaiva pūjāyāḥ sacchidrakathanaṃ tataḥ //
1.104.d:
दानप्रशंसा तत्पश्चाद्व्रतस्य महिमा ततः ।
तपश्चैव पूजायाः सच्छिद्रकथनं ततः ॥
1.104.m: the praise of giving, next the grandeur of the vow, / austerity, and the exposition of defects in worship;

1.104.s:
tadvṛttīnāṃ bhidākhyānaṃ śālagrāmanirūpaṇam /
bhārakasya vadhopāyo vṛkṣācāmahimā tathā //
1.104.d:
तद्वृत्तीनां भिदाख्यानं शालग्रामनिरूपणम् ।
भारकस्य वधोपायो वृक्षाचामहिमा तथा ॥
1.104.m: the account of the varieties of their livelihoods, the description of the Śālagrāma, / the means to slay Bhāraka, and the grandeur of the Vṛkṣācā;

1.104.s:
viṣṇoḥ śāpaśca vṛkṣatvaṃ pārvatyanutapastataḥ /
harasya tāṇḍavaṃ nṛtyaṃ rāmanāmanirūpaṇam //
1.104.d:
विष्णोः शापश्च वृक्षत्वं पार्वत्यनुतपस्ततः ।
हरस्य ताण्डवं नृत्यं रामनामनिरूपणम् ॥
1.104.m: Viṣṇu's curse and turn into a tree, then Pārvatī's repentance, / Hara's tāṇḍava dance, [and] the exposition of the name of Rāma;

1.104.s:
harasya liṅgapatanaṃ kathā baijavanasya ca /
pārvatījanmacaritaṃ tārakasya vadho 'dbhutaḥ //
1.104.d:
हरस्य लिङ्गपतनं कथा बैजवनस्य च ।
पार्वतीजन्मचरितं तारकस्य वधो ऽद्भुतः ॥
1.104.m: the falling of Hara's liṅga, and the story of Baijavana; / the narrative of Pārvatī's birth, [and] the wondrous slaying of Tāraka;

1.104.s:
praṇavaiśvaryakathanaṃ tārakācaritaṃ punaḥ /
dakṣayajñasamāptiśca dvādaśākṣarabhūṣaṇam //
1.104.d:
प्रणवैश्वर्यकथनं तारकाचरितं पुनः ।
दक्षयज्ञसमाप्तिश्च द्वादशाक्षरभूषणम् ॥
1.104.m: the discourse on the sovereign power of the Praṇava, again the story of Tāraka, / the completion of Dakṣa's sacrifice, and the ornament that is the twelve-syllable [mantra];

1.104.s:
jñānayogasamākhyānaṃ mahimā dvādaśākṣareḥ /
śravaṇādikapuṇyaṃ ca kīrtitaṃ śarmadaṃ nṛṇām //
1.104.d:
ज्ञानयोगसमाख्यानं महिमा द्वादशाक्षरेः ।
श्रवणादिकपुण्यं च कीर्तितं शर्मदं नृणाम् ॥
1.104.m: the exposition of the yoga of knowledge, the grandeur of the twelve-syllable [mantra], / and the merit gained from hearing and the rest, bestowing joy upon men, are proclaimed;

1.104.s:
tato brāhmottare bhāge śivasya mahimādbhutaḥ /
pañcākṣarasya mahimā gokarṇamahimā tataḥ //
1.104.d:
ततो ब्राह्मोत्तरे भागे शिवस्य महिमाद्भुतः ।
पञ्चाक्षरस्य महिमा गोकर्णमहिमा ततः ॥
1.104.m: then, in the Brāhmottara section, the wondrous grandeur of Śiva, / the grandeur of the five-syllable [mantra], and then the grandeur of Gokarṇa;

1.104.s:
śivarātraiśca mahimā pradoṣavra takīrtanam /
somavāravrataṃ cāpi sīmantinyāḥ kathānakam //
1.104.d:
शिवरात्रैश्च महिमा प्रदोषव्र तकीर्तनम् ।
सोमवारव्रतं चापि सीमन्तिन्याः कथानकम् ॥
1.104.m: the grandeur of Śivarātri, the proclamation of the Pradoṣa vow, / the Monday vow, and the story of Sīmantinī;

1.104.s:
bhadrāyutpattikathanaṃ sadācāranirūpaṇam /
śivavarmasamuddeśo bhadrāyūdvāhavarṇanam //
1.104.d:
भद्रायुत्पत्तिकथनं सदाचारनिरूपणम् ।
शिववर्मसमुद्देशो भद्रायूद्वाहवर्णनम् ॥
1.104.m: the account of the birth of Bhadrāyu, the determination of virtuous conduct, / the indication of Śiva's armor, and the description of Bhadrāyu's marriage;

1.104.s:
bhadrāyumahimā cāpi bhasmamāhātmyakīrtanam /
śabarākhyānakaṃ caiva umāmāheśvaraṃ vratam //
1.104.d:
भद्रायुमहिमा चापि भस्ममाहात्म्यकीर्तनम् ।
शबराख्यानकं चैव उमामाहेश्वरं व्रतम् ॥
1.104.m: the grandeur of Bhadrāyu, the proclamation of the eulogy of greatness of sacred ash, / the story of the Śabara, and the Umāmāheśvara vow;

1.104.s:
rudrākṣasya ca māhātmyaṃ rudrādhyāyasya puṇyakam /
śravaṇādikapuṇyaṃ ca brahmakhaṇḍo 'yamīritaḥ //
1.104.d:
रुद्राक्षस्य च माहात्म्यं रुद्राध्यायस्य पुण्यकम् ।
श्रवणादिकपुण्यं च ब्रह्मखण्डो ऽयमीरितः ॥
1.104.m: the eulogy of greatness of the rudrākṣa, the merit of the Rudrādhyāya, / and the merit of hearing and the like: thus this Brahma section has been declared.

1.104.s:
ataḥ paraṃ caturthaṃ tu kāśīkhaṇḍamanuttamam /
vindhyanāradayoryatra saṃvādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ //
1.104.d:
अतः परं चतुर्थं तु काशीखण्डमनुत्तमम् ।
विन्ध्यनारदयोर्यत्र संवादः परिकीर्तितः ॥
1.104.m: Hereafter, the fourth is the peerless Kāśī section, / wherein the dialogue between Vindhya and Nārada is related;

1.104.s:
satyalokaprabhāvaścāgastyāvāse surāgamaḥ /
pativratācaritraṃ ca tīrthayātrā praśaṃsanam //
1.104.d:
सत्यलोकप्रभावश्चागस्त्यावासे सुरागमः ।
पतिव्रताचरित्रं च तीर्थयात्रा प्रशंसनम् ॥
1.104.m: the power of Satyaloka, the arrival of the gods at Agastya's dwelling, / the life of the devoted wife, and the praise of pilgrimage to sacred fords;

1.104.s:
tataśca saptapuryākhyā saṃyaminyā nirūpaṇam /
budhasya ca tathendrāgnyorlokāptiḥ śivaśarmaṇaḥ //
1.104.d:
ततश्च सप्तपुर्याख्या संयमिन्या निरूपणम् ।
बुधस्य च तथेन्द्राग्न्योर्लोकाप्तिः शिवशर्मणः ॥
1.104.m: then the account of the seven cities, the description of Saṃyaminī, / and the attainment of the realms of Budha, Indra, and Agni by Śivaśarman;

1.104.s:
agneḥ samudbhavaścaiva kravyādvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ /
gandhavatyalakāpuryorīśvaryāśca samudbhavaḥ //
1.104.d:
अग्नेः समुद्भवश्चैव क्रव्याद्वरुणसंभवः ।
गन्धवत्यलकापुर्योरीश्वर्याश्च समुद्भवः ॥
1.104.m: the origin of Agni, the origin of Kravyād and Varuṇa, / and the origin of Gandhavatī, Alakāpurī, and Īśvarī;

1.104.s:
candrārkabudhalokānāṃ kujejyārkabhuvāṃ kramāt /
mama viṣṇordhruvasyāpi tapolokasya varṇanam //
1.104.d:
चन्द्रार्कबुधलोकानां कुजेज्यार्कभुवां क्रमात् ।
मम विष्णोर्ध्रुवस्यापि तपोलोकस्य वर्णनम् ॥
1.104.m: the description of the worlds of the Moon, Sun, and Mercury, and gradually of Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn, / of mine, of Viṣṇu, of Dhruva, and of Tapoloka;

1.104.s:
dhruvalokakathā puṇyā satyalokanirīkṣaṇam /
skandāgastyasamālāpo maṇikarṇīsamudbhavaḥ //
1.104.d:
ध्रुवलोककथा पुण्या सत्यलोकनिरीक्षणम् ।
स्कन्दागस्त्यसमालापो मणिकर्णीसमुद्भवः ॥
1.104.m: the sacred story of the realm of Dhruva, the sight of Satyaloka, / the conversation between Skanda and Agastya, [and] the origin of Maṇikarṇī;

1.104.s:
prabhāvaścāpi gaṅgāyā gaṅgānāmasahasrakam /
vārāṇasīpraśaṃsā ca bhairavāvirbhavastataḥ //
1.104.d:
प्रभावश्चापि गङ्गाया गङ्गानामसहस्रकम् ।
वाराणसीप्रशंसा च भैरवाविर्भवस्ततः ॥
1.104.m: the majesty of the Gaṅgā, the thousand names of the Gaṅgā, / the praise of Vārāṇasī, and then the manifestation of Bhairava;

1.104.s:
daṇḍapāṇijñānavāpyorudbhavaḥ samanantaram /
tataḥ kalāvatyākhyānaṃ sadācāranirūpaṇam //
1.104.d:
दण्डपाणिज्ञानवाप्योरुद्भवः समनन्तरम् ।
ततः कलावत्याख्यानं सदाचारनिरूपणम् ॥
1.104.m: immediately thereafter, the appearance of Daṇḍapāṇi and Jñānavāpī; / then the story of Kalāvatī, [and] the determination of virtuous conduct;

1.104.s:
brahmacārisamākhyānaṃ tataḥ strīlakṣaṇāni ca /
kṛtyākṛtyavinirdeśo hyavimukteśavarṇanam //
1.104.d:
ब्रह्मचारिसमाख्यानं ततः स्त्रीलक्षणानि च ।
कृत्याकृत्यविनिर्देशो ह्यविमुक्तेशवर्णनम् ॥
1.104.m: the discourse on the student of the Veda, then the marks of women, / the specification of what should and should not be done, and the description of Avimukteśa;

1.104.s:
gṛhasthayogino dharmāḥ kālajñānaṃ tataḥ param /
divodāsakathā puṇyā kāśikāvarṇanaṃ tataḥ //
1.104.d:
गृहस्थयोगिनो धर्माः कालज्ञानं ततः परम् ।
दिवोदासकथा पुण्या काशिकावर्णनं ततः ॥
1.104.m: the duties of the householder yogin, next the knowledge of time, / the sacred story of Divodāsa, and then the description of Kāśī;

1.104.s:
māyāgaṇapateścātha bhuvi prādurbhavastataḥ /
viṣṇumāyāprapañco 'tha divodāsavimokṣaṇam //
1.104.d:
मायागणपतेश्चाथ भुवि प्रादुर्भवस्ततः ।
विष्णुमायाप्रपञ्चो ऽथ दिवोदासविमोक्षणम् ॥
1.104.m: then the manifestation of Māyāgaṇapati upon the earth, / then the manifestation of Viṣṇu's māyā, and the liberation of Divodāsa;

1.104.s:
tataḥ pañcanadotparttirbindumādhavasaṃbhavaḥ /
tato vaiṣṇavatīrthākhyā śūlinaḥ kāśikāgamaḥ //
1.104.d:
ततः पञ्चनदोत्पर्त्तिर्बिन्दुमाधवसंभवः ।
ततो वैष्णवतीर्थाख्या शूलिनः काशिकागमः ॥
1.104.m: then the emergence of Pañcanada, the origin of Bindumādhava, / then the account of the Vaiṣṇava sacred fords, [and] the trident-bearer's arrival in Kāśī;

1.104.s:
jaigīṣavyena saṃvādo jyeṣṭheśākhyā maheśituḥ /
kṣetrākhyānaṃ kandukeśaḥ vyāghreśvarasamudbhavaḥ //
1.104.d:
जैगीषव्येन संवादो ज्येष्ठेशाख्या महेशितुः ।
क्षेत्राख्यानं कन्दुकेशः व्याघ्रेश्वरसमुद्भवः ॥
1.104.m: the dialogue with Jaigīṣavya, the narrative of Jyeṣṭheśa of the Great Lord, / the narrative of the sacred field, Kandukeśa, [and] the emergence of Vyāghreśvara;

1.104.s:
śaileśaratneśvarayoḥ kṛttivāsasya codbhavaḥ /
devatānāmadhiṣṭānaṃ durgāsuraparākramaḥ //
1.104.d:
शैलेशरत्नेश्वरयोः कृत्तिवासस्य चोद्भवः ।
देवतानामधिष्टानं दुर्गासुरपराक्रमः ॥
1.104.m: the emergence of Śaileśa and Ratneśvara, and of Kṛttivāsa, / the residences of the deities, [and] the prowess of the Asura Durgā;

1.104.s:
durgāyā vijayaścātha oṅkāreśasya varṇanam /
punarāeṅkāra māhātmya triloconasamudbhavaḥ //
1.104.d:
दुर्गाया विजयश्चाथ ओङ्कारेशस्य वर्णनम् ।
पुनराएङ्कार माहात्म्य त्रिलोचोनसमुद्भवः ॥
1.104.m: the victory of Durgā, then the description of Oṅkāreśa, / again the eulogy of greatness of Oṅkāra, [and] the emergence of Trilocana;

1.104.s:
kedārākhyā ca dharmeśa kathā viṣṇubhujodbhavā /
vīreśvarasamākhyānaṃ gaṅgāmāhātmyakīrtanam //
1.104.d:
केदाराख्या च धर्मेश कथा विष्णुभुजोद्भवा ।
वीरेश्वरसमाख्यानं गङ्गामाहात्म्यकीर्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: the story of Kedāra, Dharmeśa, and the story of the emergence from Viṣṇu's arm, / the narrative of Vīreśvara, and the proclamation of the eulogy of greatness of the Gaṅgā;

1.104.s:
viśvakarmeśamahimā dakṣayajñodbhavastathā /
satīśasyāmṛteśāderbhujastaṃbhaḥ parāśare //
1.104.d:
विश्वकर्मेशमहिमा दक्षयज्ञोद्भवस्तथा ।
सतीशस्यामृतेशादेर्भुजस्तंभः पराशरे ॥
1.104.m: the grandeur of Viśvakarmeśa, likewise the occurrence of Dakṣa's sacrifice, / Satīśa, Amṛteśa, and others, [and] the paralyzing of Parāśara's arm;

1.104.s:
kṣetratīrthakadaṃbaśca muktimaḍapasaṃkathā /
viśveśavibhavaścātha tato yātrāparikramaḥ //
ataḥ paraṃ tvavantyākhyaṃ śṛṇu khaṇḍa ca pañcamam ///
1.104.d:
क्षेत्रतीर्थकदंबश्च मुक्तिमडपसंकथा ।
विश्वेशविभवश्चाथ ततो यात्रापरिक्रमः ॥
अतः परं त्ववन्त्याख्यं शृणु खण्ड च पञ्चमम् ॥।
1.104.m:
the assemblage of sacred fields and sacred fords, the discourse on the Muktimaṇḍapa, / then the majesty of Viśveśa, and thereafter the circumambulatory pilgrimage route.

Beyond this, listen to the fifth section, named Avanti,

1.104.s: mahākālavanākhyānaṃ brahmaśīrṣacchidā tataḥ //
1.104.d: महाकालवनाख्यानं ब्रह्मशीर्षच्छिदा ततः ॥
1.104.m: the narrative of the Mahākāla forest, and then the severing of Brahmā's head.

1.104.s:
prāyaścittavidhiścāgnerutpattiśca surāgamaḥ /
devadīkṣā śivastotraṃ nānāpātakanāśanam //
1.104.d:
प्रायश्चित्तविधिश्चाग्नेरुत्पत्तिश्च सुरागमः ।
देवदीक्षा शिवस्तोत्रं नानापातकनाशनम् ॥
1.104.m: The rules for expiation, the origin of fire, the advent of the gods, / the initiation by the gods, and the hymn of praise to Śiva that destroys various sins;

1.104.s:
kapolamocanākhyānaṃ mahākālavanasthitiḥ /
tīrthaṃ kanakhaleśasya sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
1.104.d:
कपोलमोचनाख्यानं महाकालवनस्थितिः ।
तीर्थं कनखलेशस्य सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
1.104.m: the narrative of Kapolamocana, the presence of the forest of Mahākāla, / and the sacred ford of Kanakhaleśa that completely destroys all sins;

1.104.s:
kuṇḍamapsarasaṃjñaṃ ca saro rudrasya puṇyadam /
kuḍaveśaṃ ca vidyādhraṃ markaṭeśvaratīrthakam //
1.104.d:
कुण्डमप्सरसंज्ञं च सरो रुद्रस्य पुण्यदम् ।
कुडवेशं च विद्याध्रं मर्कटेश्वरतीर्थकम् ॥
1.104.m: the pool known as Apsaras, the merit-bestowing lake of Rudra, / Kuḍaveśa, the Vidyādhara [ford], and the sacred ford of Markaṭeśvara;

1.104.s:
svargadvāracatuḥsiṃdhutīrthaṃ śaṅkaravāpikā /
śaṅkarāka gandhavatītīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam //
1.104.d:
स्वर्गद्वारचतुःसिंधुतीर्थं शङ्करवापिका ।
शङ्कराक गन्धवतीतीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् ॥
1.104.m: Svargadvāra, the sacred ford of the Four Oceans, the Śaṅkara well, / Śaṅkarārka, and the sin-destroying sacred ford of Gandhavatī;

1.104.s:
daśāśvamedhikānaṃśatīrthe ca harisiddhidam /
piśācakādiyātrā ca hanumatkavaceśvarau //
1.104.d:
दशाश्वमेधिकानंशतीर्थे च हरिसिद्धिदम् ।
पिशाचकादियात्रा च हनुमत्कवचेश्वरौ ॥
1.104.m: the Daśāśvamedhika and Anaṃśa sacred fords, which grant accomplishment in Hari, / the pilgrimage beginning with Piśācaka, and the two lords Hanumat and Kavacīśvara;

1.104.s:
mahākāleśayātrā ca valmīkeśvaratīrthakam /
śukre ca pañcame cākhye kuśasthalyāḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ //
1.104.d:
महाकालेशयात्रा च वल्मीकेश्वरतीर्थकम् ।
शुक्रे च पञ्चमे चाख्ये कुशस्थल्याः प्रदक्षिणाः ॥
1.104.m: the pilgrimage to the lord Mahākāla, the sacred ford of Valmīkeśvara, / on Friday and on the fifth [tithi], the circumambulations of Kuśasthalī;

1.104.s:
akrūrasaṃjñakantvekapādaṃ candrārkavaibhavam /
karabheśākhyatīrthaṃ ca laṭukeśāditīrthakam //
1.104.d:
अक्रूरसंज्ञकन्त्वेकपादं चन्द्रार्कवैभवम् ।
करभेशाख्यतीर्थं च लटुकेशादितीर्थकम् ॥
1.104.m: the one named Akrūra, Ekapāda, the majesty of the Moon and the Sun, / the sacred ford known as Karabheśa, and the sacred fords beginning with Laṭukeśa;

1.104.s:
mārkaṇḍeśaṃ yajñavāpī someśaṃ narakāntakam /
kedāreśvararāmeśasaubhāgyeśanarārkakam //
1.104.d:
मार्कण्डेशं यज्ञवापी सोमेशं नरकान्तकम् ।
केदारेश्वररामेशसौभाग्येशनरार्ककम् ॥
1.104.m: Mārkaṇḍeśa, Yajñavāpī, Someśa, Narakāntaka, / Kedāreśvara, Rāmeśa, Saubhāgyeśa, and Narārka;

1.104.s:
keśavārkaṃ śaktibhedaṃ svarṇasāramukhāni ca /
oṅkāreśāditīrthāni andhakaśrutikīrtanam //
1.104.d:
केशवार्कं शक्तिभेदं स्वर्णसारमुखानि च ।
ओङ्कारेशादितीर्थानि अन्धकश्रुतिकीर्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: Keśavārka, the varieties of Śakti, the foremost sites such as Svarṇasāra, / the sacred fords beginning with Oṅkāreśa, and the narration of Andhaka's Vedic knowledge;

1.104.s:
kālāraṇye liṅgasaṃkhyā svarṇaśṛṅgābhidhānakam /
kuśasthalyā avantyāścojjayinyā abhidhānakam //
1.104.d:
कालारण्ये लिङ्गसंख्या स्वर्णशृङ्गाभिधानकम् ।
कुशस्थल्या अवन्त्याश्चोज्जयिन्या अभिधानकम् ॥
1.104.m: the number of liṅgas in Kālāraṇya, the name Svarṇaśṛṅga, / the names of Kuśasthalī, Avantī, and Ujjayinī;

1.104.s:
padmāvatīvai kumudvatyamarāvatināmakam /
viśālāpratikalpābhidhānaṃ ca jvaraśāntikam //
1.104.d:
पद्मावतीवै कुमुद्वत्यमरावतिनामकम् ।
विशालाप्रतिकल्पाभिधानं च ज्वरशान्तिकम् ॥
1.104.m: indeed Padmāvatī, Kumudvatī, the name Amarāvatī, / Viśālā, the different names in each aeon, and the appeasement of fever;

1.104.s:
śivānāmādikaphalaṃ nāgodgītā śivastutiḥ /
hiraṇyākṣavadhākhyānaṃ tīrthaṃ suṃdarakuṇḍakam //
1.104.d:
शिवानामादिकफलं नागोद्गीता शिवस्तुतिः ।
हिरण्याक्षवधाख्यानं तीर्थं सुंदरकुण्डकम् ॥
1.104.m: the fruit of the names of Śiva and the like, the hymn of praise to Śiva sung by the serpents, / the narrative of the slaying of Hiraṇyākṣa, and the sacred ford Sundarakuṇḍa;

1.104.s:
nīlagaṅgāpuṣkarākhyaṃ vindhyavāsanatīrthakam /
puruṣottamābhidhānaṃ tu tattīrthaṃ cāghanāśanam //
1.104.d:
नीलगङ्गापुष्कराख्यं विन्ध्यवासनतीर्थकम् ।
पुरुषोत्तमाभिधानं तु तत्तीर्थं चाघनाशनम् ॥
1.104.m: Nīlagaṅgā, the one named Puṣkara, the sacred ford Vindhyavāsana, / and the sacred ford named Puruṣottama, which destroys sins;

1.104.s:
gomatī vāmanaṃ kuṇḍo viṣṇornāmasahasrakam /
vīreśvarasaraḥ kālabhairavasya ca tīrthakam //
1.104.d:
गोमती वामनं कुण्डो विष्णोर्नामसहस्रकम् ।
वीरेश्वरसरः कालभैरवस्य च तीर्थकम् ॥
1.104.m: Gomatī, Vāmana, the pool, the Thousand Names of Viṣṇu, / the lake of Vīreśvara, and the sacred ford of Kālabhairava;

1.104.s:
mahimā nāgapañcamyā nṛsiṃhasya jayantikā /
kuṭumbeśvarayātrā ca devasādhakakīrtanam //
karkarājākhyatīrthaṃ ca vighneśādisurohanam //
1.104.d:
महिमा नागपञ्चम्या नृसिंहस्य जयन्तिका ।
कुटुम्बेश्वरयात्रा च देवसाधककीर्तनम् ॥
कर्कराजाख्यतीर्थं च विघ्नेशादिसुरोहनम् ॥
1.104.m:
the greatness of Nāgapañcamī, the birthday festival of Nṛsiṃha, / the pilgrimage to Kuṭumbeśvara, and the account of the divine practitioner;

the sacred ford named Karkarāja, and the rise of gods beginning with Vighneśa;

1.104.s: rundrakuṇḍaprabhṛtiṣu bahutīrthanirūpaṇam //
1.104.d: रुन्द्रकुण्डप्रभृतिषु बहुतीर्थनिरूपणम् ॥
1.104.m: the explanation of numerous sacred fords including Rudrakuṇḍa;

1.104.s:
yātrāṣṭatīrthajā puṇyā revāmāhātmyamucyate /
dharmaputrasya vairāgyo mārkaṇḍeyena saṃgamaḥ //
1.104.d:
यात्राष्टतीर्थजा पुण्या रेवामाहात्म्यमुच्यते ।
धर्मपुत्रस्य वैराग्यो मार्कण्डेयेन संगमः ॥
1.104.m: the meritorious pilgrimage born of the eight sacred fords, the eulogy of the greatness of the Revā, / the dispassion of the son of Dharma, and his meeting with Mārkaṇḍeya;

1.104.s:
prāgrīyānubhavākhyānamamṛtāparikīrttanam /
kalpe kalpe pṛthaṅ nāma narmadāyāḥ prakīrtitam //
1.104.d:
प्राग्रीयानुभवाख्यानममृतापरिकीर्त्तनम् ।
कल्पे कल्पे पृथङ् नाम नर्मदायाः प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
1.104.m: the narrative of past experience, the celebration of Amṛtā, / and the distinct name of the Narmadā taught in each aeon;

1.104.s:
stavamārṣaṃ nāmedaṃ ca kālarātrikathā tataḥ /
mahādevastutiḥ paścātpṛthakkalpakathādbhutā //
1.104.d:
स्तवमार्षं नामेदं च कालरात्रिकथा ततः ।
महादेवस्तुतिः पश्चात्पृथक्कल्पकथाद्भुता ॥
1.104.m: the hymn composed by the seers, this name, then the story of Kālarātri, / next the hymn of praise to Mahādeva, and the wonderful stories of distinct aeons;

1.104.s:
viśalyākhyānakaṃ paścājjāleśvarakathā tathā /
gorīvrata samākhyānaṃ tripurajvālanaṃ tataḥ //
1.104.d:
विशल्याख्यानकं पश्चाज्जालेश्वरकथा तथा ।
गोरीव्रत समाख्यानं त्रिपुरज्वालनं ततः ॥
1.104.m: then the story of Viśalyā, likewise the story of Jāleśvara, / the full narration of the Gaurī vow, then the burning of Tripura;

1.104.s:
dehapātavidhānaṃ ca kāverīsaṃgamastataḥ /
dārutīrthaṃ brahmāvartaṃ yatreśvarakathānakam //
1.104.d:
देहपातविधानं च कावेरीसंगमस्ततः ।
दारुतीर्थं ब्रह्मावर्तं यत्रेश्वरकथानकम् ॥
1.104.m: the precept on casting off the body, then the confluence of the Kāverī, / Dārutīrtha, Brahmāvarta, and the story of Yatreśvara;

1.104.s:
agnitīrthaṃ ravitīrthaṃ meghanādādidārukam /
devatīrthaṃ narmadeśaṃ kapilākhyaṃ karañjakam //
1.104.d:
अग्नितीर्थं रवितीर्थं मेघनादादिदारुकम् ।
देवतीर्थं नर्मदेशं कपिलाख्यं करञ्जकम् ॥
1.104.m: Agnitīrtha, Ravitīrtha, the timber ford beginning with Meghanāda, / Devatīrtha, Narmadeśa, the one named Kapilā, and Karañjaka;

1.104.s:
kuṇḍaleśaṃ pippalādaṃ vimaleśaṃ ca śūlabhit /
śacīharaṇamākhyā namabhrakasya vadhastataḥ //
1.104.d:
कुण्डलेशं पिप्पलादं विमलेशं च शूलभित् ।
शचीहरणमाख्या नमभ्रकस्य वधस्ततः ॥
1.104.m: Kuṇḍaleśa, Pippalāda, Vimaleśa, Śūlabhit, / the narrative of the abduction of Śacī, and then the slaying of Abhraka;

1.104.s:
śūlabhedodbhavo yatra dānadharmāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ /
ākhyānaṃ dīrghatapasa ṛṣyaśṛṅgakathā tataḥ //
1.104.d:
शूलभेदोद्भवो यत्र दानधर्माः पृथग्विधाः ।
आख्यानं दीर्घतपस ऋष्यशृङ्गकथा ततः ॥
1.104.m: where the origin of Śūlabheda [is described], the various forms of charity, / the narrative of Dīrghatapas, and then the story of Ṛṣyaśṛṅga;

1.104.s:
citrasenakathāpuṇyā kāśirājyasya lakṣaṇam /
tato devaśilākhyānaṃ śabarītīrthakānvitam //
1.104.d:
चित्रसेनकथापुण्या काशिराज्यस्य लक्षणम् ।
ततो देवशिलाख्यानं शबरीतीर्थकान्वितम् ॥
1.104.m: the meritorious story of Citrasena, the definition of the kingdom of Kāśi, / then the story of Devaśilā, together with the sacred ford of Śabarī;

1.104.s:
vyādhākhyānaṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ puṣkariṇyarkatīrthakam /
āpretyeśvaratīrthaṃ ca śakratīrthaṃ karoṭikam //
1.104.d:
व्याधाख्यानं ततः पुण्यं पुष्करिण्यर्कतीर्थकम् ।
आप्रेत्येश्वरतीर्थं च शक्रतीर्थं करोटिकम् ॥
1.104.m: then the meritorious story of the hunter, the sacred ford Puṣkariṇyarka, / the sacred ford Āpretyeśvara, Śakratīrtha, and Karoṭika;

1.104.s:
kumāreśamagastyeśamānandeśaṃ ca mātṛjam /
lokeśaṃ dhanadeśaṃ ca maṅgaleśaṃ ca kāmajam //
1.104.d:
कुमारेशमगस्त्येशमानन्देशं च मातृजम् ।
लोकेशं धनदेशं च मङ्गलेशं च कामजम् ॥
1.104.m: Kumāreśa, Agastyeśa, Ānandeśa born of the Mothers, / Lokeśa, Dhanadeśa, Maṅgaleśa, and Kāmaja;

1.104.s:
nāgeśaṃ cāpi gopāraṃ gautamaṃ śaṅkhacūḍakam /
nāradeśaṃ nandikeśaṃ varuṇeśvaratīrthakam //
1.104.d:
नागेशं चापि गोपारं गौतमं शङ्खचूडकम् ।
नारदेशं नन्दिकेशं वरुणेश्वरतीर्थकम् ॥
1.104.m: And Nāgeśa, Gopāra, Gautama, Śaṅkhacūḍaka, / Nāradeśa, Nandikeśa, and the sacred ford of Varuṇeśvara;

1.104.s:
dadhiskandāditīrthāni hanūmateśvaraṃ tataḥ /
rāmeśvarādi tīrthāni someśaṃ piṅgaleśvaram //
1.104.d:
दधिस्कन्दादितीर्थानि हनूमतेश्वरं ततः ।
रामेश्वरादि तीर्थानि सोमेशं पिङ्गलेश्वरम् ॥
1.104.m: The sacred fords beginning with Dadhiskanda, then Hanūmateśvara, / the sacred fords beginning with Rāmeśvara, Someśa, and Piṅgaleśvara;

1.104.s:
ṛṇamokṣaṃ kapileśaṃ pūtikeśaṃ jaleśayam /
caṇḍārkaṃ yamatīrthaṃ ca kālhoḍīśaṃ vanādike //
1.104.d:
ऋणमोक्षं कपिलेशं पूतिकेशं जलेशयम् ।
चण्डार्कं यमतीर्थं च काल्होडीशं वनादिके ॥
1.104.m: Ṛṇamokṣa, Kapileśa, Pūtikeśa, Jaleśaya, / Caṇḍārka, the sacred ford of Yama, Kālhoḍīśa in the sacred grove, and so forth;

1.104.s:
nārāyaṇaṃ ca koṭīśaṃ vyāsatīrthaṃ prabhāsakam /
nāgeśasaṃkarṣaṇakaṃ praśrayeśvaratīrthakam //
1.104.d:
नारायणं च कोटीशं व्यासतीर्थं प्रभासकम् ।
नागेशसंकर्षणकं प्रश्रयेश्वरतीर्थकम् ॥
1.104.m: Nārāyaṇa, Koṭīśa, the sacred ford of Vyāsa, Prabhāsaka, / Nāgeśa-Saṃkarṣaṇaka, and the sacred ford of Praśrayeśvara;

1.104.s:
airaṇḍīsaṃgamaṃ puṇyaṃ suvarṇaśilatīrthakam /
karañjaṃ kāmahaṃ tīrthaṃ bhāṇḍīro rohiṇībhavam //
1.104.d:
ऐरण्डीसंगमं पुण्यं सुवर्णशिलतीर्थकम् ।
करञ्जं कामहं तीर्थं भाण्डीरो रोहिणीभवम् ॥
1.104.m: The holy confluence of the Airaṇḍī, the sacred ford of Suvarṇaśilā, / Karañja, the sacred ford of Kāmaha, the Bhāṇḍīra [tree], and that which arose from Rohiṇī;

1.104.s:
cakratīrthaṃ dautapāpaṃ skandamāṅgirasāhvayam /
koṭitīrthamayonyakhyamaṅgārākhyaṃ trilocanam //
1.104.d:
चक्रतीर्थं दौतपापं स्कन्दमाङ्गिरसाह्वयम् ।
कोटितीर्थमयोन्यख्यमङ्गाराख्यं त्रिलोचनम् ॥
1.104.m: Cakratīrtha, Dhautapāpa, the [ford] named Skanda-Āṅgirasa, / Koṭitīrtha, that called Ayoni, that called Aṅgāra, and Trilocana;

1.104.s:
indreśaṃ kaṃbukeśaṃ ca someśaṃ kohanaṃ śakam /
nārmadaṃ cārkamāgneyaṃ bhārgaveśvaramuttamam //
1.104.d:
इन्द्रेशं कंबुकेशं च सोमेशं कोहनं शकम् ।
नार्मदं चार्कमाग्नेयं भार्गवेश्वरमुत्तमम् ॥
1.104.m: Indreśa, Kambuśeśa, Someśa, Kohana, Śaka, / Nārmada, the [ford] of Arka, Āgneya, and the supreme Bhārgaveśvara;

1.104.s:
brāhmaṃ daivaṃ ca mārgeśamādivārāhakeśvaram /
rāmeśamatha siddheśamāhalyaṃ kaṅkaṭeśvaram //
1.104.d:
ब्राह्मं दैवं च मार्गेशमादिवाराहकेश्वरम् ।
रामेशमथ सिद्धेशमाहल्यं कङ्कटेश्वरम् ॥
1.104.m: Brāhma, Daiva, Mārgeśa, Ādivārāhakeśvara, / Rāmeśa, then Siddheśa, Āhalyatīrtha, and Kaṅkaṭeśvara;

1.104.s:
śākraṃ saumyaṃ ca nādeśaṃ toyeśaṃ rukmiṇībhavam /
yojaneśaṃ varāheśaṃ dvādaśīśivatīrthakam //
1.104.d:
शाक्रं सौम्यं च नादेशं तोयेशं रुक्मिणीभवम् ।
योजनेशं वराहेशं द्वादशीशिवतीर्थकम् ॥
1.104.m: Śākra, Saumya, Nādeśa, Toyeśa, that which arose from Rukmiṇī, / Yojaneśa, Varāheśa, and the Dvādaśīśiva sacred ford;

1.104.s:
siddheśaṃ maṅgaleśaṃ ca liṅgavārāhatīrthakam /
kuṇḍeśaṃ śvetavārāhaṃ garbhāveśaṃ ravīśvaram //
1.104.d:
सिद्धेशं मङ्गलेशं च लिङ्गवाराहतीर्थकम् ।
कुण्डेशं श्वेतवाराहं गर्भावेशं रवीश्वरम् ॥
1.104.m: Siddheśa, Maṅgaleśa, the Liṅgavārāha sacred ford, / Kuṇḍeśa, Śvetavārāha, Garbhāveśa, and Ravīśvara;

1.104.s:
śuklādīni ca tīrthāni huṅkārasvāmitīrthakam /
saṃgameśaṃ nahuṣeśaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pañcagopakam /
nāgaśāvaṃ ca siddheśaṃ mārkaṇḍāṅkrūratīrthake //
1.104.d:
शुक्लादीनि च तीर्थानि हुङ्कारस्वामितीर्थकम् ।
संगमेशं नहुषेशं मोक्षणं पञ्चगोपकम् ।
नागशावं च सिद्धेशं मार्कण्डाङ्क्रूरतीर्थके ॥
1.104.m: The sacred fords beginning with Śukla, the sacred ford of Huṅkārasvāmin, / Saṃgameśa, Nahuṣeśa, Mokṣaṇa, the five Gopakas, / Nāgaśāva, Siddheśa, and the two sacred fords Mārkaṇḍa and Aṅkūra;

1.104.s:
kāmodaśūlāropākhye māṇḍavyaṃ gopakeśvaram /
kapileśaṃ piṅgaleśaṃ bhūteśaṃ gāṅgagautame //
1.104.d:
कामोदशूलारोपाख्ये माण्डव्यं गोपकेश्वरम् ।
कपिलेशं पिङ्गलेशं भूतेशं गाङ्गगौतमे ॥
1.104.m: The [fords] called Kāmoda and Śūlāropa, Māṇḍavya, Gopakeśvara, / Kapileśa, Piṅgaleśa, Bhūteśa, and the Gāṅga and Gautama [fords];

1.104.s:
āsvamedhaṃ bhṛgukacchaṃ kedāreśaṃ ca pāpanut /
kalakaleśaṃ jāleśaṃ śālagrāmaṃ varāhakam //
1.104.d:
आस्वमेधं भृगुकच्छं केदारेशं च पापनुत् ।
कलकलेशं जालेशं शालग्रामं वराहकम् ॥
1.104.m: Āśvamedha, Bhṛgukaccha, Kedāreśa which removes sins, / Kalakaleśa, Jāleśa, Śālagrāma, and Varāhaka;

1.104.s:
candraprabhāsamādityaṃ śrīpatyākhyaṃ ca haṃsakam /
mūlyasthānaṃ ca śūleśamugrākhyaṃ citradaivakam //
1.104.d:
चन्द्रप्रभासमादित्यं श्रीपत्याख्यं च हंसकम् ।
मूल्यस्थानं च शूलेशमुग्राख्यं चित्रदैवकम् ॥
1.104.m: Candraprabhāsa, Āditya, that named Śrīpati, and Haṃsaka, / Mūlyasthāna, Śūleśa, that named Ugra, and Citradaivaka;

1.104.s:
śikhīśaṃ kāṇṭitīrthaṃ ca daśakanyaṃ suvaṇakam /
ṛṇamokṣaṃ bhārabhūti puṅkhāṃ muḍiṃ ca ḍiṇḍimam //
1.104.d:
शिखीशं काण्टितीर्थं च दशकन्यं सुवणकम् ।
ऋणमोक्षं भारभूति पुङ्खां मुडिं च डिण्डिमम् ॥
1.104.m: Śikhīśa, the sacred ford of Kāṇṭi, Daśakanya, Suvaṇaka, / Ṛṇamokṣa, Bhārabhūti, Puṅkhā, Muḍi, and Ḍiṇḍima;

1.104.s:
āmaleśaṃ kapāleśaṃ śṛṅgairaṇḍībhavaṃ tataḥ /
koṭitīrthaṃ loṭaṇeṣaṃ phalastutirataḥ param //
1.104.d:
आमलेशं कपालेशं शृङ्गैरण्डीभवं ततः ।
कोटितीर्थं लोटणेषं फलस्तुतिरतः परम् ॥
1.104.m: Āmaleśa, Kapāleśa, then that born from the horn of Airaṇḍī, / Koṭitīrtha, Loṭaneśa, and thereafter the praise of fruits [of listening].

1.104.s:
dṛmijaṅgalamāhātmye rohitāśvakathā tataḥ /
dhundhumārasamākhyānaṃ vadhopāyastato 'sya vai //
1.104.d:
दृमिजङ्गलमाहात्म्ये रोहिताश्वकथा ततः ।
धुन्धुमारसमाख्यानं वधोपायस्ततो ऽस्य वै ॥
1.104.m: In the eulogy of the greatness of Dṛmijaṅgala, then the story of Rohitāśva; / the account of Dhundhumāra, and then indeed the means of killing him;

1.104.s:
vadhau dhundhostataḥ paścāttataścitravahodbhavaḥ /
mahimāsya tataścaḍīśaprabhāvo ratīśvaraḥ //
1.104.d:
वधौ धुन्धोस्ततः पश्चात्ततश्चित्रवहोद्भवः ।
महिमास्य ततश्चडीशप्रभावो रतीश्वरः ॥
1.104.m: Then, after the slaying of Dhundhu, the origin of Citravahā; / then its greatness; the power of Caṇḍīśa, and Ratīśvara;

1.104.s:
kedāreśo lakṣatīrthaṃ tato viṣṇupadībhavam /
mukhāraṃ cyavanāndhāsyaṃ brahmaṇaśca sarastataḥ //
1.104.d:
केदारेशो लक्षतीर्थं ततो विष्णुपदीभवम् ।
मुखारं च्यवनान्धास्यं ब्रह्मणश्च सरस्ततः ॥
1.104.m: Kedāreśa, Lakṣatīrtha, then that which arose from the Viṣṇupadī, / Mukhāra, the blind well of Cyavana, and then the lake of Brahmā;

1.104.s:
cakrākhyaṃ lalitākhyānaṃ tīrthaṃ ca bahugomayam /
rudrāvartaṃ ca markaṇḍaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam //
1.104.d:
चक्राख्यं ललिताख्यानं तीर्थं च बहुगोमयम् ।
रुद्रावर्तं च मर्कण्डं तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् ॥
1.104.m: That named Cakra, the story of Lalitā, the sacred ford Bahugomaya, / Rudrāvarta, and the Mārkaṇḍa sacred ford which destroys sin;

1.104.s:
śravaṇeśaṃ śuddhapaṭaṃ devāndhupretatīrthakam /
jihvodatīrthaṃsaṃbhūtiḥ śivodbhandaṃ phalastutiḥ //
1.104.d:
श्रवणेशं शुद्धपटं देवान्धुप्रेततीर्थकम् ।
जिह्वोदतीर्थंसंभूतिः शिवोद्भन्दं फलस्तुतिः ॥
1.104.m: Śravaṇeśa, Śuddhapaṭa, the blind well of the gods, the Pretatīrtha, / the origin of the Jihvodatīrtha, Śivodbhanda, and the praise of fruits.

1.104.s:
eṣa khaṇḍo hyavantyākhyaḥ śṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśanaḥ /
ataḥ paraṃ nāgarākhyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ṣaṣṭho 'bhidhīyate //
1.104.d:
एष खण्डो ह्यवन्त्याख्यः शृण्वतां पापनाशनः ।
अतः परं नागराख्यः खण्डः षष्ठो ऽभिधीयते ॥
1.104.m: This is the section called Avanti, which destroys sin for those who hear it. / Hereafter, the sixth section, called Nāgara, is declared:

1.104.s:
liṅgotpattisamākhyānaṃ hariścandrakathā śubhā /
viśvāmitrasya māhātmyaṃ triśaṅkusvargatistathā //
1.104.d:
लिङ्गोत्पत्तिसमाख्यानं हरिश्चन्द्रकथा शुभा ।
विश्वामित्रस्य माहात्म्यं त्रिशङ्कुस्वर्गतिस्तथा ॥
1.104.m: The narrative of the origin of the liṅga, the auspicious story of Hariścandra, / the eulogy of the greatness of Viśvāmitra, and likewise the ascent of Triśaṅku to heaven;

1.104.s:
hāṭake śvaramāhātmye vṛtrāsuravadhastathā /
nāgabilaṃ śaṅkhatīrthamacaleśvaravarṇanam //
1.104.d:
हाटके श्वरमाहात्म्ये वृत्रासुरवधस्तथा ।
नागबिलं शङ्खतीर्थमचलेश्वरवर्णनम् ॥
1.104.m: In the eulogy of the greatness of Hāṭakeśvara, likewise the slaying of the demon Vṛtra; / Nāgabila, Śaṅkhatīrtha, and the description of Acaleśvara;

1.104.s:
camatkārapurākhyānaṃ camatkārakaraṃ param /
gayaśīrṣaṃ bālaśākhyaṃ vālamaṇḍaṃ mṛgāhvayam //
1.104.d:
चमत्कारपुराख्यानं चमत्कारकरं परम् ।
गयशीर्षं बालशाख्यं वालमण्डं मृगाह्वयम् ॥
1.104.m: The account of Camatkārapura, which causes supreme wonder; / Gayaśīrṣa, that called Bālaśa, Vālamaṇḍa, and that named Mṛga;

1.104.s:
viṣṇupādaṃ ca gokarṇaṃ yugarūpaṃ samāśrayaḥ /
siddheśvaraṃ nāgasaraḥ saptārṣeyaṃ hyagastyakam //
1.104.d:
विष्णुपादं च गोकर्णं युगरूपं समाश्रयः ।
सिद्धेश्वरं नागसरः सप्तार्षेयं ह्यगस्त्यकम् ॥
1.104.m: Viṣṇupāda, Gokarṇa, Yugarūpa, Samāśraya, / Siddheśvara, Nāgasaras, Saptārṣeya, and indeed Agastyaka;

1.104.s:
bhrūṇagartaṃ naleśaṃ ca bhaiṣmaṃ vaiḍuramarkakam /
śāramiṣṭhaṃ somanāthaṃ ca daurgamātarjakeśvaram //
1.104.d:
भ्रूणगर्तं नलेशं च भैष्मं वैडुरमर्ककम् ।
शारमिष्ठं सोमनाथं च दौर्गमातर्जकेश्वरम् ॥
1.104.m: Bhrūṇagarta, Naleśa, Bhaiṣma, Vaiḍūrya, Arkaka, / Śāramiṣṭha, Somanātha, Daurga, and Mātariśveśvara;

1.104.s:
jāmadagnyavadhākhyānaṃ naiḥkṣatriyakathānakam /
rāmahradaṃ nāgapuraṃ ṣaāḍliṅgaṃ caiva yajñabhūḥ //
1.104.d:
जामदग्न्यवधाख्यानं नैःक्षत्रियकथानकम् ।
रामह्रदं नागपुरं षआड्लिङ्गं चैव यज्ञभूः ॥
1.104.m: The account of the slaying by Jāmadagnya, the narrative of ridding the earth of Kṣatriyas, / Rāmahrada, Nāgapura, Ṣaḍliṅga, and the sacrificial ground;

1.104.s:
muṇḍīrāditrikārkaṃ ca satīpariṇayāhvayam /
rudraśīrṣaṃ ca yāgeśaṃ vālakhilyaṃ ca gāruḍam //
1.104.d:
मुण्डीरादित्रिकार्कं च सतीपरिणयाह्वयम् ।
रुद्रशीर्षं च यागेशं वालखिल्यं च गारुडम् ॥
1.104.m: Muṇḍīra and the other three suns, that named the marriage of Satī, / Rudraśīrṣa, Yāgeśa, Vālakhilya, and Gāruḍa;

1.104.s:
lakṣmīśāpaḥ saptaviṃśasomaprāsādameva ca /
aṃbābaddhaṃ pāṇḍukākhyamāgneyaṃ brahmakuṇḍakam //
1.104.d:
लक्ष्मीशापः सप्तविंशसोमप्रासादमेव च ।
अंबाबद्धं पाण्डुकाख्यमाग्नेयं ब्रह्मकुण्डकम् ॥
1.104.m: The curse on Lakṣmī, the twenty-seventh temple of Soma, / Ambābaddha, that named Pāṇḍuka, Āgneya, and Brahmakuṇḍaka;

1.104.s:
gomukhaṃ lohayaṣṭyākhyamajāpāleśvarī tathā /
śānaiścaraṃ rājavāpī rāmeśo lakṣmaṇeśvaraḥ //
1.104.d:
गोमुखं लोहयष्ट्याख्यमजापालेश्वरी तथा ।
शानैश्चरं राजवापी रामेशो लक्ष्मणेश्वरः ॥
1.104.m: Gomukha, that named Lohayaṣṭi, and likewise Ajāpāleśvarī, / Śānaiścara, Rājavāpī, Rāmeśa, and Lakṣmaṇeśvara;

1.104.s:
kuśeśākhyaṃ laveśākhyaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvottamottamam /
aṣṭaṣaṣṭisamākhyānaṃ damayantyāstrijātakam //
1.104.d:
कुशेशाख्यं लवेशाख्यं लिङ्गं सर्वोत्तमोत्तमम् ।
अष्टषष्टिसमाख्यानं दमयन्त्यास्त्रिजातकम् ॥
1.104.m: The liṅgas named Kuśeśa and Laveśa, the most supreme of all; / the account of the sixty-eight, and the three births of Damayantī;

1.104.s:
tato vai revatī cātra bhaktikātīrthasaṃbhavaḥ /
kṣemaṅkarī ca kedāraṃ śuklatīrthamukhārakam //
1.104.d:
ततो वै रेवती चात्र भक्तिकातीर्थसंभवः ।
क्षेमङ्करी च केदारं शुक्लतीर्थमुखारकम् ॥
1.104.m: Then indeed Revatī, and here the arising of the sacred ford of Bhaktikā; / Kṣemaṅkarī, Kedāra, Śuklatīrtha, and Mukhāraka;

1.104.s:
satyasaṃdheśvarākhyānaṃ tathā karṇotpalākathā /
aṭeśvaraṃ yājñavalkya gauryaṃ gāṇeśameva ca //
1.104.d:
सत्यसंधेश्वराख्यानं तथा कर्णोत्पलाकथा ।
अटेश्वरं याज्ञवल्क्य गौर्यं गाणेशमेव च ॥
1.104.m: The narrative of Satyasaṃdheśvara, and likewise the story of Karṇotpalā; / Aṭeśvara, Yājñavalkya, Gaurya, and Gāṇeśa;

1.104.s:
tato vāstupadākhyānamajāgṛhakathānakam /
saubhāgyāndhuśca śuleśaṃ dharmarājakathānakam //
1.104.d:
ततो वास्तुपदाख्यानमजागृहकथानकम् ।
सौभाग्यान्धुश्च शुलेशं धर्मराजकथानकम् ॥
1.104.m: Then the account of Vāstupada, the narrative of Ajāgṛha, / the blind well of Saubhāgya, Śūleśa, and the story of Dharmarāja;

1.104.s:
miṣṭānnedaśvarākhyānaṃ gāṇāpatyatrayaṃ tataḥ /
jābālicaritaṃ caiva makareśakathā tataḥ //
1.104.d:
मिष्टान्नेदश्वराख्यानं गाणापत्यत्रयं ततः ।
जाबालिचरितं चैव मकरेशकथा ततः ॥
1.104.m: The account of Miṣṭānneśvara, then the triad of Gāṇāpatyas, / the deed of Jābāli, and then the story of Makareśa;

1.104.s:
kāleśvaryandhakākhyānaṃ kuṇḍamāpyarasaṃ tathā /
puṣyādityaṃ rauhitāśvaṃ nāgarotpattikīrttanam //
1.104.d:
कालेश्वर्यन्धकाख्यानं कुण्डमाप्यरसं तथा ।
पुष्यादित्यं रौहिताश्वं नागरोत्पत्तिकीर्त्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: The story of Kāleśvarī and Andhaka, likewise the Kuṇḍa [yielding] water of nectar, / Puṣyāditya, Rauhitāśva, and the proclamation of the origin of the Nāgaras;

1.104.s:
bhārgavaṃ caritaṃ caiva vaiśvāmaitraṃ tataḥ param /
sārasvataṃ paippalādaṃ kaṃsārīśaṃ ca paiṇḍakam //
1.104.d:
भार्गवं चरितं चैव वैश्वामैत्रं ततः परम् ।
सारस्वतं पैप्पलादं कंसारीशं च पैण्डकम् ॥
1.104.m: The story of Bhārgava, and thereafter that of Vaiśvāmitra; / Sārasvata, Paippalāda, Kaṃsārīśa, and Paiṇḍaka;

1.104.s:
brahmaṇo yajñacaritaṃ sāvitryākhyānasaṃyutam /
raivataṃ bhārtayajñākhyaṃ mukhyatīrthanirīkṣaṇam //
1.104.d:
ब्रह्मणो यज्ञचरितं सावित्र्याख्यानसंयुतम् ।
रैवतं भार्तयज्ञाख्यं मुख्यतीर्थनिरीक्षणम् ॥
1.104.m: The story of Brahmā's sacrifice, together with the account of Sāvitrī; / Raivata, that named Bhārtṛyajña, and the survey of the foremost sacred fords:

1.104.s:
kauravaṃ hāṭakeśākhyaṃ prabhāsaṃ kṣetrakatrayam /
pauṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ dhārmamaraṇya tritayaṃ smṛtam //
1.104.d:
कौरवं हाटकेशाख्यं प्रभासं क्षेत्रकत्रयम् ।
पौष्करं नैमिषं धार्ममरण्य त्रितयं स्मृतम् ॥
1.104.m: Kaurava, that named Hāṭakeśa, and Prabhāsa are remembered as the three sacred fields; / Pauṣkara, Naimiṣa, and Dhārma are the triad of sacred forests;

1.104.s:
vārāṇasī dvārakākhyāvantyākhyeti purītrayam /
bṛndāvanaṃ khāṇḍavākhyamadvaikākhyaṃ vanatrayam //
1.104.d:
वाराणसी द्वारकाख्यावन्त्याख्येति पुरीत्रयम् ।
बृन्दावनं खाण्डवाख्यमद्वैकाख्यं वनत्रयम् ॥
1.104.m: Vārāṇasī, the one named Dvārakā, and the one named Avanti are the triad of cities; / Vṛndāvana, that named Khāṇḍava, and that named Advaika are the triad of woods;

1.104.s:
kalpaḥ śālastathā nandigrāmatrayamanuttamam /
asiśuklapitṛsaṃjñaṃ tīrthatrayamudāhṛtam //
1.104.d:
कल्पः शालस्तथा नन्दिग्रामत्रयमनुत्तमम् ।
असिशुक्लपितृसंज्ञं तीर्थत्रयमुदाहृतम् ॥
1.104.m: Kalpa, Śāla, and Nandi are the three unexcelled villages; / those designated Asi, Śukla, and Pitṛ are declared the triad of sacred fords;

1.104.s:
rśyarbudau raivataścaiva parvatatrayamuttamam /
nadīnāṃ tritayaṃ gaṅgā narmadā ca sarasvatī //
1.104.d:
र्श्यर्बुदौ रैवतश्चैव पर्वतत्रयमुत्तमम् ।
नदीनां त्रितयं गङ्गा नर्मदा च सरस्वती ॥
1.104.m: Ṛśya, Arbuda, and Raivata are the three excellent mountains; / the triad of rivers is the Gaṅgā, the Narmadā, and the Sarasvatī;

1.104.s:
sārddhakoṭitrayaphalamekaikaṃ caiṣu kīrttitam /
kūṣikā śaṅkhatīrthaṃ cāmarakaṃ bālamaṇḍanam //
1.104.d:
सार्द्धकोटित्रयफलमेकैकं चैषु कीर्त्तितम् ।
कूषिका शङ्खतीर्थं चामरकं बालमण्डनम् ॥
1.104.m: The fruit of each single one of these is proclaimed as thirty-five million; / Kūṣikā, Śaṅkhatīrtha, Amaraka, and Bālamaṇḍana —

1.104.s:
hāṭakeśakṣetraphalapradaṃ proktaṃ catuṣṭayam /
sāṃbādityaṃ śrāddhakalpaṃ yaudhiṣṭhiramathāndhakam //
1.104.d:
हाटकेशक्षेत्रफलप्रदं प्रोक्तं चतुष्टयम् ।
सांबादित्यं श्राद्धकल्पं यौधिष्ठिरमथान्धकम् ॥
1.104.m: this tetrad is said to bestow the fruit of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśa; / Sāmbāditya, the ritual rules of ancestral rites, Yaudhiṣṭhira, then Andhaka;

1.104.s:
jalaśāyi caturmāsamaśūnyaśayanavratam /
maṅkaṇeśaṃ śivarātristulāpuruṣadānakam //
1.104.d:
जलशायि चतुर्मासमशून्यशयनव्रतम् ।
मङ्कणेशं शिवरात्रिस्तुलापुरुषदानकम् ॥
1.104.m: Jalaśāyin, the Cāturmāsya, the observance of Aśūnyaśayana, / Maṅkaṇeśa, Śivarātri, the gift of a man weighed on scales,

1.104.s:
pṛthvīdānaṃ vānakeśaṃ kapālamocaneśvaram /
pāpapiṇḍaṃ māsalaiṅgaṃ yugamānādikīrtanam //
1.104.d:
पृथ्वीदानं वानकेशं कपालमोचनेश्वरम् ।
पापपिण्डं मासलैङ्गं युगमानादिकीर्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: the gift of earth, Vānakeśa, Kapālamocaneśvara, / Pāpapiṇḍa, the monthly liṅgas, and the proclamation of the duration of cosmic ages and so forth.

1.104.s:
niṃveśaśākaṃbharyākhyā rudraikādaśakīrtanam /
dānamāhātmyakathanaṃ dvādaśādityakīrtanam //
1.104.d:
निंवेशशाकंभर्याख्या रुद्रैकादशकीर्तनम् ।
दानमाहात्म्यकथनं द्वादशादित्यकीर्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: Nimbeśa, the one named Śākaṃbharī, the celebration of the eleven Rudras, / the narration of the greatness of gifts, and the celebration of the twelve Ādityas:

1.104.s:
ityeṣanāgaraḥ khaṇḍaḥ prabhāsākhyo 'dhunocyate /
someśo yatra viśveśor'kasthalaṃ puṇyadaṃ mahat //
1.104.d:
इत्येषनागरः खण्डः प्रभासाख्यो ऽधुनोच्यते ।
सोमेशो यत्र विश्वेशोर्ऽकस्थलं पुण्यदं महत् ॥
1.104.m: this is the Nāgara section; now the one named Prabhāsa is spoken of, / where Someśa is the lord of the universe, and the great merit-bestowing Arkasthala;

1.104.s:
siddheśvarādikākhyānaṃ pṛthagatra prakīrtitam /
agnitīrthaṃ kapaddarśiṃ kedāreśaṃ gatipradam //
1.104.d:
सिद्धेश्वरादिकाख्यानं पृथगत्र प्रकीर्तितम् ।
अग्नितीर्थं कपद्दर्शिं केदारेशं गतिप्रदम् ॥
1.104.m: the narratives beginning with Siddheśvara are celebrated here separately; / Agnitīrtha, Kapardin, and Kedāreśa, which bestows a [lofty] destination;

1.104.s:
bhīmabhairavacaṇḍīśabhāskarendukujeśvarāḥ /
budhejyabhṛgusaurāguśiravīśā haravigrahāḥ //
1.104.d:
भीमभैरवचण्डीशभास्करेन्दुकुजेश्वराः ।
बुधेज्यभृगुसौरागुशिरवीशा हरविग्रहाः ॥
1.104.m: the lords Bhīma, Bhairava, Caṇḍīśa, Bhāskara, Indu, and Kuja, / and forms of Hara [representing] Budha, Ijya, Bhṛgu, Sauri, Agni, and Ravi;

1.104.s:
siddheśvarādyāḥ pañcānye rudrāstatra vyavastatra vyavasthitāḥ /
varārohā hyajā pālā maṅgalā laliteśvarī //
1.104.d:
सिद्धेश्वराद्याः पञ्चान्ये रुद्रास्तत्र व्यवस्तत्र व्यवस्थिताः ।
वरारोहा ह्यजा पाला मङ्गला ललितेश्वरी ॥
1.104.m: the five other Rudras established there, beginning with Siddheśvara; / Varārohā, indeed Ajā, Pālā, Maṅgalā, and Laliteśvarī;

1.104.s:
lakṣmīśo vāḍaveśaścorvīśaḥ kāmesvarastathā /
gaurīśavaruṇeśākhyaṃ durvāseśaṃ gaṇeśvaram //
1.104.d:
लक्ष्मीशो वाडवेशश्चोर्वीशः कामेस्वरस्तथा ।
गौरीशवरुणेशाख्यं दुर्वासेशं गणेश्वरम् ॥
1.104.m: Lakṣmīśa, Vāḍaveśa, Urvīśa, and likewise Kāmeśvara, / those named Gaurīśa and Varuṇeśa, Durvāseśa, and Gaṇeśvara;

1.104.s:
kumāreśaṃ caṇḍakalpaṃ śakulīśvarasaṃjñakam /
tataḥ prokto 'tha koṭīśabālabrahmādisatkathā //
1.104.d:
कुमारेशं चण्डकल्पं शकुलीश्वरसंज्ञकम् ।
ततः प्रोक्तो ऽथ कोटीशबालब्रह्मादिसत्कथा ॥
1.104.m: Kumāreśa, Caṇḍakalpa, and the one named Śakulīśvara; / then is proclaimed the noble story of Koṭīśa, Bālabrahmā, and others;

1.104.s:
narakeśasaṃvartteśanidhīśvarakathā tataḥ /
balabhadreśvarasyātha gaṅgāyā gaṇapasya ca //
1.104.d:
नरकेशसंवर्त्तेशनिधीश्वरकथा ततः ।
बलभद्रेश्वरस्याथ गङ्गाया गणपस्य च ॥
1.104.m: then the stories of Narakeśa, Saṃvarteśa, and Nidhīśvara, / and of Balabhadreśvara, the Gaṅgā, and Gaṇapa;

1.104.s:
jāṃbavatyākhyasaritaḥ pāṇḍukūpasya satkathā /
śatamedhalakṣamedhakoṭimedhakathā tathā //
1.104.d:
जांबवत्याख्यसरितः पाण्डुकूपस्य सत्कथा ।
शतमेधलक्षमेधकोटिमेधकथा तथा ॥
1.104.m: the noble story of the river named Jāmbavatī and of the Pāṇḍu well, / and likewise the stories of the hundred sacrifices, the hundred-thousand sacrifices, and the ten-million sacrifices;

1.104.s:
durvāsārkaghaṭasthānahiraṇyāsaṃgamotkathā /
nagarārkasya kṛṣṇasya saṃkarṣaṇasamudrayoḥ //
1.104.d:
दुर्वासार्कघटस्थानहिरण्यासंगमोत्कथा ।
नगरार्कस्य कृष्णस्य संकर्षणसमुद्रयोः ॥
1.104.m: the exalted story of the confluence of Durvāsārka, Ghaṭasthāna, and Hiraṇyā; / of Nagarārka, Kṛṣṇa, and the ocean of Saṃkarṣaṇa;

1.104.s:
kumāryāḥ kṣetrapāsya brahmeśasya kathā pṛthak /
piṅgalāsaṃgameśasya śaṅkarārkaghaṭeśayoḥ //
1.104.d:
कुमार्याः क्षेत्रपास्य ब्रह्मेशस्य कथा पृथक् ।
पिङ्गलासंगमेशस्य शङ्करार्कघटेशयोः ॥
1.104.m: the distinct story of Kumārī, Kṣetrapāla, and Brahmeśa; / of Piṅgalāsaṃgameśa, and of Śaṅkarārka and Ghaṭeśa;

1.104.s:
ṛṣitīrthasya nandārkatritakūpasya kīrtanam /
sasopānasya parṇārkanyaṅkumatyoḥ kathādbhutā //
1.104.d:
ऋषितीर्थस्य नन्दार्कत्रितकूपस्य कीर्तनम् ।
ससोपानस्य पर्णार्कन्यङ्कुमत्योः कथाद्भुता ॥
1.104.m: the celebration of Ṛṣitīrtha, Nandārka, and Tritakūpa; / the wonderful story of Parṇārka with its steps, and of the Nyaṅkumati [river];

1.104.s:
vārāhasvāmivṛttāntaṃ chāyāliṅgākhyagulphayoḥ /
kathā kanakanandāyāḥ kutīgaṅgeśayostathā //
1.104.d:
वाराहस्वामिवृत्तान्तं छायालिङ्गाख्यगुल्फयोः ।
कथा कनकनन्दायाः कुतीगङ्गेशयोस्तथा ॥
1.104.m: the account of Vārāhasvāmin, of the Shadow Liṅga and Gulpha; / the story of Kanakanandā, and likewise of the hut and Gāṅgeśa;

1.104.s:
camasodbedaviduratrilokeśakathā tataḥ /
maṅkaṇeśatraipureśaṣaṇḍatīrthakathāstathā //
1.104.d:
चमसोद्बेदविदुरत्रिलोकेशकथा ततः ।
मङ्कणेशत्रैपुरेशषण्डतीर्थकथास्तथा ॥
1.104.m: then the story of Camasodbheda, Vidura, and Trilokeśa; / and likewise the stories of Maṅkaṇeśa, Traipureśa, and the Ṣaṇḍa sacred ford;

1.104.s:
sūryaprācī trīkṣaṇayorumānātakathā tathā /
bhūddhāraśūlasthalayoścyavanārkeśayostathā //
1.104.d:
सूर्यप्राची त्रीक्षणयोरुमानातकथा तथा ।
भूद्धारशूलस्थलयोश्च्यवनार्केशयोस्तथा ॥
1.104.m: Sūryaprācī, and likewise the story of the three eyes and Umānātha; / of Bhūddhāra, Śūlasthala, and Cyavanārkeśa;

1.104.s:
ajāpāleśabālārkakuberasthalajā kathā /
ṛṣitoyā kathā puṇyā saṃgāleśvarakīrtanam //
1.104.d:
अजापालेशबालार्ककुबेरस्थलजा कथा ।
ऋषितोया कथा पुण्या संगालेश्वरकीर्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: the story originating from Ajāpāleśa, Bālārka, and Kuberasthala; / the meritorious story of Ṛṣitoyā, and the celebration of Saṅgāleśvara;

1.104.s:
nāradādityakathanaṃ nārāyaṇanirūpaṇam /
taptakuṇḍasya māhātmyaṃ mūlacaṇḍīśavarṇanam //
1.104.d:
नारदादित्यकथनं नारायणनिरूपणम् ।
तप्तकुण्डस्य माहात्म्यं मूलचण्डीशवर्णनम् ॥
1.104.m: the narration of Nāradāditya, the determination concerning Nārāyaṇa, / the greatness of Taptakuṇḍa, and the description of Mūlacaṇḍīśa;

1.104.s:
caturvaktragaṇādhyakṣakalaṃbeśvarayoḥ kathā /
gopālasvāmiva kulasvāminormarutāṃ kathā //
1.104.d:
चतुर्वक्त्रगणाध्यक्षकलंबेश्वरयोः कथा ।
गोपालस्वामिव कुलस्वामिनोर्मरुतां कथा ॥
1.104.m: the story of the four-faced lord of gaṇas and of Kalambeśvara; / the story of Gopālasvāmin, Bakulasvāmin, and the Maruts;

1.104.s:
kṣemārkennatavighneśajalasvāmikathā tataḥ /
kālameghasya rukmiṇyā durvāseśvarabhadrayoḥ //
1.104.d:
क्षेमार्केन्नतविघ्नेशजलस्वामिकथा ततः ।
कालमेघस्य रुक्मिण्या दुर्वासेश्वरभद्रयोः ॥
1.104.m: then the story of Kṣemārka, Unnatavighneśa, and Jalasvāmin; / of Kālamegha, Rukmiṇī, Durvāseśvara, and Bhadrā;

1.104.s:
śaṅkhāvartamokṣatīrthagoṣpadācyutasadmanām /
jāleśvarasya huṅkāreśvaracaṇḍīśayoḥ kathā //
1.104.d:
शङ्खावर्तमोक्षतीर्थगोष्पदाच्युतसद्मनाम् ।
जालेश्वरस्य हुङ्कारेश्वरचण्डीशयोः कथा ॥
1.104.m: of Śaṅkhāvarta, Mokṣatīrtha, Goṣpada, and the dwelling of Acyuta; / the story of Jāleśvara, Huṅkāreśvara, and Caṇḍīśa;

1.104.s:
āśāpurasthavighneśakalākuṇḍakathādbhutā /
kapileśasya ca kathā jaradgavaśivasya ca //
1.104.d:
आशापुरस्थविघ्नेशकलाकुण्डकथाद्भुता ।
कपिलेशस्य च कथा जरद्गवशिवस्य च ॥
1.104.m: the wonderful story of Vighneśa in Āśāpura and Kalākuṇḍa; / the story of Kapileśa and of Jaradgava-Śiva;

1.104.s:
nalakarkeṭeśvarayorhāṭakeśvarajā kathā /
nāradeśayantrabhūṣādurgakūṭagaṇeśajā //
1.104.d:
नलकर्केटेश्वरयोर्हाटकेश्वरजा कथा ।
नारदेशयन्त्रभूषादुर्गकूटगणेशजा ॥
1.104.m: the story born of Nala and Karkeṭeśvara, that born of Hāṭakeśvara, / and that born of Nāradeśa, Yantrabhūṣā, Durgakūṭa, and Gaṇeśa.

1.104.s:
suparṇailākhyabhairavyorbhallatīrthabhavā kathā /
kīrtanaṃ kardamālasya guptasomeśvasya ca //
1.104.d:
सुपर्णैलाख्यभैरव्योर्भल्लतीर्थभवा कथा ।
कीर्तनं कर्दमालस्य गुप्तसोमेश्वस्य च ॥
1.104.m: The story arising at Bhallatīrtha of Suparṇā and the Bhairavī called Elā, / and the glorification of Kardamāla and Guptasomeśvara;

1.104.s:
bahusvarṇeśaśṛṅgeśakoṭīśvarakathā tataḥ /
mārkaṇḍeśvarakoṭīśadāmodaragṛhotkathā //
1.104.d:
बहुस्वर्णेशशृङ्गेशकोटीश्वरकथा ततः ।
मार्कण्डेश्वरकोटीशदामोदरगृहोत्कथा ॥
1.104.m: then the narrative of Bahusvarṇeśa, Śṛṅgeśa, and Koṭīśvara; / the sublime story of the dwelling of Mārkaṇḍeśvara, Koṭīśa, and Dāmodara;

1.104.s:
svarṇarekhā brahmakuṇḍaṃ kuntībhīmeśvarau tathā /
mṛgīkuṇḍaṃ ca sarvasvaṃ kṣetre vastrāpathe smṛtam //
1.104.d:
स्वर्णरेखा ब्रह्मकुण्डं कुन्तीभीमेश्वरौ तथा ।
मृगीकुण्डं च सर्वस्वं क्षेत्रे वस्त्रापथे स्मृतम् ॥
1.104.m: Svarṇarekhā, Brahmakuṇḍa, and likewise Kuntīśvara and Bhīmeśvara, / and Mṛgīkuṇḍa—all these are recorded in the sacred field of Vastrāpatha;

1.104.s:
durgābhilleśagaṅgeśaraivatānāṃ kathādbhutā /
tator'budeśvara kathā acaleśvarakīrtanam //
1.104.d:
दुर्गाभिल्लेशगङ्गेशरैवतानां कथाद्भुता ।
ततोर्ऽबुदेश्वर कथा अचलेश्वरकीर्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: the wondrous tale of Durgā, Bhilleśa, Gaṅgeśa, and Raivata; / then the story of Arbudeśvara, and the glorification of Acaleśvara;

1.104.s:
nāgatīrthasya ca kathā vasiṣṭāśramavarṇanam /
bhadrakarṇasya māhātmyaṃ trinetrasya tataḥ param //
1.104.d:
नागतीर्थस्य च कथा वसिष्टाश्रमवर्णनम् ।
भद्रकर्णस्य माहात्म्यं त्रिनेत्रस्य ततः परम् ॥
1.104.m: and the story of Nāgatīrtha, the description of Vasiṣṭha’s hermitage, / the eulogy of greatness of Bhadrakarṇa, and thereafter of Trinetra;

1.104.s:
kedārasya ca māhātmyaṃ tīrthāṅgamanakīrtanam /
koṭīśvararūpatīrthahṛṣīkeśakathārastataḥ //
1.104.d:
केदारस्य च माहात्म्यं तीर्थाङ्गमनकीर्तनम् ।
कोटीश्वररूपतीर्थहृषीकेशकथारस्ततः ॥
1.104.m: and the eulogy of greatness of Kedāra, the mention of visiting the sacred fords, / then the stories of Koṭīśvara, Rūpatīrtha, and Hṛṣīkeśa;

1.104.s:
siddheśaśukreśvarayormaṇikarṇīśakīrtanam /
paṅgutīrthayamatīrthavārāhatīrthavarṇanam //
1.104.d:
सिद्धेशशुक्रेश्वरयोर्मणिकर्णीशकीर्तनम् ।
पङ्गुतीर्थयमतीर्थवाराहतीर्थवर्णनम् ॥
1.104.m: the praise of Siddheśa, Śukreśvara, and Maṇikarṇīśa, / the description of Paṅgutīrtha, Yamatīrtha, and Vārāhatīrtha;

1.104.s:
