candraprabhāsarpiḍodaśrīmātāśuklatīrthajam /
kātyāyanyāśca māhātmyaṃ tataḥ piṇḍārakasya ca //
1.104.d:
चन्द्रप्रभासर्पिडोदश्रीमाताशुक्लतीर्थजम् ।
कात्यायन्याश्च माहात्म्यं ततः पिण्डारकस्य च ॥
1.104.m: the story originating from Candraprabhāsa, Piḍodā, Śrīmātā, and Śuklatīrtha, / and the eulogy of greatness of Kātyāyanī, and then of Piṇḍāraka;

1.104.s:
tataḥ kanakhalasyātha cakramānuṣatīrthayoḥ /
kapilāgnitīrthakathā tathā raktānubandhajā //
1.104.d:
ततः कनखलस्याथ चक्रमानुषतीर्थयोः ।
कपिलाग्नितीर्थकथा तथा रक्तानुबन्धजा ॥
1.104.m: then of Kanakhala, and then of the two sacred fords Cakra and Mānuṣa, / the story of Kapilā and Agnitīrtha, and also that arising from Raktānubandha;

1.104.s:
gaṇeśapārtheśvarayoryāntrāyāmujjvalasya ca /
caṇḍīsthānanāgodbhavaśivakuṇḍamaheśajā //
1.104.d:
गणेशपार्थेश्वरयोर्यान्त्रायामुज्ज्वलस्य च ।
चण्डीस्थाननागोद्भवशिवकुण्डमहेशजा ॥
1.104.m: at the pilgrimage of Gaṇeśa, Pārtheśvara, and Ujjvala, / the story arising from Caṇḍīsthāna, Nāgodbhava, Śivakuṇḍa, and Maheśa;

1.104.s:
kāmeśvarasya mārkaṇḍeyotpatteśca kathā tataḥ /
uddālakeśasiddheśagatatīthakathā pṛthak //
1.104.d:
कामेश्वरस्य मार्कण्डेयोत्पत्तेश्च कथा ततः ।
उद्दालकेशसिद्धेशगततीथकथा पृथक् ॥
1.104.m: then the story of Kāmeśvara and the birth of Mārkaṇḍeya, / [and] separately the stories of Uddālakeśa, Siddheśa, and Gatatīrtha;

1.104.s:
śrīdevaravātotpattiśca vyāsagautamatīrthayoḥ /
kulasaṃtāramāhātmyaṃ rāmakoṭyāhvatīrthayoḥ //
1.104.d:
श्रीदेवरवातोत्पत्तिश्च व्यासगौतमतीर्थयोः ।
कुलसंतारमाहात्म्यं रामकोट्याह्वतीर्थयोः ॥
1.104.m: the origin of Śrīdevaravāta, and of the two sacred fords Vyāsa and Gautama, / the eulogy of greatness of saving one's lineage at the two sacred fords called Rāmakoṭi;

1.104.s:
candrodbhedeśānaśṛṅgabrahmasthānodbhavo 'dbhutam /
tripuṣkararudrahradaguheśvara kathā śubhā //
1.104.d:
चन्द्रोद्भेदेशानशृङ्गब्रह्मस्थानोद्भवो ऽद्भुतम् ।
त्रिपुष्कररुद्रह्रदगुहेश्वर कथा शुभा ॥
1.104.m: the wondrous emergence of Candrodbheda, Īśānaśṛṅga, and Brahmasthāna, / the auspicious story of Tripuṣkara, Rudrahrada, and Guheśvara;

1.104.s:
avimuktasya māhātmyamumāmāheśvarasya ca /
mahaujasaḥ prabhāvaśca jaṃbūtīrthasya varṇanam //
1.104.d:
अविमुक्तस्य माहात्म्यमुमामाहेश्वरस्य च ।
महौजसः प्रभावश्च जंबूतीर्थस्य वर्णनम् ॥
1.104.m: the eulogy of greatness of Avimukta and of Umāmāheśvara, / the power of Mahaujas, and the description of Jaṃbūtīrtha;

1.104.s:
gaṅgādharamiśrakayoḥ kathā vāthaphalastutiḥ /
dvārakāyāśca māhātmye candraśarmakathānakam //
1.104.d:
गङ्गाधरमिश्रकयोः कथा वाथफलस्तुतिः ।
द्वारकायाश्च माहात्म्ये चन्द्रशर्मकथानकम् ॥
1.104.m: the story of Gaṅgādhara and Miśraka, or the praise of rewards, / and in the eulogy of greatness of Dvārakā, the narrative of Candraśarman;

1.104.s:
jāgarādyarcanādyākhyā vratamekādaśībhavam /
mahādvādaśikākhyānaṃ prahlādarṣisamāgamaḥ //
1.104.d:
जागराद्यर्चनाद्याख्या व्रतमेकादशीभवम् ।
महाद्वादशिकाख्यानं प्रह्लादर्षिसमागमः ॥
1.104.m: the account of the vigil, worship, and the rest, the observance of the eleventh lunar day, / the narrative of the Mahādvādaśī, the meeting of Prahlāda and the sage;

1.104.s:
durvāsasa upākhyānaṃ yātropakramakīrtanam /
gomatyutpattikathanaṃ tasyāṃ snānādijaṃ phalam //
1.104.d:
दुर्वासस उपाख्यानं यात्रोपक्रमकीर्तनम् ।
गोमत्युत्पत्तिकथनं तस्यां स्नानादिजं फलम् ॥
1.104.m: the short narrative of Durvāsas, the account of the commencement of the pilgrimage, / the story of the origin of the Gomatī, and the fruit arising from bathing and other rites in it;

1.104.s:
cakratīrthasya māhātmyaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgamaḥ /
sanakādihradākhyānaṃ nṛgatīrthakathā tataḥ //
1.104.d:
चक्रतीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं गोमत्युदधिसंगमः ।
सनकादिह्रदाख्यानं नृगतीर्थकथा ततः ॥
1.104.m: the eulogy of greatness of Cakratīrtha, the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, / the narrative of the pool of Sanaka and the others, then the story of Nṛgatīrtha;

1.104.s:
gopracārakathā puṇyā gopīnāṃ dvārakāgamaḥ /
gopīsaraḥ samākhyānaṃ brahmatīrthādikīrtanam //
1.104.d:
गोप्रचारकथा पुण्या गोपीनां द्वारकागमः ।
गोपीसरः समाख्यानं ब्रह्मतीर्थादिकीर्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: the holy story of Gopracāra, the arrival of the cowherd women at Dvārakā, / the narrative of the Gopī Lake, the glorification of Brahmatīrtha and the rest;

1.104.s:
pañcanadyāgamākhyānaṃ nānākhyānasamanvitam /
śivaliṅgagadātīrthakṛṣṇapūjādikīrtanam //
1.104.d:
पञ्चनद्यागमाख्यानं नानाख्यानसमन्वितम् ।
शिवलिङ्गगदातीर्थकृष्णपूजादिकीर्तनम् ॥
1.104.m: the narrative of the arrival of the five rivers endowed with various accounts, / the mention of the Śivaliṅga, Gadātīrtha, the worship of Kṛṣṇa, and other matters;

1.104.s:
trivikramasya mūrtākhyā durvāsaḥkṛṣṇasaṃkathā /
kuśadaityavadhoñcāraviśeṣārcanajaṃ phalam //
1.104.d:
त्रिविक्रमस्य मूर्ताख्या दुर्वासःकृष्णसंकथा ।
कुशदैत्यवधोञ्चारविशेषार्चनजं फलम् ॥
1.104.m: the account of the form of Trivikrama, the conversation between Durvāsas and Kṛṣṇa, / the slaying of the demon Kuśa, and the reward arising from the special worship of gleaners;

1.104.s:
gomatyāṃ dvārakāyāṃ ca tīrthāgamanakīrtanam /
kṛṣṇamandirasaṃprekṣā drāravatyabhiṣecanam //
1.104.d:
गोमत्यां द्वारकायां च तीर्थागमनकीर्तनम् ।
कृष्णमन्दिरसंप्रेक्षा द्रारवत्यभिषेचनम् ॥
1.104.m: the mention of visiting the sacred fords at the Gomatī and Dvārakā, / beholding Kṛṣṇa's temple, the ritual sprinkling of Dvāravatī;

1.104.s:
tatratīrthāvāsakathā dvārakāpuṇyakīrtanam /
ityeṣa saptamaḥ proktaḥ khaṇḍaḥ prābhāsiko dvijāḥ //
1.104.d:
तत्रतीर्थावासकथा द्वारकापुण्यकीर्तनम् ।
इत्येष सप्तमः प्रोक्तः खण्डः प्राभासिको द्विजाः ॥
1.104.m: the account of residing in the sacred ford there, the praise of the merits of Dvārakā— / thus has been declared the seventh section, the Prābhāsika, O twice-born ones,

1.104.s:
skāndesarvottarakathe śibamāhātmyavarṇane /
likhitvaitattu yo dadyāddhemaśūlasamanvitam //
1.104.d:
स्कान्देसर्वोत्तरकथे शिबमाहात्म्यवर्णने ।
लिखित्वैतत्तु यो दद्याद्धेमशूलसमन्वितम् ॥
1.104.m: in the Skanda Purāṇa, whose narratives are supreme over all, describing the eulogy of greatness of Śiva. / Having written this down, whoever gives it along with a golden trident,

1.104.s:
mādhyāṃ satkṛtya viprāya sa śaive modate pade //
iti śrībṛhannāradīya purāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde skandapurāṇānukramaṇīvarṇanaṃ nāma caturadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.104.d:
माध्यां सत्कृत्य विप्राय स शैवे मोदते पदे ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीय पुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे स्कन्दपुराणानुक्रमणीवर्णनं नाम चतुरधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
1.104.m:
on the full moon day of the month of Māgha, having honoured a brāhmaṇa, rejoices in the abode of Śiva.

Thus ends the one hundred and fourth chapter in the fourth quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa, entitled 'The Description of the Table of Contents of the Skanda Purāṇa'.

1.105.s:
brahmovāca
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ vāmanābhidham /
trivikramacaritrāḍhyaṃ daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakam //
1.105.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
शृणु वत्स प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणं वामनाभिधम् ।
त्रिविक्रमचरित्राढ्यं दशसाहस्रसंख्यकम् ॥
1.105.m:
Brahmā said:
Listen, my child, I shall describe the Purāṇa named Vāmana, / rich in the deeds of Trivikrama, consisting of ten thousand [verses],

1.105.s:
kūrmakalpasamākhyānaṃ vargatrayakathānam /
bhāgadvayasamāyuktaṃ vaktṛśrotṛśubhāvaham //
1.105.d:
कूर्मकल्पसमाख्यानं वर्गत्रयकथानम् ।
भागद्वयसमायुक्तं वक्तृश्रोतृशुभावहम् ॥
1.105.m: containing the narrative of the Kūrma Kalpa, describing the three goals of life, / consisting of two parts, bringing welfare to speaker and listener alike.

1.105.s:
purāṇapraśnaḥ prathamaṃ brahmaśīrṣacchidā tataḥ /
kapālamocanākhyānaṃ dakṣayajñavihiṃsanam //
1.105.d:
पुराणप्रश्नः प्रथमं ब्रह्मशीर्षच्छिदा ततः ।
कपालमोचनाख्यानं दक्षयज्ञविहिंसनम् ॥
1.105.m: First is the inquiry into the Purāṇa; then the severing of Brahmā's head; / the narrative of release from the skull; the destruction of Dakṣa's sacrifice;

1.105.s:
harasya kālarūpākhyā kāmasya dahanaṃ tataḥ /
prahlādanārāyaṇayoryuddhaṃ devāsurāhavaḥ //
1.105.d:
हरस्य कालरूपाख्या कामस्य दहनं ततः ।
प्रह्लादनारायणयोर्युद्धं देवासुराहवः ॥
1.105.m: the account of Hara's form as Time; then the burning of the god of love; / the battle between Prahlāda and Nārāyaṇa; the war between the gods and asuras;

1.105.s:
sukeśyarkasamākhyānaṃ tato bhuvanakośakam /
tataḥ kāmyavratākhyānaṃ śrīdurgācaritaṃ tataḥ //
1.105.d:
सुकेश्यर्कसमाख्यानं ततो भुवनकोशकम् ।
ततः काम्यव्रताख्यानं श्रीदुर्गाचरितं ततः ॥
1.105.m: the narrative of Sukeśin and the Sun; then the constitution of the universe; / then the account of optional observances; then the deeds of glorious Durgā;

1.105.s:
tapatīcaritaṃ paścātkurukṣetrasya varṇanam /
satyāmāhātmyamatulaṃ pārvatījanmakīrtanam //
1.105.d:
तपतीचरितं पश्चात्कुरुक्षेत्रस्य वर्णनम् ।
सत्यामाहात्म्यमतुलं पार्वतीजन्मकीर्तनम् ॥
1.105.m: the deeds of Tapatī; after that the description of Kurukṣetra; / the peerless eulogy of greatness of the faithful wife; the recounting of Pārvatī's birth;

1.105.s:
tapastasyā vivāhaśca gauryupākhyānakaṃ tataḥ /
tataḥ kauśikyupākhyānaṃ kumāracaritaṃ tataḥ //
1.105.d:
तपस्तस्या विवाहश्च गौर्युपाख्यानकं ततः ।
ततः कौशिक्युपाख्यानं कुमारचरितं ततः ॥
1.105.m: her asceticism and marriage; then the short narrative of Gaurī; / then the short narrative of Kauśikī; then the deeds of Kumāra;

1.105.s:
tato 'ndhakavadhākhyānaṃsādhyopākhyānakantataḥ /
jābālicaritaṃ paścādarajāyāḥ kathādbhutā //
1.105.d:
ततो ऽन्धकवधाख्यानंसाध्योपाख्यानकन्ततः ।
जाबालिचरितं पश्चादरजायाः कथाद्भुता ॥
1.105.m: then the narrative of the slaying of Andhaka; then the short narrative of the Sādhyas; / after that the deeds of Jābāli; the wondrous story of Arajā;

1.105.s:
andhakeśarayoryuddhaṃ gaṇatvaṃ cāndhakasya ca /
marutāṃ janmakathanaṃ baleśca caritaṃ tataḥ //
1.105.d:
अन्धकेशरयोर्युद्धं गणत्वं चान्धकस्य च ।
मरुतां जन्मकथनं बलेश्च चरितं ततः ॥
1.105.m: the battle between Andhaka and Śiva; and Andhaka's attaining the status of an attendant; / the description of the birth of the Maruts; then the deeds of Bali;

1.105.s:
tatastu lakṣmyāścaritaṃ traivikramamataḥ param /
prahlādatīrthayātrāyāṃ procyante 'tha kathāḥ śubhāḥ //
1.105.d:
ततस्तु लक्ष्म्याश्चरितं त्रैविक्रममतः परम् ।
प्रह्लादतीर्थयात्रायां प्रोच्यन्ते ऽथ कथाः शुभाः ॥
1.105.m: and then the deeds of Lakṣmī; thereafter that of Trivikrama; / then auspicious stories are told during Prahlāda’s pilgrimage to sacred fords;

1.105.s:
tataśca dhundhu caritaṃ pretopākhyānakaṃ tataḥ /
nakṣatrapuruṣākhyānaṃ śrīdāmacaritaṃ tataḥ //
1.105.d:
ततश्च धुन्धु चरितं प्रेतोपाख्यानकं ततः ।
नक्षत्रपुरुषाख्यानं श्रीदामचरितं ततः ॥
1.105.m: and then the deeds of Dhundhu; then the short narrative of the ghost; / the narrative of the Astral Person; then the deeds of Śrīdāman;

1.105.s:
trivikramacaritrānte brahmaproktaḥ stavottamaḥ /
prahlādabalisaṃvāde sutale hariśaṃsanam //
1.105.d:
त्रिविक्रमचरित्रान्ते ब्रह्मप्रोक्तः स्तवोत्तमः ।
प्रह्लादबलिसंवादे सुतले हरिशंसनम् ॥
1.105.m: at the end of Trivikrama’s deeds, the supreme hymn uttered by Brahmā; / the praise of Hari in Sutala during the dialogue between Prahlāda and Bali:

1.105.s:
ityeṣa pūrvabhāgo 'sya purāṇasya tavoditaḥ /
śṛṇṇato 'syottaraṃ bhāgaṃ bahadvāmanasaṃjñakam //
1.105.d:
इत्येष पूर्वभागो ऽस्य पुराणस्य तवोदितः ।
शृण्णतो ऽस्योत्तरं भागं बहद्वामनसंज्ञकम् ॥
1.105.m: thus this first part of this Purāṇa has been proclaimed to you. / Now hear its second part, known as the Bṛhadvāmana:

1.105.s:
māheśvarī bhāgavatī saurī gāṇeśvarī tathā /
catasraḥ saṃhitāścātra pṛthak sāhasrasaṃkhyayā //
1.105.d:
माहेश्वरी भागवती सौरी गाणेश्वरी तथा ।
चतस्रः संहिताश्चात्र पृथक् साहस्रसंख्यया ॥
1.105.m: the Māheśvarī, the Bhāgavatī, the Saurī, and likewise the Gāṇeśvarī; / and here are four collections, each consisting of a thousand [verses].

1.105.s:
māheśvaryāṃ tu kṛṣṇasya tadbhaktānāṃ ca kīrtanam /
bhāgavatyāṃ jaganmātukhatārakathādbhutā //
1.105.d:
माहेश्वर्यां तु कृष्णस्य तद्भक्तानां च कीर्तनम् ।
भागवत्यां जगन्मातुखतारकथाद्भुता ॥
1.105.m: In the Māheśvarī, indeed, is the glorification of Kṛṣṇa and his devotees; / in the Bhāgavatī is the wondrous tale of the Mother of the Universe;

1.105.s:
sauryāṃ sūryasya mahimā gaditaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ /
gāṇeśvaryāṃ gaṇeśasya caritaṃ ca maheśituḥ //
1.105.d:
सौर्यां सूर्यस्य महिमा गदितः पापनाशनः ।
गाणेश्वर्यां गणेशस्य चरितं च महेशितुः ॥
1.105.m: in the Saurī, the sin-destroying greatness of the Sun is described; / in the Gāṇeśvarī are the deeds of Gaṇeśa and the great Lord.

1.105.s:
ityetadvāmanaṃ nāma purāṇaṃ suvicitrakam /
pulastyena samākhyātaṃ nāradāya mahātmane //
1.105.d:
इत्येतद्वामनं नाम पुराणं सुविचित्रकम् ।
पुलस्त्येन समाख्यातं नारदाय महात्मने ॥
1.105.m: Thus this very wonderful Purāṇa named Vāmana / was fully recounted by Pulastya to the great-souled Nārada;

1.105.s:
tato nāradataḥ prāptaṃ vyāsena sumahātmanā /
vyāsāttu labdhavāṃścaitat tacchiṣyo romaharṣaṇaḥ //
1.105.d:
ततो नारदतः प्राप्तं व्यासेन सुमहात्मना ।
व्यासात्तु लब्धवांश्चैतत् तच्छिष्यो रोमहर्षणः ॥
1.105.m: then it was obtained from Nārada by the very great-souled Vyāsa; / and from Vyāsa his pupil Romaharṣaṇa received it;

1.105.s:
sa cākhyāsyati viprebhyo naimiṣīyebhya eva ca /
evaṃ paraṃparāprāptaṃ purāṇaṃ vāmanaṃ śubham //
1.105.d:
स चाख्यास्यति विप्रेभ्यो नैमिषीयेभ्य एव च ।
एवं परंपराप्राप्तं पुराणं वामनं शुभम् ॥
1.105.m: and he will recite it to the brāhmaṇas dwelling in Naimiṣa. / Thus received through tradition is the auspicious Vāmana Purāṇa.

1.105.s:
ye paṭhanti ca śṛṇvanti te 'pi yānti parāṃ gatim /
likhitvaitatpurāṇaṃ tu yaḥ śaradviṣuver'payet //
1.105.d:
ये पठन्ति च शृण्वन्ति ते ऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ।
लिखित्वैतत्पुराणं तु यः शरद्विषुवेर्ऽपयेत् ॥
1.105.m: Those who read and hear it also attain the supreme state. / And having transcribed this Purāṇa, whoever presents it at the autumnal equinox

1.105.s:
viprāya vedaviduṣe ghṛtadhenusamanvitam /
sa samuddhṛtya narakānnayetsvargaṃ pitṝnsvakān //
dehānte bhuktabhogo 'sau yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde vāmanapurāṇānukramaṇīvarṇanaṃ nāma pañcādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.105.d:
विप्राय वेदविदुषे घृतधेनुसमन्वितम् ।
स समुद्धृत्य नरकान्नयेत्स्वर्गं पितॄन्स्वकान् ॥
देहान्ते भुक्तभोगो ऽसौ याति विष्णोः परं पदम् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे वामनपुराणानुक्रमणीवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
1.105.m:
to a brāhmaṇa learned in the Vedas along with a cow made of ghee, / he, having delivered his ancestors from hell, leads them to heaven; / having enjoyed pleasures, at the end of the body he goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

Thus ends the one hundred and fifth chapter, titled "Description of the Contents of the Vāmana Purāṇa," in the Fourth Part of the Great Narrative in the First Section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

1.106.s:
brahmovāca
śṛṇu vatsa marīce tvaṃ purāṇaṃ kūrmasaṃjñakam /
lakṣmīkalpānucaritaṃ yatra kūrmavapurhariḥ //
1.106.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
शृणु वत्स मरीचे त्वं पुराणं कूर्मसंज्ञकम् ।
लक्ष्मीकल्पानुचरितं यत्र कूर्मवपुर्हरिः ॥
1.106.m: Brahmā said: / Listen, dear Marīci, to the Purāṇa called Kūrma, / wherein Hari assumed the form of a tortoise during the events of the Lakṣmīkalpa,

1.106.s:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ māhātmyaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak /
indradyumnaprasaṃgena prāharṣibhyo dayānvitaḥ //
1.106.d:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां माहात्म्यं च पृथक्पृथक् ।
इन्द्रद्युम्नप्रसंगेन प्राहर्षिभ्यो दयान्वितः ॥
1.106.m: and out of compassion, in the course of [the story of] Indradyumna, told the sages / the eulogy of the greatness of dharma, wealth, desire, and liberation individually.

1.106.s:
tatsaptadaśasāhasraṃ sucatuḥ saṃhitaṃ śubham /
yatra brāhmāḥ purā proktā dharmā nānāvidhā mune //
1.106.d:
तत्सप्तदशसाहस्रं सुचतुः संहितं शुभम् ।
यत्र ब्राह्माः पुरा प्रोक्ता धर्मा नानाविधा मुने ॥
1.106.m: It contains seventeen thousand [verses], comprises four fine saṃhitās, is auspicious, / and in it, O sage, various Brāhmic duties were formerly declared,

1.106.s:
nānanākathāprasaṃgena nṛṇāṃ sadgatidāyakāḥ /
tatra pūrvavibhāge tu purāṇopakramaḥ purā //
1.106.d:
नाननाकथाप्रसंगेन नृणां सद्गतिदायकाः ।
तत्र पूर्वविभागे तु पुराणोपक्रमः पुरा ॥
1.106.m: which bestow the good state on men through various narratives. / In its first division, there is first the introduction to the Purāṇa,

1.106.s:
lakṣmīndradyumnasaṃvādaḥ kūrṃmarṣigaṇasaṃkathā /
varṇāśramācārakathā jagadutpattikīrtanam //
kālasaṃkhyā samāsena layānte stavanaṃ vibhoḥ //
1.106.d:
लक्ष्मीन्द्रद्युम्नसंवादः कूर्ंमर्षिगणसंकथा ।
वर्णाश्रमाचारकथा जगदुत्पत्तिकीर्तनम् ॥
कालसंख्या समासेन लयान्ते स्तवनं विभोः ॥
1.106.m:
the dialogue between Lakṣmī and Indradyumna, the conversation between the Kūrma and the host of sages, / the discourse on the conduct of castes and stages of life, the account of the creation of the universe,

the calculation of time in brief, the praise of the Lord at the end of dissolution,

1.106.s: tataḥ saṃkṣepataḥ sargaḥ śāṅkaraṃ caritaṃ tathā //
1.106.d: ततः संक्षेपतः सर्गः शाङ्करं चरितं तथा ॥
1.106.m: then creation in brief, as well as the deeds of Śiva,

1.106.s:
sahasranāma pārvatyā yogasya ca nirūpaṇam /
bhṛguvaṃśasamākhyānaṃ tataḥ svāyambhuvasya ca //
1.106.d:
सहस्रनाम पार्वत्या योगस्य च निरूपणम् ।
भृगुवंशसमाख्यानं ततः स्वायम्भुवस्य च ॥
1.106.m: the thousand names of Pārvatī, the determination of yoga, / the complete narration of the lineage of Bhṛgu, and then of Svāyambhuva,

1.106.s:
devādīnāṃ samutpattirdakṣayajñāhatistataḥ /
dakṣasṛṣṭikathā paścātkaśyapānvayakīrtanam //
1.106.d:
देवादीनां समुत्पत्तिर्दक्षयज्ञाहतिस्ततः ।
दक्षसृष्टिकथा पश्चात्कश्यपान्वयकीर्तनम् ॥
1.106.m: the birth of the gods and others, then the destruction of Dakṣa’s sacrifice, / the story of Dakṣa's creation, followed by the account of the lineage of Kaśyapa,

1.106.s:
ātreyavaṃśakathanaṃ kṛṣṇasyaṃ caritaṃ śubham /
mārtaṇḍakṛṣṇasaṃvādo vyāsapāṇḍavasaṃkathā //
1.106.d:
आत्रेयवंशकथनं कृष्णस्यं चरितं शुभम् ।
मार्तण्डकृष्णसंवादो व्यासपाण्डवसंकथा ॥
1.106.m: the narration of the lineage of Atri, the auspicious deeds of Kṛṣṇa, / the dialogue between Mārtaṇḍa and Kṛṣṇa, the discourse between Vyāsa and the Pāṇḍavas,

1.106.s:
yugadharmānukathanaṃ vyāsajaiminikīrtanam /
vārāṇasyāśca māhātmyaṃ prayāgasya tataḥ param //
1.106.d:
युगधर्मानुकथनं व्यासजैमिनिकीर्तनम् ।
वाराणस्याश्च माहात्म्यं प्रयागस्य ततः परम् ॥
1.106.m: the narration of the duties of the yugas, the account of Vyāsa and Jaimini, / the eulogy of the greatness of Vārāṇasī, and after that, of Prayāga,

1.106.s:
trailokyavarṇanaṃ caiva vedaśākhānirūpaṇam /
uttare 'syā vibhāge tu purā gītaiśvarī tataḥ //
1.106.d:
त्रैलोक्यवर्णनं चैव वेदशाखानिरूपणम् ।
उत्तरे ऽस्या विभागे तु पुरा गीतैश्वरी ततः ॥
1.106.m: the description of the three worlds, and the determination of the branches of the Veda. / In its latter division, there is first the Īśvaragītā,

1.106.s:
vyāsagītā tataḥ proktā nānādharmaprabodhinī /
nānāvidhānāṃ tīrthānāṃ māhātmyaṃ ca pṛthak tataḥ //
1.106.d:
व्यासगीता ततः प्रोक्ता नानाधर्मप्रबोधिनी ।
नानाविधानां तीर्थानां माहात्म्यं च पृथक् ततः ॥
1.106.m: then the Vyāsagītā is spoken, teaching various duties, / and after that, the eulogy of the greatness of various sacred fords separately,

1.106.s:
pratisargaprakathanaṃ brāhmīyaṃ saṃhitā smṛtā /
ataḥ paraṃ bhāgavatīsaṃhitārtha nirūpaṇam //
1.106.d:
प्रतिसर्गप्रकथनं ब्राह्मीयं संहिता स्मृता ।
अतः परं भागवतीसंहितार्थ निरूपणम् ॥
1.106.m: and the declaration of secondary creation: this is recorded as the Brāhmī Saṃhitā. / Next is the determination of the meaning of the Bhāgavatī Saṃhitā,

1.106.s:
kathitā yatra varṇānāṃ pṛthakvṛttirudāhṛtā /
pāda'syāḥ prathame proktā brāhmaṇānāṃ vyavasthitiḥ //
1.106.d:
कथिता यत्र वर्णानां पृथक्वृत्तिरुदाहृता ।
पादऽस्याः प्रथमे प्रोक्ता ब्राह्मणानां व्यवस्थितिः ॥
1.106.m: in which the separate livelihoods of the castes are stated and explained. / In its first quarter, the conduct of Brāhmaṇas is taught,

1.106.s:
sadā cāgatmikā vatsa bhogasaukhyavivarddhanī /
dvitīye kṣattriyāṇāṃ tu vṛttiḥ samyakprakīrtitā //
1.106.d:
सदा चागत्मिका वत्स भोगसौख्यविवर्द्धनी ।
द्वितीये क्षत्त्रियाणां तु वृत्तिः सम्यक्प्रकीर्तिता ॥
1.106.m: consisting of good conduct, dear one, increasing enjoyment and happiness. / In the second [quarter], the livelihood of Kṣatriyas is fully declared,

1.106.s:
yayā tvāśritayā pāpaṃ vidhūyeha vrajeddivam /
tṛtīye vaiśyajātīnāṃ vṛttiruktā caturvidhā //
1.106.d:
यया त्वाश्रितया पापं विधूयेह व्रजेद्दिवम् ।
तृतीये वैश्यजातीनां वृत्तिरुक्ता चतुर्विधा ॥
1.106.m: resorting to which, having shaken off sin, one goes to heaven in this world. / In the third, the fourfold livelihood of the Vaiśya caste is taught,

1.106.s:
yayā caritayā samyaglabhe gatimuttamām /
caturthe 'syāstathā pāde śūdravṛttirudāhṛtā //
1.106.d:
यया चरितया सम्यग्लभे गतिमुत्तमाम् ।
चतुर्थे ऽस्यास्तथा पादे शूद्रवृत्तिरुदाहृता ॥
1.106.m: by practicing which properly one attains the highest state. / Likewise, in its fourth quarter, the livelihood of Śūdras is declared,

1.106.s:
yayā saṃtuṣyati śrīśo nṛṇāṃ śreyovivarddhanaḥ /
pañcame 'syāstataḥ pāde vṛttiḥ saṃkarajoditā //
1.106.d:
यया संतुष्यति श्रीशो नृणां श्रेयोविवर्द्धनः ।
पञ्चमे ऽस्यास्ततः पादे वृत्तिः संकरजोदिता ॥
1.106.m: with which the Lord of Śrī, who increases the welfare of humans, is pleased. / Then, in its fifth quarter, the livelihood of those born of mixed castes is taught,

1.106.s:
yayā caritayāpnoti bhāvinīṃ gatimuttamām /
ityeṣā pañcapadyuktā dvitīyā saṃhitā mune //
1.106.d:
यया चरितयाप्नोति भाविनीं गतिमुत्तमाम् ।
इत्येषा पञ्चपद्युक्ता द्वितीया संहिता मुने ॥
1.106.m: by practicing which one attains an excellent future state. / Thus has the second saṃhitā consisting of five quarters been declared, O sage.

1.106.s:
tṛtīyātroditā saurī nṝṇāṃ kāryavidhāyinī /
ṣoḍhā ṣaṭkarmasirddhi bodhayantī ca kāminām //
1.106.d:
तृतीयात्रोदिता सौरी नॄणां कार्यविधायिनी ।
षोढा षट्कर्मसिर्द्धि बोधयन्ती च कामिनाम् ॥
1.106.m: The third stated here is the Saurī [Saṃhitā], which accomplishes men's purposes, / making known sixfold the attainment of the six magical rites for desire-bound people.

1.106.s:
caturthīvaiṣṇavo nāma mokṣadā parikīrtitā /
catuṣpadī dvijātīnāṃ sākṣādbrahmasvarūriṇī //
1.106.d:
चतुर्थीवैष्णवो नाम मोक्षदा परिकीर्तिता ।
चतुष्पदी द्विजातीनां साक्षाद्ब्रह्मस्वरूरिणी ॥
1.106.m: The fourth is named Vaiṣṇavī, proclaimed as granting liberation, / possessing four quarters, directly having the nature of Brahman for the twice-born.

1.106.s: tāḥ kramātṣaṭcaturdvīṣusāhasrāḥ parikīrtitāḥ //
1.106.d: ताः क्रमात्षट्चतुर्द्वीषुसाहस्राः परिकीर्तिताः ॥
1.106.m: They are proclaimed to consist of six, four, two, and five thousand [verses] respectively.

1.106.s:
etatkūrmapurāṇaṃ tu caturvargaphalapradam /
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvotkṛṣṭagatipradam //
1.106.d:
एतत्कूर्मपुराणं तु चतुर्वर्गफलप्रदम् ।
पठतां शृण्वतां नॄणां सर्वोत्कृष्टगतिप्रदम् ॥
1.106.m: This Kūrma Purāṇa bestows the fruit of the four goals of life; / it bestows the highest state on men who read and listen to it.

1.106.s:
likhitvaitattu yo bhaktyā hemakūrmasamanvitam /
brāhmaṇāyā yane dadyātsa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde kūrmaparāṇānukramaṇīkathanaṃ nāma ṣaḍuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.106.d:
लिखित्वैतत्तु यो भक्त्या हेमकूर्मसमन्वितम् ।
ब्राह्मणाया यने दद्यात्स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे कूर्मपराणानुक्रमणीकथनं नाम षडुत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः
1.106.m:
Whoever, having written it out with devotion, gives it with a golden tortoise / to a Brāhmaṇa during an equinox/solstice attains the supreme abode.

Thus ends the one hundred and sixth chapter, titled "Description of the Contents of the Kūrma Purāṇa," in the Fourth Part of the Great Narrative in the First Section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

1.107.s:
brahmovāca
atha mātsyaṃ purāṇaṃ te pravakṣye dvijasattama /
yatroktaṃ saptakalpānāṃ vṛttaṃ saṃkṣipya bhūtale //
1.107.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
अथ मात्स्यं पुराणं ते प्रवक्ष्ये द्विजसत्तम ।
यत्रोक्तं सप्तकल्पानां वृत्तं संक्षिप्य भूतले ॥
1.107.m: Brahmā said: / Now I shall tell you the Matsya Purāṇa, O best of the twice-born, / in which the events of seven kalpas on earth are spoken in summary

1.107.s:
vyāsena vedaviduṣā nārasiṃhopavarṇane /
upakramya taduddiṣṭaṃ caturddaśasahasrakam //
1.107.d:
व्यासेन वेदविदुषा नारसिंहोपवर्णने ।
उपक्रम्य तदुद्दिष्टं चतुर्द्दशसहस्रकम् ॥
1.107.m: by Vyāsa, who knows the Vedas, in the description of Nṛsiṃha; / introduced [there], it is taught as consisting of fourteen thousand [verses].

1.107.s:
manumatsyasusaṃvādo brahmāṇḍakathanaṃ tataḥ /
brahmadevāsurotpattirmārutotpattireva ca //
1.107.d:
मनुमत्स्यसुसंवादो ब्रह्माण्डकथनं ततः ।
ब्रह्मदेवासुरोत्पत्तिर्मारुतोत्पत्तिरेव च ॥
1.107.m: The dialogue between Manu and the Fish, then the description of the cosmic egg, / the birth of Brahmā, the gods, and the asuras, and the origin of the winds,

1.107.s:
madanadvādaśī tadvallokapālābhipūjanam /
manvantarasamuddeśo vaiśyarājyābhivarṇanam //
1.107.d:
मदनद्वादशी तद्वल्लोकपालाभिपूजनम् ।
मन्वन्तरसमुद्देशो वैश्यराज्याभिवर्णनम् ॥
1.107.m: likewise the Madanadvādaśī [vow], worship of the guardians of the world, / the enumeration of the manvantaras, the description of the kingdom of the Vaiśyas,

1.107.s:
sūryavaivasvatotpattirbudhasaṃgamanaṃ tathā /
pitṛvaṃśānukathanaṃ śraddhākālastathaiva ca //
1.107.d:
सूर्यवैवस्वतोत्पत्तिर्बुधसंगमनं तथा ।
पितृवंशानुकथनं श्रद्धाकालस्तथैव च ॥
1.107.m: the birth of Sūrya and Vaivasvata, likewise the meeting with Budha, / the narration of the lineage of the ancestors, and likewise the proper times for ancestral rites,

1.107.s:
pitṛtīrthapracāraśca somotpattistathaiva ca /
kīrtanaṃ somavaṃśasya yayāticaritaṃ tathā //
1.107.d:
पितृतीर्थप्रचारश्च सोमोत्पत्तिस्तथैव च ।
कीर्तनं सोमवंशस्य ययातिचरितं तथा ॥
1.107.m: the pilgrimage to the sacred fords for ancestors, and likewise the origin of Soma, / the recitation of the Lunar dynasty, and the life of Yayāti,

1.107.s:
pitṛvaṃśānukathanaṃ sṛṣṭavaṃśānukīrtanam /
bhṛguśāpastathā viṣṇordaśadhā janmane kṣitau //
1.107.d:
पितृवंशानुकथनं सृष्टवंशानुकीर्तनम् ।
भृगुशापस्तथा विष्णोर्दशधा जन्मने क्षितौ ॥
1.107.m: the narration of the lineage of the ancestors, the account of the lineages of creation, / and the curse of Bhṛgu for the ten incarnations of Viṣṇu on earth,

1.107.s:
kīrttanaṃ pūruvaṃśasya vaṃśo hautāśanaḥ param /
kriyāyogastataḥ paścātpurāṇaparikīrtanam //
1.107.d:
कीर्त्तनं पूरुवंशस्य वंशो हौताशनः परम् ।
क्रियायोगस्ततः पश्चात्पुराणपरिकीर्तनम् ॥
1.107.m: the recitation of the lineage of Pūru, then the lineage of Agni, / then kriyāyoga, followed by the recitation of the Purāṇas,

1.107.s:
vrataṃ nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ mārtaṇḍaśayanaṃ tathā /
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvrataṃ tadvadrohiṇīcandrasaṃjñitam //
1.107.d:
व्रतं नक्षत्रपुरुषं मार्तण्डशयनं तथा ।
कृष्णाष्टमीव्रतं तद्वद्रोहिणीचन्द्रसंज्ञितम् ॥
1.107.m: the Nakṣatrapuruṣa vow, and the Mārtaṇḍaśayana [vow], / likewise the Kṛṣṇāṣṭamī vow, and the one named Rohiṇīcandra,

1.107.s:
taḍāgavidhi māhātmyaṃ pādapotsarga eva ca /
saubhāgyaśayanaṃ tadvadagastyavratameva ca //
1.107.d:
तडागविधि माहात्म्यं पादपोत्सर्ग एव च ।
सौभाग्यशयनं तद्वदगस्त्यव्रतमेव च ॥
1.107.m: the rules and eulogy of greatness of tanks, the dedication of trees, / likewise the Saubhāgyaśayana [vow], and the Agastya vow,

1.107.s:
tathānantatṛtīyāyā rasakalyāṇinīvratam /
tathaivānaṃ dakaryāśca vrataṃ sārasvataṃ punaḥ //
1.107.d:
तथानन्ततृतीयाया रसकल्याणिनीव्रतम् ।
तथैवानं दकर्याश्च व्रतं सारस्वतं पुनः ॥
1.107.m: likewise the Rasakalyāṇinī vow on Anantatṛtīyā, / and likewise the Ānandakarī [vow], and then the Sārasvata vow,

1.107.s:
uparāgābhiṣekaśca saptamīśanaṃ tathā /
bhīmākhyā dvādaśī tadvadanaṅgaśayanaṃ tathā //
1.107.d:
उपरागाभिषेकश्च सप्तमीशनं तथा ।
भीमाख्या द्वादशी तद्वदनङ्गशयनं तथा ॥
1.107.m: the bath during an eclipse, and the Saptamīśayana [vow], / likewise the dvādaśī named Bhīmā, and the Anaṅgaśayana [vow],

1.107.s:
aśūnyaśayanaṃ tadvattathaivāṅgārakavratam /
saptamīsaptakaṃ tadvadviśokadvādaśīvratam //
1.107.d:
अशून्यशयनं तद्वत्तथैवाङ्गारकव्रतम् ।
सप्तमीसप्तकं तद्वद्विशोकद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
1.107.m: likewise the Aśūnyaśayana [vow], and likewise the Aṅgāraka vow, / likewise the group of seven Saptamīs, and the Viśokadvādaśī vow,

1.107.s:
merupradānaṃ daśadhā grahaśāntistathaiva ca /
grahasvarūpakathanaṃ tathā śivacaturdaśī //
1.107.d:
मेरुप्रदानं दशधा ग्रहशान्तिस्तथैव च ।
ग्रहस्वरूपकथनं तथा शिवचतुर्दशी ॥
1.107.m: the gift of Meru in ten ways, and pacification of the planets, / description of the nature of the planets, and the Śivacaturdaśī [vow],

1.107.s:
tathā sarvaphalatyāgaḥ sūryavāravrataṃ tathā /
saṃkrāntisnapanaṃ tadvadvibhūtidvādaśīvratam //
1.107.d:
तथा सर्वफलत्यागः सूर्यवारव्रतं तथा ।
संक्रान्तिस्नपनं तद्वद्विभूतिद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
1.107.m: likewise the renunciation of all fruits, the Sunday vow, / the bath at a solstitial/equinoctial transition, and the Vibhūtidvādaśī vow,

1.107.s:
ṣaṣṭīvratānāṃ māhātmyaṃ tathā snānavidhikamaḥ /
prayāgasya tu māhātmyaṃ dvīpalokānuvarṇanam //
1.107.d:
षष्टीव्रतानां माहात्म्यं तथा स्नानविधिकमः ।
प्रयागस्य तु माहात्म्यं द्वीपलोकानुवर्णनम् ॥
1.107.m: the eulogy of the greatness of the Ṣaṣṭhī vows, and the order of bathing rites, / the eulogy of the greatness of Prayāga, and the description of the island-continents and worlds,

1.107.s:
tathāntarikṣacāraśca dhruvamāhātmyameva ca /
bhavanāni suredrāṇāṃ tripurodyotanaṃ tathā //
1.107.d:
तथान्तरिक्षचारश्च ध्रुवमाहात्म्यमेव च ।
भवनानि सुरेद्राणां त्रिपुरोद्योतनं तथा ॥
1.107.m: the movement through the atmosphere, the eulogy of the greatness of Dhruva, / the mansions of the gods' rulers, and the burning of Tripura,

1.107.s:
pitṛpravaramāhātmyaṃ manvantaravinirṇayaḥ /
caturyugasya saṃbhūtiryugadharmanirūpaṇam //
1.107.d:
पितृप्रवरमाहात्म्यं मन्वन्तरविनिर्णयः ।
चतुर्युगस्य संभूतिर्युगधर्मनिरूपणम् ॥
1.107.m: the eulogy of the greatness of the foremost ancestors, the determination of the manvantaras, / the origin of the four yugas, and the determination of the duties of the yugas,

1.107.s:
vajrāṅgasya tu saṃbhūti stārakotpattireva ca /
tārakāsuramāhātmyaṃ brahmadevānukīrtanam //
1.107.d:
वज्राङ्गस्य तु संभूति स्तारकोत्पत्तिरेव च ।
तारकासुरमाहात्म्यं ब्रह्मदेवानुकीर्तनम् ॥
1.107.m: the birth of Vajrāṅga, and the birth of Tāraka, / the eulogy of the greatness of the demon Tāraka, and the praise of Brahmā,

1.107.s:
pārvatīsaṃbhavastadvattathā śivatapovanam /
anaṅgadehadāhaśca ratiśokastathaiva ca //
1.107.d:
पार्वतीसंभवस्तद्वत्तथा शिवतपोवनम् ।
अनङ्गदेहदाहश्च रतिशोकस्तथैव च ॥
1.107.m: likewise the birth of Pārvatī, Śiva’s penance-grove, / the burning of the body of Anaṅga, and the grief of Rati,

1.107.s:
gaurītapovanaṃ tadvacchivenātha prasādanam /
pārvatīṛṣisaṃvādastathairodvāhamaṅgalam //
1.107.d:
गौरीतपोवनं तद्वच्छिवेनाथ प्रसादनम् ।
पार्वतीऋषिसंवादस्तथैरोद्वाहमङ्गलम् ॥
1.107.m: likewise Gaurī’s penance-grove, then her propitiation by Śiva, / the dialogue between Pārvatī and the sage, and the auspicious marriage,

1.107.s:
kumārasaṃbhavastadvatkumāravijayastathā /
tārakasya vadho ghoro narasiṃhopavarṇanam //
1.107.d:
कुमारसंभवस्तद्वत्कुमारविजयस्तथा ।
तारकस्य वधो घोरो नरसिंहोपवर्णनम् ॥
1.107.m: likewise the birth of Kumāra, and the victory of Kumāra, / the terrible slaying of Tāraka, and the description of Narasiṃha.

1.107.s:
padmodbhavavisargastu tathaivāndhakaghātanam /
vārāṇasyāstu māhātmyaṃ narmadāyāstathaiva ca //
1.107.d:
पद्मोद्भवविसर्गस्तु तथैवान्धकघातनम् ।
वाराणस्यास्तु माहात्म्यं नर्मदायास्तथैव च ॥
1.107.m: The creation by the Lotus-born [Brahmā], the slaying of Andhaka, / and likewise the eulogy of greatness of Vārāṇasī and also of the Narmadā;

1.107.s:
pravarānukramastadvatpitṛgāthānukīrtanam /
tathobhayamukhīdānaṃ dānaṃ kṛṣṇājinasya ca //
1.107.d:
प्रवरानुक्रमस्तद्वत्पितृगाथानुकीर्तनम् ।
तथोभयमुखीदानं दानं कृष्णाजिनस्य च ॥
1.107.m: likewise the succession of prime ancestral lineages (pravaras), the recitation of ancestral songs (pitṛgāthās), / as well as the gift of a cow facing both ways (ubhayamukhī) and the gift of a black-antelope skin;

1.107.s:
tataḥ sāvitryupākhyānaṃ rājadharmāstathaiva ca /
vividhotpātakathanaṃ grahaṇāntastathaiva ca //
1.107.d:
ततः सावित्र्युपाख्यानं राजधर्मास्तथैव च ।
विविधोत्पातकथनं ग्रहणान्तस्तथैव च ॥
1.107.m: then the narrative of Sāvitrī, and likewise the duties of kings, / the description of various portents, and likewise [the period] ending with eclipses;

1.107.s:
yātrānimittakathanaṃ svapnamaṅgalakīrtane /
vāmanasya tu māhātmyaṃ vārāhasya tataḥ param //
1.107.d:
यात्रानिमित्तकथनं स्वप्नमङ्गलकीर्तने ।
वामनस्य तु माहात्म्यं वाराहस्य ततः परम् ॥
1.107.m: the description of omens for journeys, the recitation of auspicious dreams, / the eulogy of greatness of Vāmana, and thereafter of Varāha;

1.107.s:
samudramathanaṃ tadvatkālakūṭābhiśāntanam /
devāsuravimardaśca vāstuvidyā tathaiva ca //
1.107.d:
समुद्रमथनं तद्वत्कालकूटाभिशान्तनम् ।
देवासुरविमर्दश्च वास्तुविद्या तथैव च ॥
1.107.m: likewise the churning of the ocean, the pacification of the Kālakūṭa poison, / the conflict between gods and asuras, and likewise the science of architecture (vāstuvidyā);

1.107.s:
pratimālakṣaṇaṃ tadvaddevatāyatanaṃ tathā /
prāsādalakṣaṇaṃ tadvanmaṇḍapāna ca lakṣaṇam //
1.107.d:
प्रतिमालक्षणं तद्वद्देवतायतनं तथा ।
प्रासादलक्षणं तद्वन्मण्डपान च लक्षणम् ॥
1.107.m: likewise the characteristics of images, and the temples of deities, / likewise the characteristics of palaces [and temples], and the characteristics of pavilions (maṇḍapas);

1.107.s:
bhaviṣyarājñāmuddeśo mahādānānukīrtanam /
kalpānukīrtanaṃ tadvatpurāṇe 'sminprakīrtitam //
1.107.d:
भविष्यराज्ञामुद्देशो महादानानुकीर्तनम् ।
कल्पानुकीर्तनं तद्वत्पुराणे ऽस्मिन्प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
1.107.m: the mention of future kings, the recitation of the great gifts (mahādānas), / and likewise the recitation of the kalpas: all this is proclaimed in this Purāṇa.

1.107.s:
pavitrametatkalyāṇamāyuḥ kīrtivivarddhanam /
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sa yāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ //
1.107.d:
पवित्रमेतत्कल्याणमायुः कीर्तिविवर्द्धनम् ।
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि स याति भवनं हरेः ॥
1.107.m: This is purifying, auspicious, increasing lifespan and renown; / whoever reads or even hears it goes to the abode of Hari.

1.107.s:
likhitvaitattu yo dadyāddhemamatsyagavānvitam /
viprāyābhyarcya viṣuve sa yāti paramaṃ padam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde matsyapurāṇānukramaṇīkathanaṃ nāma saptottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.107.d:
लिखित्वैतत्तु यो दद्याद्धेममत्स्यगवान्वितम् ।
विप्रायाभ्यर्च्य विषुवे स याति परमं पदम् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे मत्स्यपुराणानुक्रमणीकथनं नाम सप्तोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः
1.107.m:
And having written this out, whoever gives it to a brahmin at an equinox, / endowed with a golden fish and a cow, having worshipped him, goes to the supreme abode.

Thus ends the one hundred and seventh chapter, entitled 'The Account of the Table of Contents of the Matsya Purāṇa', in the fourth quarter in the Great Narrative in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

1.108.s:
brahmovāca
marīce śṛṇu vakṣyābhi purāṇaṃ gāruḍaṃ śubham /
garuḍāyābravītpṛṣṭo bhagavāngaruḍāsanaḥ //
1.108.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
मरीचे शृणु वक्ष्याभि पुराणं गारुडं शुभम् ।
गरुडायाब्रवीत्पृष्टो भगवान्गरुडासनः ॥
1.108.m: Brahmā said: / Listen, Marīci, I shall relate the auspicious Gāruḍa Purāṇa, / which the Lord who is seated on Garuḍa spoke when questioned by Garuḍa.

1.108.s:
ekonaviṃśasāhasraṃ tārkṣyakalpakathānvitam /
purāṇopakramapraśnaḥ sargaḥ saṃkṣepatastataḥ //
1.108.d:
एकोनविंशसाहस्रं तार्क्ष्यकल्पकथान्वितम् ।
पुराणोपक्रमप्रश्नः सर्गः संक्षेपतस्ततः ॥
1.108.m: It contains nineteen thousand [verses], accompanied by the narrative of the Tārkṣya-kalpa. / [First] the inquiry introducing the Purāṇa; then creation in summary;

1.108.s:
sūryādipūjanavidhirdīkṣāvidhirataḥ param /
śrāddhapūjā tataḥ paścānnavavyūhārcanaṃ dvija //
1.108.d:
सूर्यादिपूजनविधिर्दीक्षाविधिरतः परम् ।
श्राद्धपूजा ततः पश्चान्नवव्यूहार्चनं द्विज ॥
1.108.m: the ritual of worshipping Sūrya and others; thereafter the rules of initiation (dīkṣā); / then the worship during ancestral rites (śrāddha); thereafter, O twice-born, the worship of the nine vyūhas;

1.108.s:
pūjāvidhānaṃ ca tathā vaiṣṇavaṃ pañjaraṃ tataḥ /
yogādhyāyastato viṣṇornāmasāhasrakīrtanam //
1.108.d:
पूजाविधानं च तथा वैष्णवं पञ्जरं ततः ।
योगाध्यायस्ततो विष्णोर्नामसाहस्रकीर्तनम् ॥
1.108.m: and likewise the procedure of worship; then the Vaiṣṇava Armour (vaiṣṇavapañjara); / then the chapter on yoga; then the recitation of the thousand names of Viṣṇu;

1.108.s:
dhyānaṃ viṣṇostataḥ sūryapūjā mṛtyuñjayārcanam /
mālāmantraḥ śivārcātha gaṇapūjā tataḥ param //
1.108.d:
ध्यानं विष्णोस्ततः सूर्यपूजा मृत्युञ्जयार्चनम् ।
मालामन्त्रः शिवार्चाथ गणपूजा ततः परम् ॥
1.108.m: meditation on Viṣṇu; then the worship of Sūrya; the worship of Mṛtyuñjaya; / the garland mantra (mālāmantra); the worship of Śiva; then, after that, the worship of the Gaṇas;

1.108.s:
gopālapūjā trailokyamohanaśrīdharārcanam /
viṣṇvarcā pañcatattvārcā cakrārcā devapūjanam //
1.108.d:
गोपालपूजा त्रैलोक्यमोहनश्रीधरार्चनम् ।
विष्ण्वर्चा पञ्चतत्त्वार्चा चक्रार्चा देवपूजनम् ॥
1.108.m: the worship of Gopāla; the worship of Śrīdhara, the bewitcher of the three worlds; / the worship of Viṣṇu; the worship of the five principles; the worship of the discus; the worship of the deities;

1.108.s:
nyāsādisaṃdhyopāstiśca durgārcātha surārcanam /
pūjā māheśvarī cātaḥ pavitrāropaṇārcanam //
1.108.d:
न्यासादिसंध्योपास्तिश्च दुर्गार्चाथ सुरार्चनम् ।
पूजा माहेश्वरी चातः पवित्रारोपणार्चनम् ॥
1.108.m: ritual placement (nyāsa) and other rites, and the twilight devotion (saṃdhyā); the worship of Durgā; then the worship of the gods; / and thereafter the worship of Māheśvarī; the rite of the investiture of the sacred thread (pavitrāropaṇa);

1.108.s:
mūrtidhyāṃnavāstumānaṃ prāsādānāṃ ca lakṣaṇam /
pratiṣṭhā sarvadevānāṃ pṛthakpūjā vidhānataḥ //
1.108.d:
मूर्तिध्यांनवास्तुमानं प्रासादानां च लक्षणम् ।
प्रतिष्ठा सर्वदेवानां पृथक्पूजा विधानतः ॥
1.108.m: the meditation on the image, the architectural measurements, and the characteristics of temples; / the consecration of all deities, according to the rule of separate worship;

1.108.s:
yogo 'ṣaṭāṅgo dānadharmāḥ prayaścittavidhikriyā /
dvīpeśanarakākhyānaṃ sūryavyūhaśca jyotiṣam //
1.108.d:
योगो ऽषटाङ्गो दानधर्माः प्रयश्चित्तविधिक्रिया ।
द्वीपेशनरकाख्यानं सूर्यव्यूहश्च ज्योतिषम् ॥
1.108.m: the eight-limbed yoga; the duties concerning gifts; the performance of the rules of expiation; / the narrative of the lords of the continents and of hells; the array of the sun; and astrology;

1.108.s:
sāmudrikaṃ svarajñānaṃ navaratnaparīkṣaṇam /
māhātmyamatha tīrthānāṃ gayāmāhātmyamuttamam //
1.108.d:
सामुद्रिकं स्वरज्ञानं नवरत्नपरीक्षणम् ।
माहात्म्यमथ तीर्थानां गयामाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ॥
1.108.m: physiognomy (sāmudrika); the science of divination through breath (svarajñāna); the examination of the nine gems; / then the eulogy of greatness of sacred fords; the supreme eulogy of greatness of Gayā;

1.108.s:
tato manvantarākhyānaṃ pṛthakpṛthagvibhāgaśaḥ /
pitrākhyānaṃ varṇadharmā dravyaśuddhiḥ samarpaṇam //
1.108.d:
ततो मन्वन्तराख्यानं पृथक्पृथग्विभागशः ।
पित्राख्यानं वर्णधर्मा द्रव्यशुद्धिः समर्पणम् ॥
1.108.m: then the account of the Manvantaras, section by section separately; / the account of ancestors; the duties of the castes; the purification of articles; the offering;

1.108.s:
śrāddhaṃ vināyakasyārcā grahayajñastathaā śramāḥ /
jananākhyaṃ pretaśaucaṃ nītiśāstraṃ vratoktayaḥ //
1.108.d:
श्राद्धं विनायकस्यार्चा ग्रहयज्ञस्तथआ श्रमाः ।
जननाख्यं प्रेतशौचं नीतिशास्त्रं व्रतोक्तयः ॥
1.108.m: the ancestral rite (śrāddha); the worship of Vināyaka; the sacrifice to the planets; and likewise the stages of life; / the [defilement] called birth, the purification from death, political treatises (nītiśāstra), and statements on observances;

1.108.s:
sūryavaṃśaḥ somavaṃśo 'vatārakathanaṃ hareḥ /
rāmāyaṇaṃ harervaṃśo bhāratākhyānakaṃ tataḥ //
1.108.d:
सूर्यवंशः सोमवंशो ऽवतारकथनं हरेः ।
रामायणं हरेर्वंशो भारताख्यानकं ततः ॥
1.108.m: the Solar Dynasty, the Lunar Dynasty, the account of the incarnations of Hari; / the Rāmāyaṇa; the Harivaṃśa; then the narrative of the Mahābhārata;

1.108.s:
āyurvedanidānaṃ prāk cikikatsā dravyajā guṇāḥ /
rogaghnaṃ kavacaṃ viṣṇorgāruḍaṃ traipuro manuḥ //
1.108.d:
आयुर्वेदनिदानं प्राक् चिकिकत्सा द्रव्यजा गुणाः ।
रोगघ्नं कवचं विष्णोर्गारुडं त्रैपुरो मनुः ॥
1.108.m: first the diagnosis in Āyurveda, therapeutics, and the properties arising from medicinal substances; / Viṣṇu's armour that destroys disease; the Gāruḍa [lore]; the mantra of Tripura;

1.108.s:
praśnacūḍāmaṇiścānto hayāyurvedakīrtanam /
oṣaghīnāma kathanaṃ tato vyākaraṇohanam //
1.108.d:
प्रश्नचूडामणिश्चान्तो हयायुर्वेदकीर्तनम् ।
ओषघीनाम कथनं ततो व्याकरणोहनम् ॥
1.108.m: the Praśnacūḍāmaṇi; the recitation of equine Āyurveda; / the description of medicinal herbs; then the consideration of grammar;

1.108.s:
chandaḥ śāstraṃ sadācārastataḥ snānavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ /
tarpaṇaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ ca saṃdhyā pārvaṇakarma ca //
1.108.d:
छन्दः शास्त्रं सदाचारस्ततः स्नानविधिः स्मृतः ।
तर्पणं वैश्वदेवं च संध्या पार्वणकर्म च ॥
1.108.m: the science of metrics; righteous conduct; then the rule of bathing is remembered; / water-libation (tarpaṇa), the Vaiśvadeva rite, the twilight devotion (saṃdhyā), and the rite on the new-moon day (pārvaṇa);

1.108.s:
nityaśrāddhaṃ sarpiḍākhyaṃ dharmasāro 'ghaniṣkṛtiḥ /
pratisaṃkrama uktāḥ sma yugadharmāḥ kṛteḥ phalam //
1.108.d:
नित्यश्राद्धं सर्पिडाख्यं धर्मसारो ऽघनिष्कृतिः ।
प्रतिसंक्रम उक्ताः स्म युगधर्माः कृतेः फलम् ॥
1.108.m: the daily ancestral rite (nityaśrāddha); that which is termed sapiṇḍīkaraṇa; the essence of dharma; the expiation of sins; / the cosmic dissolution; the duties of the yugas are stated; the fruit of righteous action;

1.108.s:
yogaśāstraṃ viṣṇubhaktirnamaskṛtiphalaṃ hareḥ /
māhātmyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ cātha nārasiṃhastavottamam //
1.108.d:
योगशास्त्रं विष्णुभक्तिर्नमस्कृतिफलं हरेः ।
माहात्म्यं वैष्णवं चाथ नारसिंहस्तवोत्तमम् ॥
1.108.m: the treatise on yoga; devotion to Viṣṇu; the fruit of paying homage to Hari; / and then the Vaiṣṇava greatness; the supreme hymn of praise to Nārasiṃha;

1.108.s:
jñānāmṛtaṃ guhuṣṭakaṃ stotraṃ viṣṇvarcanāhvayam /
vedāntasāṃkhyasiddhānto brahmajñānaṃ tathālmakam //
1.108.d:
ज्ञानामृतं गुहुष्टकं स्तोत्रं विष्ण्वर्चनाह्वयम् ।
वेदान्तसांख्यसिद्धान्तो ब्रह्मज्ञानं तथाल्मकम् ॥
1.108.m: the nectar of knowledge; the Guhyāṣṭaka; the hymn of praise named 'Worship of Viṣṇu'; / the doctrine of Vedānta and Sāṃkhya; and likewise knowledge of Brahman consisting of the Self;

1.108.s:
gītāsāraḥ phalotkīrtiḥ pūrvakhaṇḍo 'yamīritaḥ /
athāsyaivottare khaṇḍe pretakalpaḥ puroditaḥ //
1.108.d:
गीतासारः फलोत्कीर्तिः पूर्वखण्डो ऽयमीरितः ।
अथास्यैवोत्तरे खण्डे प्रेतकल्पः पुरोदितः ॥
1.108.m: the essence of the Gītā; the proclamation of fruits: this is declared as the first section (Pūrvakhaṇḍa). / Now in the subsequent section (Uttarakhaṇḍa) of this, the Pretakalpa is proclaimed first,

1.108.s:
yatra tārkṣyeṇa saṃpṛṣṭo bhagavānāha vāḍavāḥ /
dharmaprakaṭanaṃ pūrvaṃ yogināṃ gatikāraṇam //
1.108.d:
यत्र तार्क्ष्येण संपृष्टो भगवानाह वाडवाः ।
धर्मप्रकटनं पूर्वं योगिनां गतिकारणम् ॥
1.108.m: in which, when questioned by Tārkṣya [Garuḍa], O brahmins, the Lord stated / first the manifestation of dharma, the cause of the destination of yogins;

1.108.s:
dānādikaṃ phalaṃ cāpi proktamantrorddhadaihikam /
yamalokasthamārgasya varṇana ca taḥ param //
1.108.d:
दानादिकं फलं चापि प्रोक्तमन्त्रोर्द्धदैहिकम् ।
यमलोकस्थमार्गस्य वर्णन च तः परम् ॥
1.108.m: gifts and the like, and also their fruit; the post-mortem rites (aurdhvadehika) stated with mantras; / and thereafter the description of the path situated in the realm of Yama;

1.108.s:
ṣoḍaśaśrāddhaphalako vṛttāntaścātra varṇitaḥ /
niṣkṛtiryamamārgasya dharmarājasya vaibhavam //
1.108.d:
षोडशश्राद्धफलको वृत्तान्तश्चात्र वर्णितः ।
निष्कृतिर्यममार्गस्य धर्मराजस्य वैभवम् ॥
1.108.m: and the account bearing the fruits of the sixteen ancestral rites (śrāddhas) is described here; / the deliverance from the path of Yama; the majesty of Dharmarāja;

1.108.s:
pretapīḍāṃvinirddeśaḥ pretacihnanirūpaṇam /
pretānāṃ caritākhyānaṃ kāraṇaṃ pretatāṃ prati //
1.108.d:
प्रेतपीडांविनिर्द्देशः प्रेतचिह्ननिरूपणम् ।
प्रेतानां चरिताख्यानं कारणं प्रेततां प्रति ॥
1.108.m: the indication of the afflictions of ghosts (pretas); the determination of the signs of ghosts; / the narration of the deeds of ghosts; the cause leading to ghosthood;

1.108.s:
pretakṛtyavicāraśca sarpiḍīkaraṇoktayaḥ /
pretatvamokṣaṇākhyānaṃ dānāni ca vimuktaye //
1.108.d:
प्रेतकृत्यविचारश्च सर्पिडीकरणोक्तयः ।
प्रेतत्वमोक्षणाख्यानं दानानि च विमुक्तये ॥
1.108.m: the inquiry into the duties concerning ghosts; the statements regarding sapiṇḍīkaraṇa; / the narrative of release from ghosthood; and the gifts for complete liberation;

1.108.s:
āvaśyakottamaṃ dānaṃ pretasaukhyakarohanam /
śārīrakavinirdeśo yamalokasya varṇanam //
1.108.d:
आवश्यकोत्तमं दानं प्रेतसौख्यकरोहनम् ।
शारीरकविनिर्देशो यमलोकस्य वर्णनम् ॥
1.108.m: the necessary and supreme gift; the consideration of what causes happiness to ghosts; / the description of the physical body; the description of the realm of Yama;

1.108.s:
pretatvoddhārakathanaṃ karmakṛrttṛvinirṇayaḥ /
mṛtyoḥ pūrvakriyākhyānaṃ paścātkarmanirūpaṇam //
1.108.d:
प्रेतत्वोद्धारकथनं कर्मकृर्त्तृविनिर्णयः ।
मृत्योः पूर्वक्रियाख्यानं पश्चात्कर्मनिरूपणम् ॥
1.108.m: the account of elevation from ghosthood; the determination of the performer of the rites; / the account of rites prior to death; the determination of rites performed afterwards;

1.108.s:
madhyaṣoḍaśakaśrāddhaṃ svargaprāptikriyohanam /
sūtakasyātha saṃkhyāṃnaṃ nārāyaṇabalikriyā //
1.108.d:
मध्यषोडशकश्राद्धं स्वर्गप्राप्तिक्रियोहनम् ।
सूतकस्याथ संख्यांनं नारायणबलिक्रिया ॥
1.108.m: the sixteen middle ancestral rites (śrāddhas); the examination of rites for attaining heaven; / then the calculation of impurity due to childbirth or death (sūtaka); the performance of the Nārāyaṇa-bali;

1.108.s:
vṛṣotsargasya māhātmyaṃ niṣiddhaparivarjanam /
apamṛtyukriyoktiśca vipākaḥ karmaṇāṃ nṛṇām //
1.108.d:
वृषोत्सर्गस्य माहात्म्यं निषिद्धपरिवर्जनम् ।
अपमृत्युक्रियोक्तिश्च विपाकः कर्मणां नृणाम् ॥
1.108.m: the eulogy of greatness of releasing a bull (vṛṣotsarga); the avoidance of what is prohibited; / the statement on rites for unnatural death; the ripening of the deeds of men;

1.108.s:
kṛtyākṛtyavicāraśca viṣṇudhyānavimuktaye /
svargatau vihitākhyānaṃ svargasaukhyanirūpaṇam //
1.108.d:
कृत्याकृत्यविचारश्च विष्णुध्यानविमुक्तये ।
स्वर्गतौ विहिताख्यानं स्वर्गसौख्यनिरूपणम् ॥
1.108.m: the examination of what should and should not be done; meditation on Viṣṇu for liberation; / the narrative of what is prescribed for going to heaven; the description of heavenly happiness;

1.108.s:
bhūrlokavarṇanaṃ caiva saptādholokavarṇanam /
pañcorddhvalokakathanaṃ brahmāṇḍasthitikīrtanam //
1.108.d:
भूर्लोकवर्णनं चैव सप्ताधोलोकवर्णनम् ।
पञ्चोर्द्ध्वलोककथनं ब्रह्माण्डस्थितिकीर्तनम् ॥
1.108.m: the description of the earthly world (Bhūrloka); and the description of the seven lower worlds; / the account of the five upper worlds; the recitation of the structure of the cosmic egg;

1.108.s:
brahmāṇḍānekacaritaṃ brahmajīvanirūpaṇam /
ātyantikaṃ layākhyānaṃ phalastuti nirūpaṇam //
1.108.d:
ब्रह्माण्डानेकचरितं ब्रह्मजीवनिरूपणम् ।
आत्यन्तिकं लयाख्यानं फलस्तुति निरूपणम् ॥
1.108.m: the manifold history of the cosmic egg; the determination of the living entity and Brahman; / the ultimate dissolution; and the determination of the praise of fruits:

1.108.s:
ityetadgāruḍaṃ nāma purāṇaṃ bhuktimuktidam /
kīrtitaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṛṇām //
1.108.d:
इत्येतद्गारुडं नाम पुराणं भुक्तिमुक्तिदम् ।
कीर्तितं पापशमनं पठतां शृण्वतां नृणाम् ॥
1.108.m: thus this Purāṇa named Gāruḍa, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation, / is declared, pacifying sins for men who read or hear it.

1.108.s:
likhitvaitatpurāṇaṃ tu viṣuve yaḥ prayacchati /
sauvarṇahaṃsayugmāḍhyaṃ viprāya sa divaṃ vrajet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde gāruḍānukramaṇīvarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.108.d:
लिखित्वैतत्पुराणं तु विषुवे यः प्रयच्छति ।
सौवर्णहंसयुग्माढ्यं विप्राय स दिवं व्रजेत् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे गारुडानुक्रमणीवर्णनं नामाष्टोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः
1.108.m:
Having written out this Purāṇa, whoever presents it at an equinox / to a brahmin, furnished with a pair of golden swans, shall go to heaven.

Thus ends the one hundred and eighth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Table of Contents of the Gāruḍa Purāṇa', in the fourth quarter in the Great Narrative in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

1.109.s:
brahmovāca
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi brahmāṇḍākhyaṃ purātanam /
yacca dvādaśasāhasramādikalpakathāyutam //
1.109.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
शृणु वत्स प्रवक्ष्यामि ब्रह्माण्डाख्यं पुरातनम् ।
यच्च द्वादशसाहस्रमादिकल्पकथायुतम् ॥
1.109.m: Brahmā said: / Listen, dear child, I shall proclaim the ancient [Purāṇa] named Brahmāṇḍa, / which contains twelve thousand [verses] accompanied by the account of the initial kalpa.

1.109.s:
prakriyākhyo 'nuṣaṅgākhya upodghātastṛtīyakaḥ /
caturtha upasaṃhāraḥ pādāścatvāra eva hi //
1.109.d:
प्रक्रियाख्यो ऽनुषङ्गाख्य उपोद्घातस्तृतीयकः ।
चतुर्थ उपसंहारः पादाश्चत्वार एव हि ॥
1.109.m: The [first part] named Prakriyā, the [second] named Anuṣaṅga, the Upodghāta as the third, / and the Upasaṃhāra as the fourth: these are indeed its four quarters.

1.109.s:
pūrvapādadvayaṃ pūrvo bhāgo 'tra samudāhṛtaḥ /
tṛtīyo madhyamo bhāgaścaturthastūttaro mataḥ //
1.109.d:
पूर्वपादद्वयं पूर्वो भागो ऽत्र समुदाहृतः ।
तृतीयो मध्यमो भागश्चतुर्थस्तूत्तरो मतः ॥
1.109.m: The first two quarters are declared to be the first part here; / the third is the middle part, and the fourth is considered the later [part].

1.109.s:
ādau kṛtyasamuddeśo naimiṣākhyānakaṃ tataḥ /
hiraṇyagarbhotpattiśca lokakalpanameva ca //
1.109.d:
आदौ कृत्यसमुद्देशो नैमिषाख्यानकं ततः ।
हिरण्यगर्भोत्पत्तिश्च लोककल्पनमेव च ॥
1.109.m: First is the exposition of duties, then the account of Naimiṣa, / the origin of Hiraṇyagarbha, and the fashioning of the worlds;

1.109.s:
eṣa vai prathamaḥ pādo dvitīyaṃ śṛṇu mānada /
kalpamanvantarākhyānaṃ lokajñānaṃ tataḥ param //
1.109.d:
एष वै प्रथमः पादो द्वितीयं शृणु मानद ।
कल्पमन्वन्तराख्यानं लोकज्ञानं ततः परम् ॥
1.109.m: this indeed is the first quarter. Listen to the second, O giver of honor: / the narrative of kalpas and manvantaras, and thereafter the knowledge of the worlds;

1.109.s:
mānasīsṛṣṭikathanaṃ rudraprasavavarṇanam /
mahādevavibhūtiśca ṛṣisargastataḥ param //
1.109.d:
मानसीसृष्टिकथनं रुद्रप्रसववर्णनम् ।
महादेवविभूतिश्च ऋषिसर्गस्ततः परम् ॥
1.109.m: the account of the mental creation, the description of Rudra's birth, / the manifestation of Mahādeva, and thereafter the creation of the sages;

1.109.s:
agnīnāṃ vijayaścātha kālasadbhāvavarṇanam /
priyavratānvayoddeśaḥ pṛthivyāyāmavistaraḥ //
1.109.d:
अग्नीनां विजयश्चाथ कालसद्भाववर्णनम् ।
प्रियव्रतान्वयोद्देशः पृथिव्यायामविस्तरः ॥
1.109.m: then the victory of the fires, and the description of the nature of Time, / the account of Priyavrata's lineage, and the length and breadth of the earth;

1.109.s:
varṇanaṃ bhāratasyāsya tato 'nyeṣāṃ nirūpaṇam /
jambvādisaptadvīpākhyā tato 'dholokavarṇanam //
1.109.d:
वर्णनं भारतस्यास्य ततो ऽन्येषां निरूपणम् ।
जम्ब्वादिसप्तद्वीपाख्या ततो ऽधोलोकवर्णनम् ॥
1.109.m: the description of this Bhārata, then the delineation of the others, / the account of the seven continents such as Jambū, then the description of the lower worlds;

1.109.s:
urddhvalokānukathanaṃ grahacārastataḥ param /
ādityavyūhakathanaṃ devagrahānukīrtanam //
1.109.d:
उर्द्ध्वलोकानुकथनं ग्रहचारस्ततः परम् ।
आदित्यव्यूहकथनं देवग्रहानुकीर्तनम् ॥
1.109.m: the narration of the upper worlds, and thereafter the course of the planets, / the account of the solar system, and the description of the divine planets;

1.109.s:
nīlakaṇṭhāhvayākhyānaṃ mahādevasya vaibhavam /
amāvāsyānukathanaṃ yugatattvanirūpaṇam //
1.109.d:
नीलकण्ठाह्वयाख्यानं महादेवस्य वैभवम् ।
अमावास्यानुकथनं युगतत्त्वनिरूपणम् ॥
1.109.m: the narrative named after Nīlakaṇṭha, the majesty of Mahādeva, / the account of the new-moon day, and the delineation of the truth of the yugas;

1.109.s:
yajñapravartanaṃ cātha yugayorantyayoḥ kṛtiḥ /
yugaprajālakṣaṇaṃ ca ṛṣipravaravarṇanam //
1.109.d:
यज्ञप्रवर्तनं चाथ युगयोरन्त्ययोः कृतिः ।
युगप्रजालक्षणं च ऋषिप्रवरवर्णनम् ॥
1.109.m: the promulgation of sacrifice, and the condition of the last two yugas, / the characteristics of the people of the yugas, and the description of the eminent sages;

1.109.s:
vedānāṃ vyasanākhyānaṃ svāyambhuvanirūpaṇam /
śeṣamanvantarākhyānaṃ pṛthivīdohanaṃ tataḥ //
1.109.d:
वेदानां व्यसनाख्यानं स्वायम्भुवनिरूपणम् ।
शेषमन्वन्तराख्यानं पृथिवीदोहनं ततः ॥
1.109.m: the account of the division of the Vedas, the delineation of Svāyambhuva, / the account of the remaining manvantaras, and then the milking of the earth;

1.109.s:
cākṣuṣe 'dyatane sarge dvitīyo 'ṅghriḥ purodale /
athopodghātapāde tu saptarṣiparikīrtanam //
1.109.d:
चाक्षुषे ऽद्यतने सर्गे द्वितीयो ऽङ्घ्रिः पुरोदले ।
अथोपोद्घातपादे तु सप्तर्षिपरिकीर्तनम् ॥
1.109.m: in the present creation of Cākṣuṣa—[this is] the second quarter in the earlier half. / Then in the Upodghāta quarter, the celebration of the Seven Sages,

1.109.s:
prajāpatyanvayastasmāddevādīnāṃ samudbhavaḥ /
tato jayābhilāṣaśca marudutpattikīrtanam //
1.109.d:
प्रजापत्यन्वयस्तस्माद्देवादीनां समुद्भवः ।
ततो जयाभिलाषश्च मरुदुत्पत्तिकीर्तनम् ॥
1.109.m: the lineage of Prajāpati, and from that the origin of the gods and others, / then the desire for victory, and the celebration of the birth of the Maruts;

1.109.s:
kāśyapeyānukathanaṃ ṛṣivaṃśanirūpaṇam /
pitṛkalpānukathanaṃ śrāddhakalpastataḥ param //
1.109.d:
काश्यपेयानुकथनं ऋषिवंशनिरूपणम् ।
पितृकल्पानुकथनं श्राद्धकल्पस्ततः परम् ॥
1.109.m: the account of the descendants of Kaśyapa, the delineation of the lineages of sages, / the narration of the Pitṛ-kalpa, and thereafter the Śrāddha-kalpa;

1.109.s:
vaivasvatasamutpattiḥ sṛṣṭistasya tataḥ param /
manuputrānvayaścānto gāndharvasya nirūpaṇam //
1.109.d:
वैवस्वतसमुत्पत्तिः सृष्टिस्तस्य ततः परम् ।
मनुपुत्रान्वयश्चान्तो गान्धर्वस्य निरूपणम् ॥
1.109.m: the origin of Vaivasvata, and thereafter his creation, / the lineage of the sons of Manu and its end, and the delineation of the Gandharva;

1.109.s:
ikṣvākuvaṃśakathanaṃ vaṃśo 'treḥ sumahātmanaḥ /
amāvasoranvayaśca rajeścaritamadbhutam //
1.109.d:
इक्ष्वाकुवंशकथनं वंशो ऽत्रेः सुमहात्मनः ।
अमावसोरन्वयश्च रजेश्चरितमद्भुतम् ॥
1.109.m: the account of Ikṣvāku's lineage, the lineage of the noble Atri, / the lineage of Amāvasu, and the wondrous deeds of Raji;

1.109.s:
yayāticaritaṃ cātha yaduvaṃśanirūpaṇam /
kārtavīryasya caritaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ tataḥ param //
1.109.d:
ययातिचरितं चाथ यदुवंशनिरूपणम् ।
कार्तवीर्यस्य चरितं जामदग्न्यं ततः परम् ॥
1.109.m: the deeds of Yayāti, and then the delineation of Yadu's lineage, / the deeds of Kārtavīrya, and thereafter Jāmadagnya;

1.109.s:
vṛṣṇivaṃśānukathanaṃ sagarasyātha saṃbhavaḥ /
bhārgavasyānucaritaṃ pitṛkāryavadhāśrayam //
1.109.d:
वृष्णिवंशानुकथनं सगरस्याथ संभवः ।
भार्गवस्यानुचरितं पितृकार्यवधाश्रयम् ॥
1.109.m: the account of the Vṛṣṇi lineage, then the birth of Sagara, / the narrative of the Bhārgava connected with the slaying for ancestral rites;

1.109.s:
sagarasyātha caritaṃ bhārgavasya kathā punaḥ /
devāsurāhavakathā kṛṣṇāvirbhāvavarṇanam //
1.109.d:
सगरस्याथ चरितं भार्गवस्य कथा पुनः ।
देवासुराहवकथा कृष्णाविर्भाववर्णनम् ॥
1.109.m: then the deeds of Sagara, again the story of the Bhārgava, / the story of the battle between gods and asuras, and the description of Kṛṣṇa's manifestation;

1.109.s:
indrasya tu stavaḥ puṇyaḥ śukreṇa parikīrtitaḥ /
viṣṇumāhātmyakathanaṃ balivaṃśanirūpaṇam //
1.109.d:
इन्द्रस्य तु स्तवः पुण्यः शुक्रेण परिकीर्तितः ।
विष्णुमाहात्म्यकथनं बलिवंशनिरूपणम् ॥
1.109.m: the holy hymn to Indra proclaimed by Śukra, / the exposition of the greatness of Viṣṇu, and the delineation of Bali's lineage;

1.109.s:
bhaviṣyarājacaritaṃ saṃprāpte 'tha kalau yuge /
samupoddhātapādo 'yaṃ tṛtīyo madhyame dale //
1.109.d:
भविष्यराजचरितं संप्राप्ते ऽथ कलौ युगे ।
समुपोद्धातपादो ऽयं तृतीयो मध्यमे दले ॥
1.109.m: the deeds of future kings when the Kali age has arrived. / This is the Upodghāta quarter, the third, in the middle half.

1.109.s:
caturthamupasaṃhāraṃ vakṣye khaṇḍe tathottare /
vaivasvatāntarākhyānaṃ vistareṇa yathātathām //
1.109.d:
चतुर्थमुपसंहारं वक्ष्ये खण्डे तथोत्तरे ।
वैवस्वतान्तराख्यानं विस्तरेण यथातथाम् ॥
1.109.m: I will state the fourth, the Upasaṃhāra, likewise in the later section: / the narrative of the period of Vaivasvata in detail as it truly is.

1.109.s:
pūrvameva samuddiṣṭaṃ saṃkṣepādiha kathyate /
bhaviṣyāṇāṃ manūnāṃ ca caritaṃ hi tataḥ param //
1.109.d:
पूर्वमेव समुद्दिष्टं संक्षेपादिह कथ्यते ।
भविष्याणां मनूनां च चरितं हि ततः परम् ॥
1.109.m: What was already indicated earlier is stated here in brief; / thereafter indeed is the history of the future Manus,

1.109.s:
kalpapralayanirdeśaḥ kālamānaṃ tataḥ param /
lokāścaturddaśa tataḥ kathitāḥ prāptalakṣaṇaiḥ //
1.109.d:
कल्पप्रलयनिर्देशः कालमानं ततः परम् ।
लोकाश्चतुर्द्दश ततः कथिताः प्राप्तलक्षणैः ॥
1.109.m: the exposition of the dissolution of the kalpa, and thereafter the measure of Time; / then the fourteen worlds are related by those who have attained knowledge of their characteristics;

1.109.s:
varṇanaṃ narakāṇāṃ ca vikarmācaraṇaistataḥ /
manomayapurākhyānaṃ layaḥ prākṛtikastataḥ //
1.109.d:
वर्णनं नरकाणां च विकर्माचरणैस्ततः ।
मनोमयपुराख्यानं लयः प्राकृतिकस्ततः ॥
1.109.m: the description of the hells, and then [the retribution] for prohibited acts, / the account of the city of mind, and then the elemental dissolution;

1.109.s:
śaivasyātha purasyāpi varṇanaṃ ca tataḥ param /
trividhā guṇasaṃbandhājjantūnāṃ kīrtitā gatiḥ //
1.109.d:
शैवस्याथ पुरस्यापि वर्णनं च ततः परम् ।
त्रिविधा गुणसंबन्धाज्जन्तूनां कीर्तिता गतिः ॥
1.109.m: and thereafter the description of the Śaiva city as well; / the threefold destiny of beings resulting from the connection of the guṇas is proclaimed;

1.109.s:
anirdeśyāpratarkyasya brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ /
anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ varṇanaṃ hi tataḥ param //
1.109.d:
अनिर्देश्याप्रतर्क्यस्य ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः ।
अन्वयव्यतिरेकाभ्यां वर्णनं हि ततः परम् ॥
1.109.m: and thereafter indeed is the description of the indescribable and unthinkable / Brahman, the Supreme Self, through positive and negative concomitance.

1.109.s:
ityeṣa upasaṃhārapādo vṛttaḥ sahottaraḥ /
catuṣpādaṃ purāṇaṃ te brahmāṇḍaṃ samudāhṛtakam //
1.109.d:
इत्येष उपसंहारपादो वृत्तः सहोत्तरः ।
चतुष्पादं पुराणं ते ब्रह्माण्डं समुदाहृतकम् ॥
1.109.m: Thus this Upasaṃhāra quarter has been completed along with the later [section]. / The four-quartered Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa has been expounded to you,

1.109.s:
aṣṭādaśamanaupamyaṃ sārātsārataraṃ dvija /
brahmāṇḍaṃ yaccaturlakṣaṃ purāṇaṃ yena vaṭhyate //
1.109.d:
अष्टादशमनौपम्यं सारात्सारतरं द्विज ।
ब्रह्माण्डं यच्चतुर्लक्षं पुराणं येन वठ्यते ॥
1.109.m: the peerless eighteenth, the essence of essences, O twice-born, / the Brahmāṇḍa, which is the Purāṇa of four hundred thousand [verses] from which it is recited.

1.109.s:
tadetadasya gaditamatrāṣṭādaśadhā pṛthak /
pāsaśaryeṇa muninā sarveṣāmapi mānada //
1.109.d:
तदेतदस्य गदितमत्राष्टादशधा पृथक् ।
पासशर्येण मुनिना सर्वेषामपि मानद ॥
1.109.m:
This has been related here in eighteen parts separately
by the sage, son of Parāśara, O honor-giver to all.

1.109.s:
vastutastūpadeṣṭrātha munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām /
mattaḥ śrutvā purāṇāni lokebhyaḥ pracakāśire //
1.109.d:
वस्तुतस्तूपदेष्ट्राथ मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् ।
मत्तः श्रुत्वा पुराणानि लोकेभ्यः प्रचकाशिरे ॥
1.109.m:
Indeed, having been taught by the instructor of sages of cultivated self,
they shone forth to the worlds, having been heard from me.

1.109.s:
munayo dharmaśīlāste dīnānugrahakāriṇaḥ /
mayācedaṃ purāṇaṃ tu vasiṣṭāya puroditam //
1.109.d:
मुनयो धर्मशीलास्ते दीनानुग्रहकारिणः ।
मयाचेदं पुराणं तु वसिष्टाय पुरोदितम् ॥
1.109.m:
Those sages of righteous conduct bestow grace upon the distressed.
And this Purāṇa was formerly spoken by me to Vasiṣṭha.

1.109.s:
tena śaktisutāyoktaṃ jātūkarṇyāya tena ca /
vyāso labdhvā tataścaitatprabhañjanamukhodgatam //
1.109.d:
तेन शक्तिसुतायोक्तं जातूकर्ण्याय तेन च ।
व्यासो लब्ध्वा ततश्चैतत्प्रभञ्जनमुखोद्गतम् ॥
1.109.m:
By him it was spoken to the son of Śakti, and by him to Jātūkarṇya.
Then Vyāsa, having received this that arose from the mouth of Prabhañjana,

1.109.s:
pramāṇīkṛtya loke 'sminprāvartayadanuttamam /
ya idaṃ kīrtayedvatsa śṛṇoti ca samāhitaḥ //
1.109.d:
प्रमाणीकृत्य लोके ऽस्मिन्प्रावर्तयदनुत्तमम् ।
य इदं कीर्तयेद्वत्स शृणोति च समाहितः ॥
1.109.m:
and having accepted it as authoritative in this world, set it forth, unrivaled.
Whoever proclaims this, O child, and listens attentively,

1.109.s:
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni yāti lokamanāmayam /
likhitvaitatpurāṇaṃ tu svarṇasiṃhāsanasthitam //
1.109.d:
स विधूयेह पापानि याति लोकमनामयम् ।
लिखित्वैतत्पुराणं तु स्वर्णसिंहासनस्थितम् ॥
1.109.m:
having shaken off sins here, goes to the sorrowless world.
Having written this Purāṇa, placed on a golden throne,

1.109.s:
vastreṇācchāditaṃ yastu brāhmaṇāya prayacchati /
sa yādi brahmaṇo lokaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
1.109.d:
वस्त्रेणाच्छादितं यस्तु ब्राह्मणाय प्रयच्छति ।
स यादि ब्रह्मणो लोकं नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
1.109.m:
whoever gives it covered with a cloth to a brāhmaṇa,
he goes to the world of Brahmā; no doubt should be entertained here.

1.109.s:
marīce 'ṣṭādaśaitāni mayā proktāni yāni te /
purāṇāni tu saṃkṣepācchrotavyāni ca vistarāt //
1.109.d:
मरीचे ऽष्टादशैतानि मया प्रोक्तानि यानि ते ।
पुराणानि तु संक्षेपाच्छ्रोतव्यानि च विस्तरात् ॥
1.109.m:
O Marīci, these eighteen Purāṇas spoken by me to you
in brief are also to be heard in detail.

1.109.s:
aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni yaḥ śṛṇoti narottamaḥ /
kathayedvā vidhānena neha bhūyaḥ sa jāyate //
1.109.d:
अष्टादश पुराणानि यः शृणोति नरोत्तमः ।
कथयेद्वा विधानेन नेह भूयः स जायते ॥
1.109.m:
That best of men who listens to the eighteen Purāṇas
or recites them according to the rules is not born here again.

1.109.s:
sūtrametatpurāṇānāṃ yanmayoktaṃ tavādhunā /
tannityaṃ śīlanīyaṃ hi purāṇaphalamicchatā //
1.109.d:
सूत्रमेतत्पुराणानां यन्मयोक्तं तवाधुना ।
तन्नित्यं शीलनीयं हि पुराणफलमिच्छता ॥
1.109.m:
This aphorism of the Purāṇas, which was spoken by me to you now,
is indeed constantly to be studied by one desiring the fruit of the Purāṇas.

1.109.s:
na dāṃbhikāya pāpāya devagurvanusūyave /
deyaṃ kadāpi sādhūnāṃ dveṣiṇe na śaṭhāya ca //
1.109.d:
न दांभिकाय पापाय देवगुर्वनुसूयवे ।
देयं कदापि साधूनां द्वेषिणे न शठाय च ॥
1.109.m:
It should never be given to a hypocrite, a sinner, one who envies gods and gurus,
to a hater of the virtuous, nor to a rogue.

1.109.s:
śāntāya śamacittāya śuśrūṣābhiratāya ca /
nirmatsarāya śucaye deyaṃ sadvaiṣṇavāya ca //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde brahmāṇḍapurāṇānukramaṇīnirūpaṇaṃ nāma navottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.109.d:
शान्ताय शमचित्ताय शुश्रूषाभिरताय च ।
निर्मत्सराय शुचये देयं सद्वैष्णवाय च ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे ब्रह्माण्डपुराणानुक्रमणीनिरूपणं नाम नवोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः
1.109.m:
It should be given to one who is calm, tranquil in mind, devoted to service,
free from malice, pure, and a true Vaiṣṇava.

Thus ends the one hundred and ninth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Table of Contents of the Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa', in the fourth quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

1.110.s:
nārada uvāca
purāṇasūtramakhilaṃ śrutaṃ tava mukhādvibho /
marūcaye yathā proktaṃ brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā //
1.110.d:
नारद उवाच
पुराणसूत्रमखिलं श्रुतं तव मुखाद्विभो ।
मरूचये यथा प्रोक्तं ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना ॥
1.110.m:
Nārada said:
The entire summary of the Purāṇas has been heard from your mouth, O Lord,
as it was told to Marīci by Brahmā, the supreme deity.

1.110.s:
adhunā tu mahābhāga tithīnāṃ vai kathānakam /
kramato mahyamākhyāhi yathā syādvataniścayaḥ //
1.110.d:
अधुना तु महाभाग तिथीनां वै कथानकम् ।
क्रमतो मह्यमाख्याहि यथा स्याद्वतनिश्चयः ॥
1.110.m:
Now, O greatly fortunate one, tell me in order
the account of the lunar days, so that there may be certainty regarding the observances.

1.110.s:
yasminmāse tu yā puṇyā tithiryena uvāsitā /
yadvidhānaṃ ca pūjādestatsarvaṃ vada sāṃpratam //
1.110.d:
यस्मिन्मासे तु या पुण्या तिथिर्येन उवासिता ।
यद्विधानं च पूजादेस्तत्सर्वं वद सांप्रतम् ॥
1.110.m:
In which month, which lunar day is sacred, by whom it was observed,
and what the procedure for worship and the like is—tell all that now.

1.110.s:
sanātana uvāca
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi tithīnāṃ te vrataṃ pṛthak /
tithīśānukramādeva sarvasiddhividhāyakam //
1.110.d:
सनातन उवाच
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि तिथीनां ते व्रतं पृथक् ।
तिथीशानुक्रमादेव सर्वसिद्धिविधायकम् ॥
1.110.m:
Sanātana said:
Listen, Nārada; I shall tell you the individual observance for the lunar days,
in order of the lords of the lunar days, bestowing all accomplishments.

1.110.s:
caitre māsi jagadbrahmā sasaja prathame 'hani /
śuklapakṣe samagraṃ vai tadā sūryodaye sati //
1.110.d:
चैत्रे मासि जगद्ब्रह्मा ससज प्रथमे ऽहनि ।
शुक्लपक्षे समग्रं वै तदा सूर्योदये सति ॥
1.110.m:
In the month of Caitra, on the first day of the bright fortnight,
Brahmā created the entire universe at sunrise.

1.110.s:
vatsarādau vasaṃtādau balirājye tathaiva ca /
pūrvaviddhaiva kartavyā pratipatsarvadā budhaiḥ //
1.110.d:
वत्सरादौ वसंतादौ बलिराज्ये तथैव च ।
पूर्वविद्धैव कर्तव्या प्रतिपत्सर्वदा बुधैः ॥
1.110.m:
At the start of the year, at the beginning of spring, and likewise during the reign of Bali,
the first lunar day conjoined with the previous day should always be observed by the wise.

1.110.s:
tatra kāryā mahāśāntiḥ sarvakalmaṣanāśinī /
sarvotpātapraśamanī kaliduṣkṛtahāriṇī //
1.110.d:
तत्र कार्या महाशान्तिः सर्वकल्मषनाशिनी ।
सर्वोत्पातप्रशमनी कलिदुष्कृतहारिणी ॥
1.110.m:
There, a great rite of pacification is to be performed, destroying all sins,
allaying all portents, removing the evil deeds of the Kali age,

1.110.s:
āyuḥ pradāpuṣṭikarī dhanasaubhāgyavarddhinī /
maṅgalyā ca pavitrā ca lokadvayamukhāvahā //
1.110.d:
आयुः प्रदापुष्टिकरी धनसौभाग्यवर्द्धिनी ।
मङ्गल्या च पवित्रा च लोकद्वयमुखावहा ॥
1.110.m:
granting life, bringing nourishment, increasing wealth and good fortune,
auspicious, pure, and bringing happiness in both worlds.

1.110.s:
tasyāmādau tu saṃpūjyo brahmā vahnivapurdharaḥ /
pādyārdhyapuṣpadhūpaiśca vastrālaṅkārabhojanaiḥ //
1.110.d:
तस्यामादौ तु संपूज्यो ब्रह्मा वह्निवपुर्धरः ।
पाद्यार्ध्यपुष्पधूपैश्च वस्त्रालङ्कारभोजनैः ॥
1.110.m:
On it, Brahmā bearing the body of Agni is first to be worshipped
with water for the feet, guest-water, flowers, incense, garments, ornaments, and food,

1.110.s:
homairbalyupahāraiśca tathā brāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ /
tataḥ krameṇa devebhyaḥ pūjā kāryā pṛthakpṛthak //
1.110.d:
होमैर्बल्युपहारैश्च तथा ब्राह्मणतर्पणैः ।
ततः क्रमेण देवेभ्यः पूजा कार्या पृथक्पृथक् ॥
1.110.m:
with fire oblations, offerings of bali, and propitiations of brāhmaṇas.
Then worship should be performed in succession for the gods individually.

1.110.s:
kṛtvoṅkāra namaskāraṃ kuśodakatilākṣataiḥ /
savastraṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca tato dadyāddijātaye //
1.110.d:
कृत्वोङ्कार नमस्कारं कुशोदकतिलाक्षतैः ।
सवस्त्रं सहिरण्यं च ततो दद्याद्दिजातये ॥
1.110.m:
Having made the utterance of Oṃ and salutation with kuśa grass, water, sesame, and unbroken rice grains,
one should then give to a twice-born, along with cloth and gold,

1.110.s:
dakṣiṇāṃ vedaviduṣe vratasaṃpūrtihetave /
evaṃ pūjāviśeṣeṇa vrataṃ syātsaurisaṃjñakam //
1.110.d:
दक्षिणां वेदविदुषे व्रतसंपूर्तिहेतवे ।
एवं पूजाविशेषेण व्रतं स्यात्सौरिसंज्ञकम् ॥
1.110.m:
a sacrificial gift to a knower of the Vedas for the purpose of completing the observance.
In this way, through this specific worship, the observance becomes known as Sauri,

1.110.s:
ārogyadaṃ nṛṇāṃ vipra tasminneva dine mune /
vidyāvratamapi proktamasyāmeva tithau mune //
1.110.d:
आरोग्यदं नृणां विप्र तस्मिन्नेव दिने मुने ।
विद्याव्रतमपि प्रोक्तमस्यामेव तिथौ मुने ॥
1.110.m:
granting health to mortals, O brāhmaṇa sage, on that very day.
The Vidya-vrata is also proclaimed on this very lunar day, O sage.

1.110.s:
tilakaṃ nāma ca proktaṃ kṛṣṇenājātaśatrave /
atha jyeṣṭhe site pakṣe pakṣatyāṃ divasodaye //
1.110.d:
तिलकं नाम च प्रोक्तं कृष्णेनाजातशत्रवे ।
अथ ज्येष्ठे सिते पक्षे पक्षत्यां दिवसोदये ॥
1.110.m:
And the observance named Tilaka was declared by Kṛṣṇa to Ajātaśatru.
Then, in Jyeṣṭha, in the bright fortnight, on the first lunar day at the rising of day,

1.110.s:
devodyānabhavaṃ hṛdyaṃ karavīraṃ samarcayet /
raktatanturīdhānaṃ gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ //
1.110.d:
देवोद्यानभवं हृद्यं करवीरं समर्चयेत् ।
रक्ततन्तुरीधानं गन्धधूपविलेपनैः ॥
1.110.m:
one should worship the charming oleander born in a divine garden,
wrapped with red thread, with perfumes, incense, and ointments,

1.110.s:
prarūḍhasaptadhānyaiśca nāragairbījapūrakaiḥ /
abhyukṣyākṣatatoyena mantreṇetthaṃ kṣamāpayet //
1.110.d:
प्ररूढसप्तधान्यैश्च नारगैर्बीजपूरकैः ।
अभ्युक्ष्याक्षततोयेन मन्त्रेणेत्थं क्षमापयेत् ॥
1.110.m:
with sprouted seven grains, and with oranges and citrons.
Having sprinkled it with water and unbroken rice, one should ask forgiveness with this mantra:

1.110.s:
karavīra vṛṣāvāsa namaste bhānuvallabha /
daṃbholimṛḍadurgādidevānāṃ satataṃ priya //
1.110.d:
करवीर वृषावास नमस्ते भानुवल्लभ ।
दंभोलिमृडदुर्गादिदेवानां सततं प्रिय ॥
1.110.m:
'O oleander, abode of righteousness, salutation to you, beloved of the sun,
ever dear to the gods headed by the wielder of the thunderbolt, Śiva, and Durgā!'

1.110.s:
ākṛṣṇeneti vedoktamantreṇetthaṃ kṣamāpayet /
evaṃ bhaktyā samabhyacya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām //
1.110.d:
आकृष्णेनेति वेदोक्तमन्त्रेणेत्थं क्षमापयेत् ।
एवं भक्त्या समभ्यच्य दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ॥
1.110.m:
With this Vedic mantra beginning with 'ākṛṣṇena', one should thus ask forgiveness.
Having worshipped thus with devotion and given a sacrificial gift to a brāhmaṇa,

1.110.s:
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kuryātpaścātsvabhavanaṃ vrajet /
nabhaḥ śukle pratipadi lakṣmībuddhipradāyakam //
1.110.d:
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कुर्यात्पश्चात्स्वभवनं व्रजेत् ।
नभः शुक्ले प्रतिपदि लक्ष्मीबुद्धिप्रदायकम् ॥
1.110.m:
one should then perform circumambulation and afterwards return to one's own home.
On the bright first lunar day of Śrāvaṇa, granting fortune and wisdom,

1.110.s:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ nidānaṃ paramaṃ vratam /
somavāraṃ samārabhya sārdhamāsatrayaṃ dvija //
1.110.d:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां निदानं परमं व्रतम् ।
सोमवारं समारभ्य सार्धमासत्रयं द्विज ॥
1.110.m:
the supreme observance, the foundation of righteousness, wealth, desire, and liberation,
is undertaken on a Monday for three and a half months, O twice-born.

1.110.s:
kārtikāsitabhūtāyāmupoṣyaṃ vratatatparaḥ /
pūrṇāyāṃ śivamabhyarcya suvaṇa vaṃśasaṃyutam //
1.110.d:
कार्तिकासितभूतायामुपोष्यं व्रततत्परः ।
पूर्णायां शिवमभ्यर्च्य सुवण वंशसंयुतम् ॥
1.110.m:
Devoted to the observance, having fasted on the fourteenth of the dark fortnight of Kārtika,
one should worship Śiva on the full moon day with a bamboo vessel containing gold.

1.110.s:
vāyanaṃ sumahatpuṇyaṃ devatāprītivardhakam /
dadyādviprāya saṃkalpya dhanavṛddhyai munīśvara //
1.110.d:
वायनं सुमहत्पुण्यं देवताप्रीतिवर्धकम् ।
दद्याद्विप्राय संकल्प्य धनवृद्ध्यै मुनीश्वर ॥
1.110.m:
A most meritorious ritual gift increasing the delight of the deities
should be given to a brāhmaṇa with a solemn resolve for the increase of wealth, O lord of sages.

1.110.s:
bhādraśuklapratipadi vrataṃ nāmnā mahattamam /
vrataṃ maunāhvayaṃ kecitprāhuratra śivor'cyate //
1.110.d:
भाद्रशुक्लप्रतिपदि व्रतं नाम्ना महत्तमम् ।
व्रतं मौनाह्वयं केचित्प्राहुरत्र शिवोर्ऽच्यते ॥
1.110.m:
On the bright first lunar day of Bhādrapada is the supreme observance by name;
some call it the observance called Mauna, wherein Śiva is worshipped.

1.110.s:
naivedyaṃ tu pacenmaunī ṣoḍaśatriguṇāni ca /
phalāni piṣṭapakvāni dadyādviprāya ṣoḍaśa //
1.110.d:
नैवेद्यं तु पचेन्मौनी षोडशत्रिगुणानि च ।
फलानि पिष्टपक्वानि दद्याद्विप्राय षोडश ॥
1.110.m:
The silent observer should cook offerings, and sixteen times three
fruits and cooked pastries; he should give sixteen to a brāhmaṇa,

1.110.s:
devāya ṣoḍaśānyāni bhujyante ṣoḍaśātmanā /
sauvarṇaṃ śivamabhyarcya kumbhopari vidhānavit //
1.110.d:
देवाय षोडशान्यानि भुज्यन्ते षोडशात्मना ।
सौवर्णं शिवमभ्यर्च्य कुम्भोपरि विधानवित् ॥
1.110.m:
sixteen others to the god, and sixteen are eaten by himself.
Having worshipped golden Śiva atop a water jar, a knower of the rules

1.110.s:
tatsarvaṃ dhenusahitamācāryyāya pradāpayet /
idaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra deva devasya śūlinaḥ //
1.110.d:
तत्सर्वं धेनुसहितमाचार्य्याय प्रदापयेत् ।
इदं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र देव देवस्य शूलिनः ॥
1.110.m:
should give all that together with a cow to the preceptor.
Having performed this observance, O brāhmaṇa, of the god of gods, the trident-bearer,

1.110.s:
caturdaśābdaṃ dehāntaṃ bhuktabhogaḥ śivaṃ vrajet /
āśvine sitapakṣatyāṃ katvāśokavrataṃ naraḥ //
1.110.d:
चतुर्दशाब्दं देहान्तं भुक्तभोगः शिवं व्रजेत् ।
आश्विने सितपक्षत्यां कत्वाशोकव्रतं नरः ॥
1.110.m:
for fourteen years, having enjoyed pleasures until the end of the body, he goes to Śiva.
Having performed the Aśoka-vrata on the bright first lunar day of Āśvina, a man

1.110.s:
aśoko jāyate vipradhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ /
aśokapūjanaṃ tatra kāryaṃ niyamatatparaiḥ //
1.110.d:
अशोको जायते विप्रधनधान्यसमन्वितः ।
अशोकपूजनं तत्र कार्यं नियमतत्परैः ॥
1.110.m:
becomes free from sorrow, endowed with wealth and grain, O brāhmaṇa.
The worship of the aśoka tree is to be performed there by those intent on the vow.

1.110.s:
vratānte dvādaśe varṣe mūrtiṃ cāśokaśākhinaḥ /
samarpya gurave bhaktyā śivaloke mahīyate //
1.110.d:
व्रतान्ते द्वादशे वर्षे मूर्तिं चाशोकशाखिनः ।
समर्प्य गुरवे भक्त्या शिवलोके महीयते ॥
1.110.m:
At the end of the observance, in the twelfth year, having offered an image of the aśoka tree
to the guru with devotion, he is glorified in the world of Śiva.

1.110.s:
asyāmeva pratipadi navarātraṃ samārabhet /
pūrvāhne pūjayeddevīṃ ghaṭasthāpanapūrvakam //
1.110.d:
अस्यामेव प्रतिपदि नवरात्रं समारभेत् ।
पूर्वाह्ने पूजयेद्देवीं घटस्थापनपूर्वकम् ॥
1.110.m:
On this very first lunar day, one should begin the Navarātra.
In the morning, one should worship the Goddess after establishing the water jar,

1.110.s:
aṅkurāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā yavairgodhūmamiśritaiḥ /
tataḥ pratidinaṃ kuryādekabhuktamayācitam //
1.110.d:
अङ्कुरारोपणं कृत्वा यवैर्गोधूममिश्रितैः ।
ततः प्रतिदिनं कुर्यादेकभुक्तमयाचितम् ॥
1.110.m:
having sown sprouts with barley mixed with wheat.
Then every day one should eat once, unasked,

1.110.s:
upavāsaṃ yathāśakti pūjāpāṭhajapādikam /
mārkaṃṇḍeya purāṇoktaṃ caritatritayaṃ dvija //
1.110.d:
उपवासं यथाशक्ति पूजापाठजपादिकम् ।
मार्कंण्डेय पुराणोक्तं चरितत्रितयं द्विज ॥
1.110.m:
fast according to one's ability, and perform worship, recitation, japa, and the like.
The three episodes proclaimed in the Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa, O twice-born,

1.110.s:
paṭhanīyaṃ navadinaṃ bhuktimuktī abhīpsatā /
kumārīpūjanaṃ tatra praśastaṃ bhojanādibhiḥ //
1.110.d:
पठनीयं नवदिनं भुक्तिमुक्ती अभीप्सता ।
कुमारीपूजनं तत्र प्रशस्तं भोजनादिभिः ॥
1.110.m:
should be read for nine days by one desiring enjoyment and liberation.
The worship of young virgins there with food and the like is praised.

1.110.s:
itthaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra sarvasiddhyālayo naraḥ /
jāyate bhuvi durgāyāḥ prasādānnātra saṃśayaḥ //
1.110.d:
इत्थं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र सर्वसिद्ध्यालयो नरः ।
जायते भुवि दुर्गायाः प्रसादान्नात्र संशयः ॥
1.110.m:
Having performed the observance in this manner, O brāhmaṇa, a man becomes an abode
of all accomplishments on earth through the grace of Durgā; of this there is no doubt.

1.110.s:
athorjasitapakṣatyāṃ navarātroditaṃ caret /
viśeṣādannakūṭākhyaṃ viṣṇuprītivivardhanam //
1.110.d:
अथोर्जसितपक्षत्यां नवरात्रोदितं चरेत् ।
विशेषादन्नकूटाख्यं विष्णुप्रीतिविवर्धनम् ॥
1.110.m:
Then, on the bright first lunar day of Kārtika, one should observe what is prescribed for Navarātra,
especially the rite called Annakūṭa, which increases the pleasure of Viṣṇu.

1.110.s:
sarvapākaiḥ sardadohaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvārthasiddhaye /
kartavyamannakūṭaṃ tu govarddhanasamarcane //
1.110.d:
सर्वपाकैः सर्ददोहैः सर्वैः सर्वार्थसिद्धये ।
कर्तव्यमन्नकूटं तु गोवर्द्धनसमर्चने ॥
1.110.m: With all cooked foods and all milk-yields, for the achievement of all ends, / a mountain of food should be made during the worship of Govardhana.

1.110.s:
sāyaṃ gobhiḥ saha śrīmadgovarddhanadharādharam /
samarcya dakṣiṇīkṛtya bhuktimuktī samāpnuyāt //
1.110.d:
सायं गोभिः सह श्रीमद्गोवर्द्धनधराधरम् ।
समर्च्य दक्षिणीकृत्य भुक्तिमुक्ती समाप्नुयात् ॥
1.110.m: In the evening, having worshipped the glorious Govardhana mountain along with the cows / and circumambulated it, one obtains enjoyment and liberation.

1.110.s:
atha mārgasitādyāyāṃ dhanavratamanuttamam /
naktaṃ viṣṇvarcanaṃ homaiḥ sauvarṇīṃ hutabhuktanum //
1.110.d:
अथ मार्गसिताद्यायां धनव्रतमनुत्तमम् ।
नक्तं विष्ण्वर्चनं होमैः सौवर्णीं हुतभुक्तनुम् ॥
1.110.m: Now, on the first day of the bright half of Mārgaśīrṣa, is the unsurpassed vow for wealth: / the worship of Viṣṇu at night with fire oblations; one should give a golden image of Agni,

1.110.s:
raktavastrayugācchannāṃ dvijāya pratipādayet /
evaṃ kṛtvā dhanairdhānyaiḥ samṛddho jāyate bhuvi //
1.110.d:
रक्तवस्त्रयुगाच्छन्नां द्विजाय प्रतिपादयेत् ।
एवं कृत्वा धनैर्धान्यैः समृद्धो जायते भुवि ॥
1.110.m: covered with a pair of red garments, to a twice-born. / Doing thus, one becomes rich with wealth and grains on earth;

1.110.s:
vahninā dagdhapāpastu viṣṇuloke mahīyate /
pauṣaśuklapratipadi bhānumabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ //
1.110.d:
वह्निना दग्धपापस्तु विष्णुलोके महीयते ।
पौषशुक्लप्रतिपदि भानुमभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः ॥
1.110.m: with his sins burnt by fire, he is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu. / On the first day of the bright half of Pauṣa, having worshipped the Sun with devotion,

1.110.s:
ekabhaktavrato martyo bhānulokamavāpnuyāt /
māghaśuklādyadivase vahniṃ sākṣānmaheśvaram //
1.110.d:
एकभक्तव्रतो मर्त्यो भानुलोकमवाप्नुयात् ।
माघशुक्लाद्यदिवसे वह्निं साक्षान्महेश्वरम् ॥
1.110.m: a mortal observing the vow of eating a single meal reaches the world of the Sun. / On the first day of the bright half of Māgha, having duly worshipped

1.110.s:
samabhyacya vidhānena samṛddho jāyate bhuvi /
atha phaālgunaśuklādau devadevaṃ digaṃbaram //
1.110.d:
समभ्यच्य विधानेन समृद्धो जायते भुवि ।
अथ फआल्गुनशुक्लादौ देवदेवं दिगंबरम् ॥
1.110.m: Agni as Maheśvara in person, one becomes prosperous on earth. / Now, on the first day of the bright half of Phālguna, one should sprinkle all around with water

1.110.s:
dhūlidhūsarasarvāṅgaṃ jalairukṣetsamantataḥ /
karmaṇā laukikenāpi saṃtuṣṭo hi maheśvaraḥ //
1.110.d:
धूलिधूसरसर्वाङ्गं जलैरुक्षेत्समन्ततः ।
कर्मणा लौकिकेनापि संतुष्टो हि महेश्वरः ॥
1.110.m: the God of gods, who is clothed in space, whose entire body is grey with dust. / Satisfied even by an ordinary worldly act,

1.110.s:
svasāyujyaṃ pradiśati bhaktyā samyaksamarcitaḥ /
vaiśākhe tu sitādyāyāṃ viṣṇuṃ viśvavihāriṇam //
1.110.d:
स्वसायुज्यं प्रदिशति भक्त्या सम्यक्समर्चितः ।
वैशाखे तु सिताद्यायां विष्णुं विश्वविहारिणम् ॥
1.110.m: Maheśvara, when worshipped properly with devotion, grants union with himself. / On the first day of the bright half of Vaiśākha, having duly worshipped

1.110.s:
samabhyarcya vidhānena viprānsaṃbhojayedvatī /
evaṃ śucisitādyāyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ gurum //
1.110.d:
समभ्यर्च्य विधानेन विप्रान्संभोजयेद्वती ।
एवं शुचिसिताद्यायां ब्रह्माणं जगतां गुरुम् ॥
1.110.m: Viṣṇu, who sports through the universe, the vow-keeper should feed Brahmins. / Likewise, on the first day of the bright half of Śuci, [having worshipped] Brahmā, the guru of the worlds,

1.110.s:
viṣṇunā sahito brahmā sarvalokeśvareśvaraḥ /
svasāyujyaṃ pradiśati sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt //
1.110.d:
विष्णुना सहितो ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकेश्वरेश्वरः ।
स्वसायुज्यं प्रदिशति सर्वसिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् ॥
1.110.m: Brahmā together with Viṣṇu, the Lord of the lords of all worlds, / grants union with himself, and one obtains all perfections.

1.110.s:
āsu dvādaśamāsānāṃ pratipatsu dvijottama /
vratāni tubhyaṃ proktāni bhuktimuktipradāni ca //
1.110.d:
आसु द्वादशमासानां प्रतिपत्सु द्विजोत्तम ।
व्रतानि तुभ्यं प्रोक्तानि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानि च ॥
1.110.m: The vows on these first days of the twelve months, O best of the twice-born, / have been declared to you, bestowing enjoyment and liberation.

1.110.s:
vrateṣveteṣu sarveṣu brahmacaryaṃ vidhīyate /
bhojane tu haviṣyānnaṃ sāmānyata udāhṛtam //
